source_hebrew: Westminster Leningrad Codex (pointed text via Sefaria), supplied for reference; the site does not display the Hebrew

verses.english: A man lived in the land of Uz whose name was Job. That man was blameless and upright, fearing God and turning away from evil.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ הָיָה בְאֶרֶץ־עוּץ אִיּוֹב שְׁמוֹ וְהָיָה הָאִישׁ הַהוּא תָּם וְיָשָׁר וִירֵא אֱלֹהִים וְסָר מֵרָע׃

verses.english: Seven sons and three daughters were born to him.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּוָּלְדוּ לוֹ שִׁבְעָה בָנִים וְשָׁלוֹשׁ בָּנוֹת׃

verses.english: His livestock numbered seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of cattle, and five hundred female donkeys, and he had a very large household of servants. That man was greater than all the sons of the east.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקְנֵהוּ שִׁבְעַת אַלְפֵי־צֹאן וּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אַלְפֵי גְמַלִּים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת צֶמֶד־בָּקָר וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת אֲתוֹנוֹת וַעֲבֻדָּה רַבָּה מְאֹד וַיְהִי הָאִישׁ הַהוּא גָּדוֹל מִכָּל־בְּנֵי־קֶדֶם׃

verses.english: His sons would go and hold a feast in each one’s house on his day. They would send and invite their three sisters to eat and drink with them.
verses.hebrew: וְהָלְכוּ בָנָיו וְעָשׂוּ מִשְׁתֶּה בֵּית אִישׁ יוֹמוֹ וְשָׁלְחוּ וְקָרְאוּ לִשְׁלֹשֶׁת אחיתיהם [אַחְיוֹתֵיהֶם] לֶאֱכֹל וְלִשְׁתּוֹת עִמָּהֶם׃

verses.english: When the days of the feast had gone their round, Job would send for them and consecrate them. He would rise early in the morning and offer burnt offerings according to the number of them all, for Job said, “Perhaps my sons have sinned and cursed God in their hearts.” Job did this continually.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי הִקִּיפוּ יְמֵי הַמִּשְׁתֶּה וַיִּשְׁלַח אִיּוֹב וַיְקַדְּשֵׁם וְהִשְׁכִּים בַּבֹּקֶר וְהֶעֱלָה עֹלוֹת מִסְפַּר כֻּלָּם כִּי אָמַר אִיּוֹב אוּלַי חָטְאוּ בָנַי וּבֵרֲכוּ אֱלֹהִים בִּלְבָבָם כָּכָה יַעֲשֶׂה אִיּוֹב כָּל־הַיָּמִים׃

verses.english: One day the sons of God came to present themselves before YHWH, and the accuser also came among them.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וַיָּבֹאוּ בְּנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים לְהִתְיַצֵּב עַל־יְהוָה וַיָּבוֹא גַם־הַשָּׂטָן בְּתוֹכָם׃

verses.english: YHWH said to the accuser, “Where have you come from?” The accuser answered YHWH, “From roaming about the earth and walking around in it.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־הַשָּׂטָן מֵאַיִן תָּבֹא וַיַּעַן הַשָּׂטָן אֶת־יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר מִשּׁוּט בָּאָרֶץ וּמֵהִתְהַלֵּךְ בָּהּ׃

verses.english: YHWH said to the accuser, “Have you set your heart on My servant Job? For there is no one like him on earth, a blameless and upright man, fearing God and turning away from evil.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־הַשָּׂטָן הֲשַׂמְתָּ לִבְּךָ עַל־עַבְדִּי אִיּוֹב כִּי אֵין כָּמֹהוּ בָּאָרֶץ אִישׁ תָּם וְיָשָׁר יְרֵא אֱלֹהִים וְסָר מֵרָע׃

verses.english: The accuser answered YHWH, “Does Job fear God for nothing?
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הַשָּׂטָן אֶת־יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר הַחִנָּם יָרֵא אִיּוֹב אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: Have You not put a hedge around him, around his house, and around everything he has on every side? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his livestock have spread through the land.
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־את [אַתָּה] שַׂכְתָּ בַעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד־בֵּיתוֹ וּבְעַד כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ מִסָּבִיב מַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו בֵּרַכְתָּ וּמִקְנֵהוּ פָּרַץ בָּאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: But stretch out Your hand now and touch everything he has; surely he will curse You to Your face.”
verses.hebrew: וְאוּלָם שְׁלַח־נָא יָדְךָ וְגַע בְּכָל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ אִם־לֹא עַל־פָּנֶיךָ יְבָרֲכֶךָּ׃

verses.english: YHWH said to the accuser, “Look, everything he has is in your hand; only do not stretch out your hand against him.” Then the accuser went out from the presence of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־הַשָּׂטָן הִנֵּה כָל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ בְּיָדֶךָ רַק אֵלָיו אַל־תִּשְׁלַח יָדֶךָ וַיֵּצֵא הַשָּׂטָן מֵעִם פְּנֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: One day his sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine in the house of their eldest brother.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וּבָנָיו וּבְנֹתָיו אֹכְלִים וְשֹׁתִים יַיִן בְּבֵית אֲחִיהֶם הַבְּכוֹר׃

verses.english: A messenger came to Job and said, “The cattle were plowing, and the female donkeys were grazing beside them.
verses.hebrew: וּמַלְאָךְ בָּא אֶל־אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר הַבָּקָר הָיוּ חֹרְשׁוֹת וְהָאֲתֹנוֹת רֹעוֹת עַל־יְדֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Then Sabeans fell upon them and took them, and they struck the servants with the edge of the sword. I alone escaped to tell you.”
verses.hebrew: וַתִּפֹּל שְׁבָא וַתִּקָּחֵם וְאֶת־הַנְּעָרִים הִכּוּ לְפִי־חָרֶב וָאִמָּלְטָה רַק־אֲנִי לְבַדִּי לְהַגִּיד לָךְ׃

verses.english: While this one was still speaking, another came and said, “Fire of God fell from heaven and burned among the sheep and the servants and consumed them. I alone escaped to tell you.”
verses.hebrew: עוֹד זֶה מְדַבֵּר וְזֶה בָּא וַיֹּאמַר אֵשׁ אֱלֹהִים נָפְלָה מִן־הַשָּׁמַיִם וַתִּבְעַר בַּצֹּאן וּבַנְּעָרִים וַתֹּאכְלֵם וָאִמָּלְטָה רַק־אֲנִי לְבַדִּי לְהַגִּיד לָךְ׃

verses.english: While this one was still speaking, another came and said, “Chaldeans formed three companies, raided the camels and took them, and struck the servants with the edge of the sword. I alone escaped to tell you.”
verses.hebrew: עוֹד זֶה מְדַבֵּר וְזֶה בָּא וַיֹּאמַר כַּשְׂדִּים שָׂמוּ שְׁלֹשָׁה רָאשִׁים וַיִּפְשְׁטוּ עַל־הַגְּמַלִּים וַיִּקָּחוּם וְאֶת־הַנְּעָרִים הִכּוּ לְפִי־חָרֶב וָאִמָּלְטָה רַק־אֲנִי לְבַדִּי לְהַגִּיד לָךְ׃

verses.english: While this one was still speaking, another came and said, “Your sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine in the house of their eldest brother.
verses.hebrew: עַד זֶה מְדַבֵּר וְזֶה בָּא וַיֹּאמַר בָּנֶיךָ וּבְנוֹתֶיךָ אֹכְלִים וְשֹׁתִים יַיִן בְּבֵית אֲחִיהֶם הַבְּכוֹר׃

verses.english: Then look, a great wind came from beyond the wilderness and struck the four corners of the house. It fell on the young people, and they died. I alone escaped to tell you.”
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה רוּחַ גְּדוֹלָה בָּאָה מֵעֵבֶר הַמִּדְבָּר וַיִּגַּע בְּאַרְבַּע פִּנּוֹת הַבַּיִת וַיִּפֹּל עַל־הַנְּעָרִים וַיָּמוּתוּ וָאִמָּלְטָה רַק־אֲנִי לְבַדִּי לְהַגִּיד לָךְ׃

verses.english: Job rose, tore his robe, and shaved his head. He fell to the ground and bowed in worship.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם אִיּוֹב וַיִּקְרַע אֶת־מְעִלוֹ וַיָּגָז אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיִּפֹּל אַרְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ׃

verses.english: He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked I will return there. YHWH gave, and YHWH took away. May the name of YHWH be blessed.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר עָרֹם יצתי [יָצָאתִי] מִבֶּטֶן אִמִּי וְעָרֹם אָשׁוּב שָׁמָה יְהוָה נָתַן וַיהוָה לָקָח יְהִי שֵׁם יְהוָה מְבֹרָךְ׃

verses.english: In all this Job did not sin or attribute folly to God.
verses.hebrew: בְּכָל־זֹאת לֹא־חָטָא אִיּוֹב וְלֹא־נָתַן תִּפְלָה לֵאלֹהִים׃

verses.english: One day the sons of God came to present themselves before YHWH, and the accuser also came among them to present himself before YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וַיָּבֹאוּ בְּנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים לְהִתְיַצֵּב עַל־יְהוָה וַיָּבוֹא גַם־הַשָּׂטָן בְּתֹכָם לְהִתְיַצֵּב עַל־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: YHWH said to the accuser, “Where have you come from?” The accuser answered YHWH, “From roaming about the earth and walking around in it.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־הַשָּׂטָן אֵי מִזֶּה תָּבֹא וַיַּעַן הַשָּׂטָן אֶת־יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר מִשֻּׁט בָּאָרֶץ וּמֵהִתְהַלֵּךְ בָּהּ׃

verses.english: YHWH said to the accuser, “Have you set your heart on My servant Job? For there is no one like him on earth, a blameless and upright man, fearing God and turning away from evil. He still holds firmly to his integrity, although you incited Me against him to swallow him up for nothing.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־הַשָּׂטָן הֲשַׂמְתָּ לִבְּךָ אֶל־עַבְדִּי אִיּוֹב כִּי אֵין כָּמֹהוּ בָּאָרֶץ אִישׁ תָּם וְיָשָׁר יְרֵא אֱלֹהִים וְסָר מֵרָע וְעֹדֶנּוּ מַחֲזִיק בְּתֻמָּתוֹ וַתְּסִיתֵנִי בוֹ לְבַלְּעוֹ חִנָּם׃

verses.english: The accuser answered YHWH, “Skin for skin! Everything a man has he will give for his life.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הַשָּׂטָן אֶת־יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר עוֹר בְּעַד־עוֹר וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר לָאִישׁ יִתֵּן בְּעַד נַפְשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: But stretch out Your hand now and touch his bone and his flesh; surely he will curse You to Your face.”
verses.hebrew: אוּלָם שְׁלַח־נָא יָדְךָ וְגַע אֶל־עַצְמוֹ וְאֶל־בְּשָׂרוֹ אִם־לֹא אֶל־פָּנֶיךָ יְבָרֲכֶךָּ׃

verses.english: YHWH said to the accuser, “Look, he is in your hand; only preserve his life.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־הַשָּׂטָן הִנּוֹ בְיָדֶךָ אַךְ אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ שְׁמֹר׃

verses.english: The accuser went out from the presence of YHWH and struck Job with a grievous boil from the sole of his foot to the crown of his head.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הַשָּׂטָן מֵאֵת פְּנֵי יְהוָה וַיַּךְ אֶת־אִיּוֹב בִּשְׁחִין רָע מִכַּף רַגְלוֹ עד [וְעַד] קָדְקֳדוֹ׃

verses.english: He took a potsherd to scrape himself with while he sat among the ashes.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח־לוֹ חֶרֶשׂ לְהִתְגָּרֵד בּוֹ וְהוּא יֹשֵׁב בְּתוֹךְ־הָאֵפֶר׃

verses.english: His wife said to him, “Do you still hold firmly to your integrity? Curse God and die.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אִשְׁתּוֹ עֹדְךָ מַחֲזִיק בְּתֻמָּתֶךָ בָּרֵךְ אֱלֹהִים וָמֻת׃

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אִשְׁתּוֹ עֹדְךָ מַחֲזִיק בְּתֻמָּתֶךָ בָּרֵךְ אֱלֹהִים וָמֻת׃

verses.english: He said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women speaks. Shall we receive the good from God and not receive the bad?” In all this Job did not sin with his lips.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ כְּדַבֵּר אַחַת הַנְּבָלוֹת תְּדַבֵּרִי גַּם אֶת־הַטּוֹב נְקַבֵּל מֵאֵת הָאֱלֹהִים וְאֶת־הָרָע לֹא נְקַבֵּל בְּכָל־זֹאת לֹא־חָטָא אִיּוֹב בִּשְׂפָתָיו׃

verses.english: Job’s three friends heard of all this calamity that had come upon him. They came, each from his own place: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite. They agreed together to come to grieve with him and comfort him.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת רֵעֵי אִיּוֹב אֵת כָּל־הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת הַבָּאָה עָלָיו וַיָּבֹאוּ אִישׁ מִמְּקֹמוֹ אֱלִיפַז הַתֵּימָנִי וּבִלְדַּד הַשּׁוּחִי וְצוֹפַר הַנַּעֲמָתִי וַיִּוָּעֲדוּ יַחְדָּו לָבוֹא לָנוּד־לוֹ וּלְנַחֲמוֹ׃

verses.english: They lifted their eyes from a distance and did not recognize him. They raised their voices and wept; each tore his robe, and they threw dust toward heaven over their heads.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת־עֵינֵיהֶם מֵרָחוֹק וְלֹא הִכִּירֻהוּ וַיִּשְׂאוּ קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ וַיִּקְרְעוּ אִישׁ מְעִלוֹ וַיִּזְרְקוּ עָפָר עַל־רָאשֵׁיהֶם הַשָּׁמָיְמָה׃

verses.english: They sat with him on the ground seven days and seven nights, and no one spoke a word to him, for they saw that his pain was very great.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ אִתּוֹ לָאָרֶץ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְשִׁבְעַת לֵילוֹת וְאֵין־דֹּבֵר אֵלָיו דָּבָר כִּי רָאוּ כִּי־גָדַל הַכְּאֵב מְאֹד׃

verses.english: After this Job opened his mouth and cursed his day.
verses.hebrew: אַחֲרֵי־כֵן פָּתַח אִיּוֹב אֶת־פִּיהוּ וַיְקַלֵּל אֶת־יוֹמוֹ׃

verses.english: Job spoke and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “Let the day perish on which I was born, and the night that said, ‘A male child has been conceived!’
verses.hebrew: יֹאבַד יוֹם אִוָּלֶד בּוֹ וְהַלַּיְלָה אָמַר הֹרָה גָבֶר׃

verses.english: Let that day be darkness; let God above not seek it, and let no light shine upon it.
verses.hebrew: הַיּוֹם הַהוּא יְהִי חֹשֶׁךְ אַל־יִדְרְשֵׁהוּ אֱלוֹהַּ מִמָּעַל וְאַל־תּוֹפַע עָלָיו נְהָרָה׃

verses.english: Let darkness and death’s shadow reclaim it; let a cloud dwell upon it; let the blackness of day terrify it.
verses.hebrew: יִגְאָלֻהוּ חֹשֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָוֶת תִּשְׁכָּן־עָלָיו עֲנָנָה יְבַעֲתֻהוּ כִּמְרִירֵי יוֹם׃

verses.english: That night—let gloom seize it; let it not rejoice among the days of the year, let it not enter the number of the months.
verses.hebrew: הַלַּיְלָה הַהוּא יִקָּחֵהוּ אֹפֶל אַל־יִחַדְּ בִּימֵי שָׁנָה בְּמִסְפַּר יְרָחִים אַל־יָבֹא׃

verses.english: Look, let that night be barren; let no joyful cry enter it.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה הַלַּיְלָה הַהוּא יְהִי גַלְמוּד אַל־תָּבֹא רְנָנָה בוֹ׃

verses.english: Let those who curse a day curse it, those ready to rouse Leviathan.
verses.hebrew: יִקְּבֻהוּ אֹרְרֵי־יוֹם הָעֲתִידִים עֹרֵר לִוְיָתָן׃

verses.english: Let the stars of its twilight be darkened; let it wait for light and have none, and let it not see the eyelids of dawn,
verses.hebrew: יֶחְשְׁכוּ כּוֹכְבֵי נִשְׁפּוֹ יְקַו־לְאוֹר וָאַיִן וְאַל־יִרְאֶה בְּעַפְעַפֵּי־שָׁחַר׃

verses.english: because it did not shut the doors of my mother’s womb and hide trouble from my eyes.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא סָגַר דַּלְתֵי בִטְנִי וַיַּסְתֵּר עָמָל מֵעֵינָי׃

verses.english: Why did I not die from the womb, come out from the belly and expire?
verses.hebrew: לָמָּה לֹּא מֵרֶחֶם אָמוּת מִבֶּטֶן יָצָאתִי וְאֶגְוָע׃

verses.english: Why did knees receive me? Why were there breasts for me to suck?
verses.hebrew: מַדּוּעַ קִדְּמוּנִי בִרְכָּיִם וּמַה־שָּׁדַיִם כִּי אִינָק׃

verses.english: For now I would have lain down and been quiet; I would have slept, then been at rest,
verses.hebrew: כִּי־עַתָּה שָׁכַבְתִּי וְאֶשְׁקוֹט יָשַׁנְתִּי אָז יָנוּחַ לִי׃

verses.english: with kings and counselors of the earth who built ruins for themselves,
verses.hebrew: עִם־מְלָכִים וְיֹעֲצֵי אָרֶץ הַבֹּנִים חֳרָבוֹת לָמוֹ׃

verses.english: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver.
verses.hebrew: אוֹ עִם־שָׂרִים זָהָב לָהֶם הַמְמַלְאִים בָּתֵּיהֶם כָּסֶף׃

verses.english: Or, like a hidden miscarriage, I would not exist, like infants who never saw light.
verses.hebrew: אוֹ כְנֵפֶל טָמוּן לֹא אֶהְיֶה כְּעֹלְלִים לֹא־רָאוּ אוֹר׃

verses.english: There the wicked cease from turmoil, and there those exhausted of strength rest.
verses.hebrew: שָׁם רְשָׁעִים חָדְלוּ רֹגֶז וְשָׁם יָנוּחוּ יְגִיעֵי כֹחַ׃

verses.english: Together the prisoners are at ease; they do not hear the taskmaster’s voice.
verses.hebrew: יַחַד אֲסִירִים שַׁאֲנָנוּ לֹא שָׁמְעוּ קוֹל נֹגֵשׂ׃

verses.english: Small and great are there, and the slave is free from his master.
verses.hebrew: קָטֹן וְגָדוֹל שָׁם הוּא וְעֶבֶד חָפְשִׁי מֵאֲדֹנָיו׃

verses.english: Why does He give light to one in trouble, and life to those bitter in soul,
verses.hebrew: לָמָּה יִתֵּן לְעָמֵל אוֹר וְחַיִּים לְמָרֵי נָפֶשׁ׃

verses.english: who wait for death, but it does not come, and dig for it more than for hidden treasures,
verses.hebrew: הַמְחַכִּים לַמָּוֶת וְאֵינֶנּוּ וַיַּחְפְּרֻהוּ מִמַּטְמוֹנִים׃

verses.english: who rejoice exceedingly and are glad when they find a grave?
verses.hebrew: הַשְּׂמֵחִים אֱלֵי־גִיל יָשִׂישׂוּ כִּי יִמְצְאוּ־קָבֶר׃

verses.english: Why give it to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?
verses.hebrew: לְגֶבֶר אֲשֶׁר־דַּרְכּוֹ נִסְתָּרָה וַיָּסֶךְ אֱלוֹהַּ בַּעֲדוֹ׃

verses.english: For my sighing comes before my bread, and my groans pour out like water.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־לִפְנֵי לַחְמִי אַנְחָתִי תָבֹא וַיִּתְּכוּ כַמַּיִם שַׁאֲגֹתָי׃

verses.english: For the dread I dreaded has come upon me, and what I feared comes to me.
verses.hebrew: כִּי פַחַד פָּחַדְתִּי וַיֶּאֱתָיֵנִי וַאֲשֶׁר יָגֹרְתִּי יָבֹא לִי׃

verses.english: I have no ease, no quiet, no rest; yet turmoil comes.”
verses.hebrew: לֹא שָׁלַוְתִּי וְלֹא שָׁקַטְתִּי וְלֹא־נָחְתִּי וַיָּבֹא רֹגֶז׃

verses.english: Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אֱלִיפַז הַתֵּימָנִי וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “If someone ventures a word to you, will you be weary? But who can restrain words?
verses.hebrew: הֲנִסָּה דָבָר אֵלֶיךָ תִּלְאֶה וַעְצֹר בְּמִלִּין מִי יוּכָל׃

verses.english: Look, you have instructed many and strengthened slack hands.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה יִסַּרְתָּ רַבִּים וְיָדַיִם רָפוֹת תְּחַזֵּק׃

verses.english: Your words have raised up the stumbling, and you have strengthened buckling knees.
verses.hebrew: כּוֹשֵׁל יְקִימוּן מִלֶּיךָ וּבִרְכַּיִם כֹּרְעוֹת תְּאַמֵּץ׃

verses.english: But now it comes to you, and you are weary; it touches you, and you are alarmed.
verses.hebrew: כִּי עַתָּה תָּבוֹא אֵלֶיךָ וַתֵּלֶא תִּגַּע עָדֶיךָ וַתִּבָּהֵל׃

verses.english: Is not your fear of God your confidence, and the integrity of your ways your hope?
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא יִרְאָתְךָ כִּסְלָתֶךָ תִּקְוָתְךָ וְתֹם דְּרָכֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Remember now: who that was innocent ever perished? Where were the upright wiped out?
verses.hebrew: זְכָר־נָא מִי הוּא נָקִי אָבָד וְאֵיפֹה יְשָׁרִים נִכְחָדוּ׃

verses.english: As I have seen, those who plow wrongdoing and sow trouble reap it.
verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר רָאִיתִי חֹרְשֵׁי אָוֶן וְזֹרְעֵי עָמָל יִקְצְרֻהוּ׃

verses.english: By God’s breath they perish; by the blast of His anger they come to an end.
verses.hebrew: מִנִּשְׁמַת אֱלוֹהַ יֹאבֵדוּ וּמֵרוּחַ אַפּוֹ יִכְלוּ׃

verses.english: The lion’s roar, the fierce lion’s voice, and the teeth of young lions are broken.
verses.hebrew: שַׁאֲגַת אַרְיֵה וְקוֹל שָׁחַל וְשִׁנֵּי כְפִירִים נִתָּעוּ׃

verses.english: The strong lion perishes for lack of prey, and the lioness’s cubs scatter.
verses.hebrew: לַיִשׁ אֹבֵד מִבְּלִי־טָרֶף וּבְנֵי לָבִיא יִתְפָּרָדוּ׃

verses.english: Now a word stole to me, and my ear caught a whisper of it.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלַי דָּבָר יְגֻנָּב וַתִּקַּח אָזְנִי שֵׁמֶץ מֶנְהוּ׃

verses.english: Amid disquieting thoughts from visions of the night, when deep sleep falls upon people,
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׂעִפִּים מֵחֶזְיֹנוֹת לָיְלָה בִּנְפֹל תַּרְדֵּמָה עַל־אֲנָשִׁים׃

verses.english: dread and trembling met me and made all my bones shake.
verses.hebrew: פַּחַד קְרָאַנִי וּרְעָדָה וְרֹב עַצְמוֹתַי הִפְחִיד׃

verses.english: A spirit passed across my face; the hair of my flesh stood on end.
verses.hebrew: וְרוּחַ עַל־פָּנַי יַחֲלֹף תְּסַמֵּר שַׂעֲרַת בְּשָׂרִי׃

verses.english: It stood still, but I could not recognize its appearance— a form before my eyes. Silence, and then I heard a voice:
verses.hebrew: יַעֲמֹד וְלֹא־אַכִּיר מַרְאֵהוּ תְּמוּנָה לְנֶגֶד עֵינָי דְּמָמָה וָקוֹל אֶשְׁמָע׃

verses.english: ‘Can a mortal be more righteous than God? Can a man be purer than his Maker?
verses.hebrew: הַאֱנוֹשׁ מֵאֱלוֹהַ יִצְדָּק אִם מֵעֹשֵׂהוּ יִטְהַר־גָּבֶר׃

verses.english: Look, He puts no trust in His servants, and He charges His angels with error;
verses.hebrew: הֵן בַּעֲבָדָיו לֹא יַאֲמִין וּבְמַלְאָכָיו יָשִׂים תָּהֳלָה׃

verses.english: how much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in dust, who are crushed more easily than a moth!
verses.hebrew: אַף שֹׁכְנֵי בָתֵּי־חֹמֶר אֲשֶׁר־בֶּעָפָר יְסוֹדָם יְדַכְּאוּם לִפְנֵי־עָשׁ׃

verses.english: From morning to evening they are shattered; without anyone noticing, they perish forever.
verses.hebrew: מִבֹּקֶר לָעֶרֶב יֻכַּתּוּ מִבְּלִי מֵשִׂים לָנֶצַח יֹאבֵדוּ׃

verses.english: Is not their tent cord pulled away within them? They die without wisdom.’
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־נִסַּע יִתְרָם בָּם יָמוּתוּ וְלֹא בְחָכְמָה׃

verses.english: “Call now! Is there anyone to answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?
verses.hebrew: קְרָא־נָא הֲיֵשׁ עוֹנֶךָּ וְאֶל־מִי מִקְּדֹשִׁים תִּפְנֶה׃

verses.english: For vexation kills a fool, and jealousy puts a simpleton to death.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־לֶאֱוִיל יַהֲרָג־כָּעַשׂ וּפֹתֶה תָּמִית קִנְאָה׃

verses.english: I have seen a fool taking root, but suddenly I cursed his dwelling.
verses.hebrew: אֲ‍נִי־רָאִיתִי אֱוִיל מַשְׁרִישׁ וָאֶקּוֹב נָוֵהוּ פִתְאֹם׃

verses.english: His children are far from deliverance; they are crushed in the gate, with no one to rescue them.
verses.hebrew: יִרְחֲקוּ בָנָיו מִיֶּשַׁע וְיִדַּכְּאוּ בַשַּׁעַר וְאֵין מַצִּיל׃

verses.english: The hungry eat his harvest and take it even from among thorns, and the thirsty pant after their wealth.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר קְצִירוֹ רָעֵב יֹאכֵל וְאֶל־מִצִּנִּים יִקָּחֵהוּ וְשָׁאַף צַמִּים חֵילָם׃

verses.english: For wrongdoing does not come out of dust, and trouble does not sprout from the ground;
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־יֵצֵא מֵעָפָר אָוֶן וּמֵאֲדָמָה לֹא־יִצְמַח עָמָל׃

verses.english: for a human being is born to trouble, as sparks fly upward.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אָדָם לְעָמָל יוּלָּד וּבְנֵי־רֶשֶׁף יַגְבִּיהוּ עוּף׃

verses.english: But as for me, I would seek God, and to God I would commit my cause,
verses.hebrew: אוּלָם אֲנִי אֶדְרֹשׁ אֶל־אֵל וְאֶל־אֱלֹהִים אָשִׂים דִּבְרָתִי׃

verses.english: who does great things beyond searching out, wonders beyond numbering.
verses.hebrew: עֹשֶׂה גְדֹלוֹת וְאֵין חֵקֶר נִפְלָאוֹת עַד־אֵין מִסְפָּר׃

verses.english: He gives rain upon the earth and sends water upon the fields,
verses.hebrew: הַנֹּתֵן מָטָר עַל־פְּנֵי־אָרֶץ וְשֹׁלֵחַ מַיִם עַל־פְּנֵי חוּצוֹת׃

verses.english: to set the lowly on high, and raise mourners to safety.
verses.hebrew: לָשׂוּם שְׁפָלִים לְמָרוֹם וְקֹדְרִים שָׂגְבוּ יֶשַׁע׃

verses.english: He frustrates the plans of the crafty, so their hands achieve no success.
verses.hebrew: מֵפֵר מַחְשְׁבוֹת עֲרוּמִים וְלֹא־תַעֲשֶׂינָה יְדֵיהֶם תּוּשִׁיָּה׃

verses.english: He catches the wise in their craftiness, and the counsel of the twisted is rushed headlong.
verses.hebrew: לֹכֵד חֲכָמִים בְּעָרְמָם וַעֲצַת נִפְתָּלִים נִמְהָרָה׃

verses.english: By day they meet darkness; at noon they grope as in the night.
verses.hebrew: יוֹמָם יְפַגְּשׁוּ־חֹשֶׁךְ וְכַלַּיְלָה יְמַשְׁשׁוּ בַצָּהֳרָיִם׃

verses.english: But He saves the needy from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the strong.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּשַׁע מֵחֶרֶב מִפִּיהֶם וּמִיַּד חָזָק אֶבְיוֹן׃

verses.english: So the poor have hope, and injustice shuts its mouth.
verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי לַדַּל תִּקְוָה וְעֹלָתָה קָפְצָה פִּיהָ׃

verses.english: Look, happy is the mortal whom God reproves; do not reject the discipline of Shaddai.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה אַשְׁרֵי אֱנוֹשׁ יוֹכִחֶנּוּ אֱלוֹהַּ וּמוּסַר שַׁדַּי אַל־תִּמְאָס׃

verses.english: For He causes pain and binds up; He wounds, and His hands heal.
verses.hebrew: כִּי הוּא יַכְאִיב וְיֶחְבָּשׁ יִמְחַץ וידו [וְיָדָיו] תִּרְפֶּינָה׃

verses.english: In six troubles He will rescue you; in seven no harm will touch you.
verses.hebrew: בְּשֵׁשׁ צָרוֹת יַצִּילֶךָּ וּבְשֶׁבַע לֹא־יִגַּע בְּךָ רָע׃

verses.english: In famine He will redeem you from death, and in war from the power of the sword.
verses.hebrew: בְּרָעָב פָּדְךָ מִמָּוֶת וּבְמִלְחָמָה מִידֵי חָרֶב׃

verses.english: You will be hidden from the lash of the tongue; you will not fear devastation when it comes.
verses.hebrew: בְּשׁוֹט לָשׁוֹן תֵּחָבֵא וְלֹא־תִירָא מִשֹּׁד כִּי יָבוֹא׃

verses.english: You will laugh at devastation and famine; do not fear the wild animals of the earth.
verses.hebrew: לְשֹׁד וּלְכָפָן תִּשְׂחָק וּמֵחַיַּת הָאָרֶץ אַל־תִּירָא׃

verses.english: For your covenant is with the stones of the field, and the wild animals of the field are at peace with you.
verses.hebrew: כִּי עִם־אַבְנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה בְרִיתֶךָ וְחַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה הָשְׁלְמָה־לָךְ׃

verses.english: You will know that your tent is at peace; you will inspect your dwelling and miss nothing.
verses.hebrew: וְיָדַעְתָּ כִּי־שָׁלוֹם אָהֳלֶךָ וּפָקַדְתָּ נָוְךָ וְלֹא תֶחֱטָא׃

verses.english: You will know that your offspring are many, and your descendants like the grass of the earth.
verses.hebrew: וְיָדַעְתָּ כִּי־רַב זַרְעֶךָ וְצֶאֱצָאֶיךָ כְּעֵשֶׂב הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: You will come to the grave in full vigor, like a stack of grain brought up in its season.
verses.hebrew: תָּבוֹא בְכֶלַח אֱלֵי־קָבֶר כַּעֲלוֹת גָּדִישׁ בְּעִתּוֹ׃

verses.english: Look, we have examined this; so it is. Hear it, and know it for yourself.”
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה־זֹאת חֲקַרְנוּהָ כֶּן־הִיא שְׁמָעֶנָּה וְאַתָּה דַע־לָךְ׃

verses.english: Job answered and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “If only my vexation were fully weighed, and my calamity placed with it in the scales!
verses.hebrew: לוּ שָׁקוֹל יִשָּׁקֵל כַּעְשִׂי והיתי [וְהַוָּתִי] בְּמֹאזְנַיִם יִשְׂאוּ־יָחַד׃

verses.english: For now it would outweigh the sand of the seas; therefore my words have been rash.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־עַתָּה מֵחוֹל יַמִּים יִכְבָּד עַל־כֵּן דְּבָרַי לָעוּ׃

verses.english: For Shaddai’s arrows are within me; my spirit drinks their poison. God’s terrors array themselves against me.
verses.hebrew: כִּי חִצֵּי שַׁדַּי עִמָּדִי אֲשֶׁר חֲמָתָם שֹׁתָה רוּחִי בִּעוּתֵי אֱלוֹהַּ יַעַרְכוּנִי׃

verses.english: Does a wild donkey bray over grass, or an ox low over its fodder?
verses.hebrew: הֲיִנְהַק־פֶּרֶא עֲלֵי־דֶשֶׁא אִם יִגְעֶה־שּׁוֹר עַל־בְּלִילוֹ׃

verses.english: Can something tasteless be eaten without salt? Is there flavor in the slime of mallow?
verses.hebrew: הֲיֵאָכֵל תָּפֵל מִבְּלִי־מֶלַח אִם־יֶשׁ־טַעַם בְּרִיר חַלָּמוּת׃

verses.english: My appetite refuses to touch them; they are like loathsome food to me.
verses.hebrew: מֵאֲנָה לִנְגּוֹעַ נַפְשִׁי הֵמָּה כִּדְוֵי לַחְמִי׃

verses.english: If only my request would come to pass, and God would grant my hope!
verses.hebrew: מִי־יִתֵּן תָּבוֹא שֶׁאֱלָתִי וְתִקְוָתִי יִתֵּן אֱלוֹהַּ׃

verses.english: If only God would be willing to crush me, loose His hand and cut me off!
verses.hebrew: וְיֹאֵל אֱלוֹהַּ וִידַכְּאֵנִי יַתֵּר יָדוֹ וִיבַצְּעֵנִי׃

verses.english: Then this would still be my consolation— I would leap in anguish that does not spare— for I have not denied the words of the Holy One.
verses.hebrew: וּתְהִי עוֹד נֶחָמָתִי וַאֲסַלְּדָה בְחִילָה לֹא יַחְמוֹל כִּי־לֹא כִחַדְתִּי אִמְרֵי קָדוֹשׁ׃

verses.english: What is my strength, that I should wait? What is my end, that I should prolong my life?
verses.hebrew: מַה־כֹּחִי כִי־אֲיַחֵל וּמַה־קִּצִּי כִּי־אַאֲרִיךְ נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: Is my strength the strength of stones? Is my flesh bronze?
verses.hebrew: אִם־כֹּחַ אֲבָנִים כֹּחִי אִם־בְּשָׂרִי נָחוּשׁ׃

verses.english: Is not my help within me gone, and resourcefulness driven away from me?
verses.hebrew: הַאִם אֵין עֶזְרָתִי בִי וְתֻשִׁיָּה נִדְּחָה מִמֶּנִּי׃

verses.english: The one who is wasting away deserves loyalty from his friend, even if he forsakes the fear of Shaddai.
verses.hebrew: לַמָּס מֵרֵעֵהוּ חָסֶד וְיִרְאַת שַׁדַּי יַעֲזוֹב׃

verses.english: My brothers have acted treacherously like a stream, like channels of streams that pass away,
verses.hebrew: אַחַי בָּגְדוּ כְמוֹ־נָחַל כַּאֲפִיק נְחָלִים יַעֲבֹרוּ׃

verses.english: darkened by ice, with snow hiding itself upon them.
verses.hebrew: הַקֹּדְרִים מִנִּי־קָרַח עָלֵימוֹ יִתְעַלֶּם־שָׁלֶג׃

verses.english: When they grow warm they vanish; when it is hot they are extinguished from their place.
verses.hebrew: בְּעֵת יְזֹרְבוּ נִצְמָתוּ בְּחֻמּוֹ נִדְעֲכוּ מִמְּקוֹמָם׃

verses.english: Caravans turn aside from their route; they go up into wasteland and perish.
verses.hebrew: הִבִּיטוּ אָרְחוֹת תֵּמָא הֲלִיכֹת שְׁבָא קִוּוּ־לָמוֹ׃

verses.english: The caravans of Tema look; the travelers of Sheba hope for them.
verses.hebrew: הִבִּיטוּ אָרְחוֹת תֵּמָא הֲלִיכֹת שְׁבָא קִוּוּ־לָמוֹ׃

verses.english: They are ashamed because they trusted; they come there and are confounded.
verses.hebrew: בֹּשׁוּ כִּי־בָטָח בָּאוּ עָדֶיהָ וַיֶּחְפָּרוּ׃

verses.english: For now you have become nothing; you see a terror and are afraid.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־עַתָּה הֱיִיתֶם לא [לוֹ] תִּרְאוּ חֲתַת וַתִּירָאוּ׃

verses.english: Did I say, ‘Give me something, and from your wealth make a gift on my behalf,
verses.hebrew: הֲ‍כִי־אָמַרְתִּי הָבוּ לִי וּמִכֹּחֲכֶם שִׁחֲדוּ בַעֲדִי׃

verses.english: rescue me from an adversary’s hand, and redeem me from the hand of ruthless men’?
verses.hebrew: וּמַלְּטוּנִי מִיַּד־צָר וּמִיַּד עָרִיצִים תִּפְדּוּנִי׃

verses.english: Teach me, and I will be silent; make me understand where I have gone astray.
verses.hebrew: הוֹרוּנִי וַאֲנִי אַחֲרִישׁ וּמַה־שָּׁגִיתִי הָבִינוּ לִי׃

verses.english: How forceful are upright words! But what does your reproof prove?
verses.hebrew: מַה־נִּמְרְצוּ אִמְרֵי־יֹשֶׁר וּמַה־יּוֹכִיחַ הוֹכֵחַ מִכֶּם׃

verses.english: Do you intend to reprove words, when a desperate person’s words are wind?
verses.hebrew: הַלְהוֹכַח מִלִּים תַּחְשֹׁבוּ וּלְרוּחַ אִמְרֵי נֹאָשׁ׃

verses.english: You would even cast lots over an orphan and bargain over your friend.
verses.hebrew: אַף־עַל־יָתוֹם תַּפִּילוּ וְתִכְרוּ עַל־רֵיעֲכֶם׃

verses.english: Now, please turn toward me; I surely will not lie to your faces.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הוֹאִילוּ פְנוּ־בִי וְעַל־פְּנֵיכֶם אִם־אֲכַזֵּב׃

verses.english: Turn back, please; let there be no injustice. Turn back again; my righteousness is in this.
verses.hebrew: שֻׁבוּ־נָא אַל־תְּהִי עַוְלָה ושבי [וְשׁוּבוּ] עוֹד צִדְקִי־בָהּ׃

verses.english: Is there injustice on my tongue? Can my palate not discern calamities?
verses.hebrew: הֲיֵשׁ־בִּלְשׁוֹנִי עַוְלָה אִם־חִכִּי לֹא־יָבִין הַוּוֹת׃

verses.english: “Is not a mortal’s life on earth hard service, and his days like a hired worker’s days?
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־צָבָא לֶאֱנוֹשׁ על־[עֲלֵי־] אָרֶץ וְכִימֵי שָׂכִיר יָמָיו׃

verses.english: Like a slave who pants for shade, and a hired worker who waits for his wages,
verses.hebrew: כְּעֶבֶד יִשְׁאַף־צֵל וּכְשָׂכִיר יְקַוֶּה פָעֳלוֹ׃

verses.english: so I have been allotted months of emptiness, and nights of trouble have been assigned to me.
verses.hebrew: כֵּן הָנְחַלְתִּי לִי יַרְחֵי־שָׁוְא וְלֵילוֹת עָמָל מִנּוּ־לִי׃

verses.english: When I lie down, I say, ‘When will I rise?’ The night stretches on, and I am full of tossing until dawn.
verses.hebrew: אִם־שָׁכַבְתִּי וְאָמַרְתִּי מָתַי אָקוּם וּמִדַּד־עָרֶב וְשָׂבַעְתִּי נְדֻדִים עֲדֵי־נָשֶׁף׃

verses.english: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin hardens and breaks out again.
verses.hebrew: לָבַשׁ בְּשָׂרִי רִמָּה וגיש [וְגוּשׁ] עָפָר עוֹרִי רָגַע וַיִּמָּאֵס׃

verses.english: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle and come to an end without hope.
verses.hebrew: יָמַי קַלּוּ מִנִּי־אָרֶג וַיִּכְלוּ בְּאֶפֶס תִּקְוָה׃

verses.english: Remember that my life is wind; my eye will not again see good.
verses.hebrew: זְכֹר כִּי־רוּחַ חַיָּי לֹא־תָשׁוּב עֵינִי לִרְאוֹת טוֹב׃

verses.english: The eye of the one who sees me will behold me no more; Your eyes will be upon me, but I will be gone.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־תְשׁוּרֵנִי עֵין רֹאִי עֵינֶיךָ בִּי וְאֵינֶנִּי׃

verses.english: A cloud is spent and goes away; so one who goes down to Sheol will not come up.
verses.hebrew: כָּלָה עָנָן וַיֵּלַךְ כֵּן יוֹרֵד שְׁאוֹל לֹא יַעֲלֶה׃

verses.english: He will not return again to his house, and his place will recognize him no more.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יָשׁוּב עוֹד לְבֵיתוֹ וְלֹא־יַכִּירֶנּוּ עוֹד מְקֹמוֹ׃

verses.english: So I too will not restrain my mouth; I will speak in the distress of my spirit, I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־אֲנִי לֹא אֶחֱשָׂךְ פִּי אֲ‍דַבְּרָה בְּצַר רוּחִי אָשִׂיחָה בְּמַר נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: Am I the sea, or a sea monster, that You set a guard over me?
verses.hebrew: הֲ‍יָם־אָנִי אִם־תַּנִּין כִּי־תָשִׂים עָלַי מִשְׁמָר׃

verses.english: When I say, ‘My couch will comfort me; my bed will bear my complaint,’
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אָמַרְתִּי תְּנַחֲמֵנִי עַרְשִׂי יִשָּׂא בְשִׂיחִי מִשְׁכָּבִי׃

verses.english: then You frighten me with dreams and terrify me with visions,
verses.hebrew: וְחִתַּתַּנִי בַחֲלֹמוֹת וּמֵחֶזְיֹנוֹת תְּבַעֲתַנִּי׃

verses.english: so that my soul would choose strangling, death rather than these bones of mine.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּבְחַר מַחֲנָק נַפְשִׁי מָוֶת מֵעַצְמוֹתָי׃

verses.english: I reject life; I would not live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are vapor.
verses.hebrew: מָאַסְתִּי לֹא־לְעֹלָם אֶחְיֶה חֲדַל מִמֶּנִּי כִּי־הֶבֶל יָמָי׃

verses.english: What is a mortal, that You make so much of him, that You set Your heart on him,
verses.hebrew: מָה־אֱנוֹשׁ כִּי תְגַדְּלֶנּוּ וְכִי־תָשִׁית אֵלָיו לִבֶּךָ׃

verses.english: that You visit him every morning and test him every moment?
verses.hebrew: וַתִּפְקְדֶנּוּ לִבְקָרִים לִרְגָעִים תִּבְחָנֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: How long will You not look away from me, nor let me alone until I swallow my saliva?
verses.hebrew: כַּמָּה לֹא־תִשְׁעֶה מִמֶּנִּי לֹא־תַרְפֵּנִי עַד־בִּלְעִי רֻקִּי׃

verses.english: I have sinned—what have I done to You, Watcher of humanity? Why have You made me Your target, so that I am a burden to myself?
verses.hebrew: חָטָאתִי מָה אֶפְעַל לָךְ נֹצֵר הָאָדָם לָמָה שַׂמְתַּנִי לְמִפְגָּע לָךְ וָאֶהְיֶה עָלַי לְמַשָּׂא׃

verses.english: Why do You not lift away my transgression and pass over my guilt? For now I will lie down in dust; You will seek me, but I will be gone.”
verses.hebrew: וּמֶה לֹא־תִשָּׂא פִשְׁעִי וְתַעֲבִיר אֶת־עֲוֺנִי כִּי־עַתָּה לֶעָפָר אֶשְׁכָּב וְשִׁחֲרְתַּנִי וְאֵינֶנִּי׃

verses.english: Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן בִּלְדַּד הַשּׁוּחִי וַיֹאמַר׃

verses.english: “How long will you speak these things, the words of your mouth a mighty wind?
verses.hebrew: עַד־אָן תְּמַלֶּל־אֵלֶּה וְרוּחַ כַּבִּיר אִמְרֵי־פִיךָ׃

verses.english: Does God pervert judgment? Does Shaddai pervert righteousness?
verses.hebrew: הַאֵל יְעַוֵּת מִשְׁפָּט וְאִם־שַׁדַּי יְעַוֵּת־צֶדֶק׃

verses.english: If your children sinned against Him, He handed them over to the power of their transgression.
verses.hebrew: אִם־בָּנֶיךָ חָטְאוּ־לוֹ וַיְשַׁלְּחֵם בְּיַד־פִּשְׁעָם׃

verses.english: If you earnestly seek God and plead for favor with Shaddai,
verses.hebrew: אִם־אַתָּה תְּשַׁחֵר אֶל־אֵל וְאֶל־שַׁדַּי תִּתְחַנָּן׃

verses.english: if you are pure and upright, then surely He will rouse Himself for you and restore your righteous dwelling.
verses.hebrew: אִם־זַךְ וְיָשָׁר אָתָּה כִּי־עַתָּה יָעִיר עָלֶיךָ וְשִׁלַּם נְוַת צִדְקֶךָ׃

verses.english: Your beginning may be small, but your latter state will grow greatly.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה רֵאשִׁיתְךָ מִצְעָר וְאַחֲרִיתְךָ יִשְׂגֶּה מְאֹד׃

verses.english: For ask the former generation, and apply yourself to what their fathers searched out.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־שְׁאַל־נָא לְדֹר רִישׁוֹן וְכוֹנֵן לְחֵקֶר אֲבוֹתָם׃

verses.english: For we are only of yesterday and know nothing; our days on earth are a shadow.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־תְמוֹל אֲנַחְנוּ וְלֹא נֵדָע כִּי צֵל יָמֵינוּ עֲלֵי־אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Will they not teach you and tell you, and bring forth words from their heart?
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־הֵם יוֹרוּךָ יֹאמְרוּ לָךְ וּמִלִּבָּם יוֹצִאוּ מִלִּים׃

verses.english: Can papyrus grow tall without a marsh? Can reeds flourish without water?
verses.hebrew: הֲיִגְאֶה־גֹּמֶא בְּלֹא בִצָּה יִשְׂגֶּה־אָחוּ בְלִי־מָיִם׃

verses.english: While it is still fresh and uncut, it withers before all other grass.
verses.hebrew: עֹדֶנּוּ בְאִבּוֹ לֹא יִקָּטֵף וְלִפְנֵי כָל־חָצִיר יִיבָשׁ׃

verses.english: So are the paths of all who forget God; the hope of the godless will perish.
verses.hebrew: כֵּן אָרְחוֹת כָּל־שֹׁכְחֵי אֵל וְתִקְוַת חָנֵף תֹּאבֵד׃

verses.english: His confidence is cut off, and his trust is a spider’s house.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־יָקוֹט כִּסְלוֹ וּבֵית עַכָּבִישׁ מִבְטַחוֹ׃

verses.english: He leans on his house, but it does not stand; he grasps it, but it does not hold up.
verses.hebrew: יִשָּׁעֵן עַל־בֵּיתוֹ וְלֹא יַעֲמֹד יַחֲזִיק בּוֹ וְלֹא יָקוּם׃

verses.english: He is lush before the sun, and his shoots spread over his garden.
verses.hebrew: רָטֹב הוּא לִפְנֵי־שָׁמֶשׁ וְעַל גַּנָּתוֹ יֹנַקְתּוֹ תֵצֵא׃

verses.english: His roots interweave over a heap; he looks upon a house of stones.
verses.hebrew: עַל־גַּל שָׁרָשָׁיו יְסֻבָּכוּ בֵּית אֲבָנִים יֶחֱזֶה׃

verses.english: If he is swallowed up from his place, it disowns him: ‘I never saw you.’
verses.hebrew: אִם־יְבַלְּעֶנּוּ מִמְּקוֹמוֹ וְכִחֶשׁ בּוֹ לֹא רְאִיתִיךָ׃

verses.english: Look, that is the joy of his way; and others sprout from the dust.
verses.hebrew: הֶן־הוּא מְשׂוֹשׂ דַּרְכּוֹ וּמֵעָפָר אַחֵר יִצְמָחוּ׃

verses.english: Look, God will not reject the blameless, nor take evildoers by the hand.
verses.hebrew: הֶן־אֵל לֹא יִמְאַס־תָּם וְלֹא־יַחֲזִיק בְּיַד־מְרֵעִים׃

verses.english: He will yet fill your mouth with laughter, and your lips with a shout of joy.
verses.hebrew: עַד־יְמַלֵּה שְׂחוֹק פִּיךָ וּשְׂפָתֶיךָ תְרוּעָה׃

verses.english: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame, and the tent of the wicked will be no more.”
verses.hebrew: שֹׂנְאֶיךָ יִלְבְּשׁוּ־בֹשֶׁת וְאֹהֶל רְשָׁעִים אֵינֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: Job answered and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “Indeed, I know that it is so; but how can a mortal be right before God?
verses.hebrew: אָמְנָם יָדַעְתִּי כִי־כֵן וּמַה־יִּצְדַּק אֱנוֹשׁ עִם־אֵל׃

verses.english: If he wished to contend with Him, he could not answer Him once in a thousand.
verses.hebrew: אִם־יַחְפֹּץ לָרִיב עִמּוֹ לֹא־יַעֲנֶנּוּ אַחַת מִנִּי־אָלֶף׃

verses.english: Wise of heart and mighty in strength— who has hardened himself against Him and remained unharmed?
verses.hebrew: חֲכַם לֵבָב וְאַמִּיץ כֹּחַ מִי־הִקְשָׁה אֵלָיו וַיִּשְׁלָם׃

verses.english: He removes mountains without their knowing, He overturns them in His anger.
verses.hebrew: הַמַּעְתִּיק הָרִים וְלֹא יָדָעוּ אֲשֶׁר הֲפָכָם בְּאַפּוֹ׃

verses.english: He shakes the earth from its place, and its pillars tremble.
verses.hebrew: הַמַּרְגִּיז אֶרֶץ מִמְּקוֹמָהּ וְעַמּוּדֶיהָ יִתְפַלָּצוּן׃

verses.english: He speaks to the sun and it does not rise, and He seals up the stars.
verses.hebrew: הָאֹמֵר לַחֶרֶס וְלֹא יִזְרָח וּבְעַד כּוֹכָבִים יַחְתֹּם׃

verses.english: He alone stretches out the heavens and treads on the heights of the sea.
verses.hebrew: נֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם לְבַדּוֹ וְדוֹרֵךְ עַל־בָּמֳתֵי יָם׃

verses.english: He makes Ash, Kesil, and Kimah, and the chambers of the south.
verses.hebrew: עֹשֶׂה־עָשׁ כְּסִיל וְכִימָה וְחַדְרֵי תֵמָן׃

verses.english: He does great things beyond searching out, and wonders beyond numbering.
verses.hebrew: עֹשֶׂה גְדֹלוֹת עַד־אֵין חֵקֶר וְנִפְלָאוֹת עַד־אֵין מִסְפָּר׃

verses.english: Look, He passes by me, and I do not see; He moves past, and I do not perceive Him.
verses.hebrew: הֵן יַעֲבֹר עָלַי וְלֹא אֶרְאֶה וְיַחֲלֹף וְלֹא־אָבִין לוֹ׃

verses.english: Look, He snatches away—who can turn Him back? Who can say to Him, ‘What are You doing?’
verses.hebrew: הֵן יַחְתֹּף מִי יְשִׁיבֶנּוּ מִי־יֹאמַר אֵלָיו מַה־תַּעֲשֶׂה׃

verses.english: God will not turn back His anger; beneath Him Rahab’s helpers bow down.
verses.hebrew: אֱלוֹהַּ לֹא־יָשִׁיב אַפּוֹ תחתו [תַּחְתָּיו] שָׁחֲחוּ עֹזְרֵי רָהַב׃

verses.english: How much less could I answer Him and choose my words with Him?
verses.hebrew: אַף כִּי־אָנֹכִי אֶעֱנֶנּוּ אֶבְחֲרָה דְבָרַי עִמּוֹ׃

verses.english: Even if I were right, I could not answer; I would plead for mercy with my Judge.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר אִם־צָדַקְתִּי לֹא אֶעֱנֶה לִמְשֹׁפְטִי אֶתְחַנָּן׃

verses.english: If I called and He answered me, I would not believe that He was listening to my voice.
verses.hebrew: אִם־קָרָאתִי וַיַּעֲנֵנִי לֹא־אַאֲמִין כִּי־יַאֲזִין קוֹלִי׃

verses.english: For He crushes me with a storm and multiplies my wounds without cause.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־בִּשְׂעָרָה יְשׁוּפֵנִי וְהִרְבָּה פְצָעַי חִנָּם׃

verses.english: He will not let me recover my breath, but fills me with bitter things.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יִתְּנֵנִי הָשֵׁב רוּחִי כִּי יַשְׂבִּעַנִי מַמְּרֹרִים׃

verses.english: If it is a matter of strength, look, He is mighty! If of judgment, who will summon me?
verses.hebrew: אִם־לְכֹחַ אַמִּיץ הִנֵּה וְאִם־לְמִשְׁפָּט מִי יוֹעִידֵנִי׃

verses.english: Even if I am right, my mouth condemns me; though I am blameless, it makes me crooked.
verses.hebrew: אִם־אֶצְדָּק פִּי יַרְשִׁיעֵנִי תָּם־אָנִי וַיַּעְקְשֵׁנִי׃

verses.english: I am blameless; I do not regard my own life; I reject my life.
verses.hebrew: תָּם־אָנִי לֹא־אֵדַע נַפְשִׁי אֶמְאַס חַיָּי׃

verses.english: It is all one; therefore I say, ‘He destroys both the blameless and the wicked.’
verses.hebrew: אַחַת הִיא עַל־כֵּן אָמַרְתִּי תָּם וְרָשָׁע הוּא מְכַלֶּה׃

verses.english: If a scourge suddenly kills, He mocks the despair of the innocent.
verses.hebrew: אִם־שׁוֹט יָמִית פִּתְאֹם לְמַסַּת נְקִיִּם יִלְעָג׃

verses.english: The earth is given into a wicked person’s hand; He covers the faces of its judges. If it is not He, then who is it?
verses.hebrew: אֶרֶץ נִתְּנָה בְיַד־רָשָׁע פְּנֵי־שֹׁפְטֶיהָ יְכַסֶּה אִם־לֹא אֵפוֹא מִי־הוּא׃

verses.english: My days are swifter than a runner; they flee and see no good.
verses.hebrew: וְיָמַי קַלּוּ מִנִּי־רָץ בָּרְחוּ לֹא־רָאוּ טוֹבָה׃

verses.english: They pass by like reed boats, like an eagle swooping upon food.
verses.hebrew: חָלְפוּ עִם־אֳנִיּוֹת אֵבֶה כְּנֶשֶׁר יָטוּשׂ עֲלֵי־אֹכֶל׃

verses.english: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, leave my gloomy face and brighten up,’
verses.hebrew: אִם־אָמְרִי אֶשְׁכְּחָה שִׂיחִי אֶעֶזְבָה פָנַי וְאַבְלִיגָה׃

verses.english: I dread all my pains; I know that You will not acquit me.
verses.hebrew: יָגֹרְתִּי כָל־עַצְּבֹתָי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־לֹא תְנַקֵּנִי׃

verses.english: I will be declared guilty; why, then, should I toil in vain?
verses.hebrew: אָנֹכִי אֶרְשָׁע לָמָּה־זֶּה הֶבֶל אִיגָע׃

verses.english: If I wash myself with snow water and cleanse my hands with lye,
verses.hebrew: אִם־הִתְרָחַצְתִּי במו־[בְמֵי־] שָׁלֶג וַהֲזִכּוֹתִי בְּבֹר כַּפָּי׃

verses.english: then You would plunge me into a pit, and my own clothes would abhor me.
verses.hebrew: אָז בַּשַּׁחַת תִּטְבְּלֵנִי וְתִעֲבוּנִי שַׂלְמוֹתָי׃

verses.english: For He is not a man like me, that I could answer Him, that we could come together in judgment.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־לֹא־אִישׁ כָּמֹנִי אֶעֱנֶנּוּ נָבוֹא יַחְדָּו בַּמִּשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: There is no arbiter between us to lay his hand on both of us.
verses.hebrew: לֹא יֵשׁ־בֵּינֵינוּ מוֹכִיחַ יָשֵׁת יָדוֹ עַל־שְׁנֵינוּ׃

verses.english: Let Him remove His rod from me, and let His terror not frighten me.
verses.hebrew: יָסֵר מֵעָלַי שִׁבְטוֹ וְאֵמָתוֹ אַל־תְּבַעֲתַנִּי׃

verses.english: Then I would speak and not fear Him, for I am not so within myself.
verses.hebrew: אַדַבְּרָה וְלֹא אִירָאֶנּוּ כִּי לֹא־כֵן אָנֹכִי עִמָּדִי׃

verses.english: “My soul loathes my life; I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.hebrew: נָקְטָה נַפְשִׁי בְּחַיָּי אֶעֶזְבָה עָלַי שִׂיחִי אֲדַבְּרָה בְּמַר נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: I will say to God, ‘Do not condemn me; make me know why You contend with me.
verses.hebrew: אֹמַר אֶל־אֱלוֹהַּ אַל־תַּרְשִׁיעֵנִי הוֹדִיעֵנִי עַל מַה־תְּרִיבֵנִי׃

verses.english: Does it seem good to You to oppress, to reject the work of Your hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked?
verses.hebrew: הֲטוֹב לְךָ כִּי־תַעֲשֹׁק כִּי־תִמְאַס יְגִיעַ כַּפֶּיךָ וְעַל־עֲצַת רְשָׁעִים הוֹפָעְתָּ׃

verses.english: Do You have eyes of flesh? Do You see as a mortal sees?
verses.hebrew: הַעֵינֵי בָשָׂר לָךְ אִם־כִּרְאוֹת אֱנוֹשׁ תִּרְאֶה׃

verses.english: Are Your days like a mortal’s days, or Your years like a man’s days,
verses.hebrew: הֲכִימֵי אֱנוֹשׁ יָמֶיךָ אִם־שְׁנוֹתֶיךָ כִּימֵי גָבֶר׃

verses.english: that You seek my guilt and search for my sin,
verses.hebrew: כִּי־תְבַקֵּשׁ לַעֲוֺנִי וּלְחַטָּאתִי תִדְרוֹשׁ׃

verses.english: although You know that I am not wicked, and no one can rescue me from Your hand?
verses.hebrew: עַל־דַּעְתְּךָ כִּי־לֹא אֶרְשָׁע וְאֵין מִיָּדְךָ מַצִּיל׃

verses.english: Your hands shaped me and made me, all of me, on every side—yet You swallow me up!
verses.hebrew: יָדֶיךָ עִצְּבוּנִי וַיַּעֲשׂוּנִי יַחַד סָבִיב וַתְּבַלְּעֵנִי׃

verses.english: Remember, please, that You made me like clay; will You return me to dust?
verses.hebrew: זְכָר־נָא כִּי־כַחֹמֶר עֲשִׂיתָנִי וְאֶל־עָפָר תְּשִׁיבֵנִי׃

verses.english: Did You not pour me out like milk and curdle me like cheese?
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא כֶחָלָב תַּתִּיכֵנִי וְכַגְּבִנָּה תַּקְפִּיאֵנִי׃

verses.english: You clothed me with skin and flesh and wove me together with bones and sinews.
verses.hebrew: עוֹר וּבָשָׂר תַּלְבִּישֵׁנִי וּבַעֲצָמוֹת וְגִידִים תְּסֹכְכֵנִי׃

verses.english: You granted me life and loyal kindness, and Your care guarded my spirit.
verses.hebrew: חַיִּים וָחֶסֶד עָשִׂיתָ עִמָּדִי וּפְקֻדָּתְךָ שָׁמְרָה רוּחִי׃

verses.english: Yet these things You hid in Your heart; I know that this was with You.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה צָפַנְתָּ בִלְבָבֶךָ יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־זֹאת עִמָּךְ׃

verses.english: If I sin, You watch me and will not acquit me of my guilt.
verses.hebrew: אִם־חָטָאתִי וּשְׁמַרְתָּנִי וּמֵעֲוֺנִי לֹא תְנַקֵּנִי׃

verses.english: If I am wicked, woe to me! If I am righteous, I cannot lift my head, full of disgrace—look upon my affliction!
verses.hebrew: אִם־רָשַׁעְתִּי אַלְלַי לִי וְצָדַקְתִּי לֹא־אֶשָּׂא רֹאשִׁי שְׂבַע קָלוֹן וּרְאֵה עָנְיִי׃

verses.english: If my head rises, You hunt me like a lion and again show Your wonders against me.
verses.hebrew: וְיִגְאֶה כַּשַּׁחַל תְּצוּדֵנִי וְתָשֹׁב תִּתְפַּלָּא־בִי׃

verses.english: You renew Your witnesses against me and increase Your vexation toward me; fresh forces and an army are against me.
verses.hebrew: תְּחַדֵּשׁ עֵדֶיךָ נֶגְדִּי וְתֶרֶב כַּעַשְׂךָ עִמָּדִי חֲלִיפוֹת וְצָבָא עִמִּי׃

verses.english: Why did You bring me out of the womb? If only I had expired before any eye saw me!
verses.hebrew: וְלָמָּה מֵרֶחֶם הֹצֵאתָנִי אֶגְוַע וְעַיִן לֹא־תִרְאֵנִי׃

verses.english: I would have been as though I had not existed, carried from the womb to the grave.
verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר לֹא־הָיִיתִי אֶהְיֶה מִבֶּטֶן לַקֶּבֶר אוּבָל׃

verses.english: Are not my days few? Let Him cease; let Him turn away from me, so that I may brighten a little,
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־מְעַט יָמַי יחדל [וַחֲדָל] ישית [וְשִׁית] מִמֶּנִּי וְאַבְלִיגָה מְּעָט׃

verses.english: before I go and do not return to a land of darkness and death’s shadow,
verses.hebrew: בְּטֶרֶם אֵלֵךְ וְלֹא אָשׁוּב אֶל־אֶרֶץ חֹשֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָוֶת׃

verses.english: a land of dimness like thick darkness, of death’s shadow and disorder, where even the light is like thick darkness.’”
verses.hebrew: אֶרֶץ עֵיפָתָה כְּמוֹ אֹפֶל צַלְמָוֶת וְלֹא סְדָרִים וַתֹּפַע כְּמוֹ־אֹפֶל׃

verses.english: Zophar the Naamathite answered and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן צֹפַר הַנַּעֲמָתִי וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “Should a multitude of words go unanswered, and should a man of many lips be declared right?
verses.hebrew: הֲרֹב דְּבָרִים לֹא יֵעָנֶה וְאִם־אִישׁ שְׂפָתַיִם יִצְדָּק׃

verses.english: Will your empty talk silence people? Will you mock, with no one putting you to shame?
verses.hebrew: בַּדֶּיךָ מְתִים יַחֲרִישׁו וַתִּלְעַג וְאֵין מַכְלִם׃

verses.english: You say, ‘My teaching is pure, and I am clean in Your eyes.’
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר זַךְ לִקְחִי וּבַר הָיִיתִי בְעֵינֶיךָ׃

verses.english: But if only God would speak and open His lips with you,
verses.hebrew: וְאוּלָם מִי־יִתֵּן אֱלוֹהַּ דַּבֵּר וְיִפְתַּח שְׂפָתָיו עִמָּךְ׃

verses.english: and tell you the hidden things of wisdom, for sound wisdom is twofold! Know that God overlooks some of your guilt.
verses.hebrew: וְיַגֶּד־לְךָ תַּעֲלֻמוֹת חָכְמָה כִּי־כִפְלַיִם לְתוּשִׁיָּה וְדַע כִּי־יַשֶּׁה לְךָ אֱלוֹהַ מֵעֲוֺנֶךָ׃

verses.english: Can you discover God by searching, or reach the full extent of Shaddai?
verses.hebrew: אִם־יַחֲלֹף וְיַסְגִּיר וְיַקְהִיל וּמִי יְשִׁיבֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: Higher than heaven—what can you do? Deeper than Sheol—what can you know?
verses.hebrew: גָּבְהֵי שָׁמַיִם מַה־תִּפְעָל עֲמֻקָּה מִשְּׁאוֹל מַה־תֵּדָע׃

verses.english: Its measure is longer than earth and broader than sea.
verses.hebrew: אֲרֻכָּה מֵאֶרֶץ מִדָּהּ וּרְחָבָה מִנִּי־יָם׃

verses.english: If He passes through, imprisons, and convenes an assembly, who can turn Him back?
verses.hebrew: אִם־יַחֲלֹף וְיַסְגִּיר וְיַקְהִיל וּמִי יְשִׁיבֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: For He knows worthless people; He sees wrongdoing—will He not consider it?
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הוּא יָדַע מְתֵי־שָׁוְא וַיַּרְא־אָוֶן וְלֹא יִתְבּוֹנָן׃

verses.english: An empty-headed man will gain a heart when a wild donkey’s colt is born human.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ נָבוּב יִלָּבֵב וְעַיִר פֶּרֶא אָדָם יִוָּלֵד׃

verses.english: If you prepare your heart and spread out your hands to Him,
verses.hebrew: אִם־אַתָּה הֲכִינוֹתָ לִבֶּךָ וּפָרַשְׂתָּ אֵלָיו כַּפֶּךָ׃

verses.english: if wrongdoing is in your hand, put it far away, and do not let injustice dwell in your tents,
verses.hebrew: אִם־אָוֶן בְּיָדְךָ הַרְחִיקֵהוּ וְאַל־תַּשְׁכֵּן בְּאֹהָלֶיךָ עַוְלָה׃

verses.english: then you will lift your face free from blemish; you will stand firm and not fear.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אָז תִּשָּׂא פָנֶיךָ מִמּוּם וְהָיִיתָ מֻצָק וְלֹא תִירָא׃

verses.english: For you will forget trouble; you will remember it like waters that have passed away.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה עָמָל תִּשְׁכָּח כְּמַיִם עָבְרוּ תִזְכֹּר׃

verses.english: Your life will rise brighter than noon; its darkness will be like morning.
verses.hebrew: וּמִצָּהֳרַיִם יָקוּם חָלֶד תָּעֻפָה כַּבֹּקֶר תִּהְיֶה׃

verses.english: You will be confident, for there is hope; you will search about and lie down safely.
verses.hebrew: וּבָטַחְתָּ כִּי־יֵשׁ תִּקְוָה וְחָפַרְתָּ לָבֶטַח תִּשְׁכָּב׃

verses.english: You will lie down, with no one to frighten you, and many will seek your favor.
verses.hebrew: וְרָבַצְתָּ וְאֵין מַחֲרִיד וְחִלּוּ פָנֶיךָ רַבִּים׃

verses.english: But the eyes of the wicked will fail; escape will be lost to them, and their hope will be the breathing out of life.”
verses.hebrew: וְעֵינֵי רְשָׁעִים תִּכְלֶינָה וּמָנוֹס אָבַד מִנְהֶם וְתִקְוָתָם מַפַּח־נָפֶשׁ׃

verses.english: Job answered and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “Indeed, you are the people, and wisdom will die with you!
verses.hebrew: אָמְנָם כִּי אַתֶּם־עָם וְעִמָּכֶם תָּמוּת חָכְמָה׃

verses.english: I too have understanding like you; I am not inferior to you. Who does not know such things?
verses.hebrew: גַּם־לִי לֵבָב כְּמוֹכֶם לֹא־נֹפֵל אָנֹכִי מִכֶּם וְאֶת־מִי־אֵין כְּמוֹ־אֵלֶּה׃

verses.english: I have become a laughingstock to my friend, one who called to God and received an answer— a righteous, blameless man made a laughingstock!
verses.hebrew: שְׂחֹק לְרֵעֵהוּ אֶהְיֶה קֹרֵא לֶאֱלוֹהַּ וַיַּעֲנֵהוּ שְׂחוֹק צַדִּיק תָּמִים׃

verses.english: In the thoughts of one at ease there is contempt for calamity; it is ready for those whose feet slip.
verses.hebrew: לַפִּיד בּוּז לְעַשְׁתּוּת שַׁאֲנָן נָכוֹן לְמוֹעֲדֵי רָגֶל׃

verses.english: The tents of raiders are at ease, and those who provoke God are secure— those into whose hand God brings it.
verses.hebrew: יִשְׁלָיוּ אֹהָלִים לְשֹׁדְדִים וּבַטֻּחוֹת לְמַרְגִּיזֵי אֵל לַאֲשֶׁר הֵבִיא אֱלוֹהַּ בְּיָדוֹ׃

verses.english: But ask the animals, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you;
verses.hebrew: וְאוּלָם שְׁאַל־נָא בְהֵמוֹת וְתֹרֶךָּ וְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וְיַגֶּד־לָךְ׃

verses.english: or speak to the earth, and it will teach you; the fish of the sea will recount it to you.
verses.hebrew: אוֹ שִׂיחַ לָאָרֶץ וְתֹרֶךָּ וִיסַפְּרוּ לְךָ דְּגֵי הַיָּם׃

verses.english: Who among all these does not know that the hand of YHWH has done this?
verses.hebrew: מִי לֹא־יָדַע בְּכָל־אֵלֶּה כִּי יַד־יְהוָה עָשְׂתָה זֹּאת׃

verses.english: In His hand is the life of every living thing and the breath of all human flesh.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדוֹ נֶפֶשׁ כָּל־חָי וְרוּחַ כָּל־בְּשַׂר־אִישׁ׃

verses.english: Does not the ear test words, and the palate taste food for itself?
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־אֹזֶן מִלִּין תִּבְחָן וְחֵךְ אֹכֶל יִטְעַם־לוֹ׃

verses.english: Wisdom is with the aged, and understanding with length of days.
verses.hebrew: בִּישִׁישִׁים חָכְמָה וְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים תְּבוּנָה׃

verses.english: With Him are wisdom and might; counsel and understanding belong to Him.
verses.hebrew: עִמּוֹ חָכְמָה וּגְבוּרָה לוֹ עֵצָה וּתְבוּנָה׃

verses.english: Look, He tears down, and it cannot be rebuilt; He shuts a man in, and it cannot be opened.
verses.hebrew: הֵן יַהֲרוֹס וְלֹא יִבָּנֶה יִסְגֹּר עַל־אִישׁ וְלֹא יִפָּתֵחַ׃

verses.english: Look, He restrains the waters, and they dry up; He sends them out, and they overturn the earth.
verses.hebrew: הֵן יַעְצֹר בַּמַּיִם וְיִבָשׁוּ וִישַׁלְּחֵם וְיַהַפְכוּ אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: With Him are strength and sound wisdom; the one who errs and the one who leads astray belong to Him.
verses.hebrew: עִמּוֹ עֹז וְתוּשִׁיָּה לוֹ שֹׁגֵג וּמַשְׁגֶּה׃

verses.english: He leads counselors away stripped and makes judges foolish.
verses.hebrew: מוֹלִיךְ יוֹעֲצִים שׁוֹלָל וְשֹׁפְטִים יְהוֹלֵל׃

verses.english: He loosens the bonds of kings and binds a belt around their waists.
verses.hebrew: מוּסַר מְלָכִים פִּתֵּחַ וַיֶּאְסֹר אֵזוֹר בְּמָתְנֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: He leads priests away stripped and overthrows the firmly established.
verses.hebrew: מוֹלִיךְ כֹּהֲנִים שׁוֹלָל וְאֵתָנִים יְסַלֵּף׃

verses.english: He takes speech away from the trusted and removes the elders’ discernment.
verses.hebrew: מֵסִיר שָׂפָה לְנֶאֱמָנִים וְטַעַם זְקֵנִים יִקָּח׃

verses.english: He pours contempt upon nobles and loosens the belt of the mighty.
verses.hebrew: שׁוֹפֵךְ בּוּז עַל־נְדִיבִים וּמְזִיחַ אֲפִיקִים רִפָּה׃

verses.english: He reveals deep things out of darkness and brings death’s shadow into light.
verses.hebrew: מְגַלֶּה עֲמֻקוֹת מִנִּי־חֹשֶׁךְ וַיֹּצֵא לָאוֹר צַלְמָוֶת׃

verses.english: He makes nations great and destroys them; He spreads nations out and leads them.
verses.hebrew: מַשְׂגִּיא לַגּוֹיִם וַיְאַבְּדֵם שֹׁטֵחַ לַגּוֹיִם וַיַּנְחֵם׃

verses.english: He takes understanding away from the heads of the people of the earth and makes them wander in a wasteland without a road.
verses.hebrew: מֵסִיר לֵב רָאשֵׁי עַם־הָאָרֶץ וַיַּתְעֵם בְּתֹהוּ לֹא־דָרֶךְ׃

verses.english: They grope in darkness without light, and He makes them stagger like a drunkard.
verses.hebrew: יְמַשְׁשׁוּ־חֹשֶׁךְ וְלֹא־אוֹר וַיַּתְעֵם כַּשִּׁכּוֹר׃

verses.english: “Look, my eye has seen all this; my ear has heard and understood it.
verses.hebrew: הֶן־כֹּל רָאֲתָה עֵינִי שָׁמְעָה אָזְנִי וַתָּבֶן לָהּ׃

verses.english: What you know, I too know; I am not inferior to you.
verses.hebrew: כְּדַעְתְּכֶם יָדַעְתִּי גַם־אָנִי לֹא־נֹפֵל אָנֹכִי מִכֶּם׃

verses.english: But I would speak to Shaddai; I desire to argue my case with God.
verses.hebrew: אוּלָם אֲנִי אֶל־שַׁדַּי אֲדַבֵּר וְהוֹכֵחַ אֶל־אֵל אֶחְפָּץ׃

verses.english: But you are plasterers of falsehood, worthless physicians, all of you.
verses.hebrew: וְאוּלָם אַתֶּם טֹפְלֵי־שָׁקֶר רֹפְאֵי אֱלִל כֻּלְּכֶם׃

verses.english: If only you would keep completely silent! That would count as wisdom for you.
verses.hebrew: מִי־יִתֵּן הַחֲרֵשׁ תַּחֲרִישׁוּן וּתְהִי לָכֶם לְחָכְמָה׃

verses.english: Hear now my argument, and attend to the contentions of my lips.
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ־נָא תוֹכַחְתִּי וְרִבוֹת שְׂפָתַי הַקְשִׁיבוּ׃

verses.english: Will you speak injustice for God, and speak deceit on His behalf?
verses.hebrew: הַלְאֵל תְּדַבְּרוּ עַוְלָה וְלוֹ תְּדַבְּרוּ רְמִיָּה׃

verses.english: Will you show Him partiality? Will you contend for God?
verses.hebrew: הֲפָנָיו תִּשָּׂאוּן אִם־לָאֵל תְּרִיבוּן׃

verses.english: Will it be good when He examines you? Can you deceive Him as one deceives a mortal?
verses.hebrew: הֲטוֹב כִּי־יַחְקֹר אֶתְכֶם אִם־כְּהָתֵל בֶּאֱנוֹשׁ תְּהָתֵלּוּ בוֹ׃

verses.english: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.
verses.hebrew: הוֹכֵחַ יוֹכִיחַ אֶתְכֶם אִם־בַּסֵּתֶר פָּנִים תִּשָּׂאוּן׃

verses.english: Will not His majesty terrify you, and His dread fall upon you?
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא שְׂאֵתוֹ תְּבַעֵת אֶתְכֶם וּפַחְדּוֹ יִפֹּל עֲלֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes; your defenses are defenses of clay.
verses.hebrew: זִכְרֹנֵיכֶם מִשְׁלֵי־אֵפֶר לְגַבֵּי־חֹמֶר גַּבֵּיכֶם׃

verses.english: Be silent before me, and let me speak; let whatever may come pass over me.
verses.hebrew: הַחֲרִישׁוּ מִמֶּנִּי וַאֲדַבְּרָה־אָנִי וְיַעֲבֹר עָלַי מָה׃

verses.english: Why should I carry my flesh in my teeth and put my life in my hand?
verses.hebrew: עַל־מָה אֶשָּׂא בְשָׂרִי בְשִׁנָּי וְנַפְשִׁי אָשִׂים בְּכַפִּי׃

verses.english: Look, He may kill me; I have no hope. Yet I will argue my ways before Him.
verses.hebrew: הֵן יִקְטְלֵנִי לא [לוֹ] אֲיַחֵל אַךְ־דְּרָכַי אֶל־פָּנָיו אוֹכִיחַ׃

verses.english: This too will be my deliverance, for a godless person will not come before Him.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־הוּא־לִי לִישׁוּעָה כִּי־לֹא לְפָנָיו חָנֵף יָבוֹא׃

verses.english: Listen carefully to my word, and let my declaration be in your ears.
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ שָׁמוֹעַ מִלָּתִי וְאַחֲוָתִי בְּאָזְנֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: Look now, I have arranged my case; I know that I will be vindicated.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה־נָא עָרַכְתִּי מִשְׁפָּט יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־אֲנִי אֶצְדָּק׃

verses.english: Who is there to contend with me? For then I would be silent and expire.
verses.hebrew: מִי־הוּא יָרִיב עִמָּדִי כִּי־עַתָּה אַחֲרִישׁ וְאֶגְוָע׃

verses.english: Only do not do two things to me; then I will not hide from Your presence:
verses.hebrew: אַךְ־שְׁתַּיִם אַל־תַּעַשׂ עִמָּדִי אָז מִפָּנֶיךָ לֹא אֶסָּתֵר׃

verses.english: remove Your hand far from me, and do not let Your terror frighten me.
verses.hebrew: כַּפְּךָ מֵעָלַי הַרְחַק וְאֵמָתְךָ אַל־תְּבַעֲתַנִּי׃

verses.english: Then call, and I will answer; or let me speak, and answer me.
verses.hebrew: וּקְרָא וְאָנֹכִי אֶעֱנֶה אוֹ־אֲדַבֵּר וַהֲשִׁיבֵנִי׃

verses.english: How many are my wrongdoings and sins? Make me know my transgression and my sin.
verses.hebrew: כַּמָּה לִי עֲוֺנוֹת וְחַטָּאוֹת פִּשְׁעִי וְחַטָּאתִי הֹדִיעֵנִי׃

verses.english: Why do You hide Your face and consider me Your enemy?
verses.hebrew: לָמָּה־פָנֶיךָ תַסְתִּיר וְתַחְשְׁבֵנִי לְאוֹיֵב לָךְ׃

verses.english: Will You terrify a windblown leaf and pursue dry stubble?
verses.hebrew: הֶעָלֶה נִדָּף תַּעֲרוֹץ וְאֶת־קַשׁ יָבֵשׁ תִּרְדֹּף׃

verses.english: For You write bitter things against me and make me inherit the wrongdoings of my youth.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־תִכְתֹּב עָלַי מְרֹרוֹת וְתוֹרִישֵׁנִי עֲוֺנוֹת נְעוּרָי׃

verses.english: You put my feet in the stocks and watch all my paths; You mark out the soles of my feet.
verses.hebrew: וְתָשֵׂם בַּסַּד רַגְלַי וְתִשְׁמוֹר כָּל־אָרְחוֹתָי עַל־שָׁרְשֵׁי רַגְלַי תִּתְחַקֶּה׃

verses.english: And he wears away like something rotten, like a garment eaten by moths.
verses.hebrew: וְהוּא כְּרָקָב יִבְלֶה כְּבֶגֶד אֲכָלוֹ עָשׁ׃

verses.english: “A human being born of woman is short of days and full of turmoil.
verses.hebrew: אָדָם יְלוּד אִשָּׁה קְצַר יָמִים וּשְׂבַע־רֹגֶז׃

verses.english: He comes out like a flower and withers; he flees like a shadow and does not remain.
verses.hebrew: כְּצִיץ יָצָא וַיִּמָּל וַיִּבְרַח כַּצֵּל וְלֹא יַעֲמוֹד׃

verses.english: Even upon such a one You open Your eyes, and You bring me into judgment with You!
verses.hebrew: אַף־עַל־זֶה פָּקַחְתָּ עֵינֶךָ וְאֹתִי תָבִיא בְמִשְׁפָּט עִמָּךְ׃

verses.english: Who can bring something clean from the unclean? Not one.
verses.hebrew: מִי־יִתֵּן טָהוֹר מִטָּמֵא לֹא אֶחָד׃

verses.english: If his days are determined, the number of his months is with You; You have made his limit, and he cannot pass it.
verses.hebrew: אִם חֲרוּצִים יָמָיו מִסְפַּר־חֳדָשָׁיו אִתָּךְ חקו [חֻקָּיו] עָשִׂיתָ וְלֹא יַעֲבוֹר׃

verses.english: Look away from him, so that he may cease, until he enjoys his day like a hired worker.
verses.hebrew: שְׁעֵה מֵעָלָיו וְיֶחְדָּל עַד־יִרְצֶה כְּשָׂכִיר יוֹמוֹ׃

verses.english: For a tree has hope: if it is cut down, it will sprout again, and its shoot will not cease.
verses.hebrew: כִּי יֵשׁ לָעֵץ תִּקְוָה אִם־יִכָּרֵת וְעוֹד יַחֲלִיף וְיֹנַקְתּוֹ לֹא תֶחְדָּל׃

verses.english: Though its root grows old in the earth and its stump dies in the dust,
verses.hebrew: אִם־יַזְקִין בָּאָרֶץ שָׁרְשׁוֹ וּבֶעָפָר יָמוּת גִּזְעוֹ׃

verses.english: at the scent of water it will bud and make branches like a newly planted tree.
verses.hebrew: מֵרֵיחַ מַיִם יַפְרִחַ וְעָשָׂה קָצִיר כְּמוֹ־נָטַע׃

verses.english: But a man dies and lies powerless; a human being expires, and where is he?
verses.hebrew: וְגֶבֶר יָמוּת וַיֶּחֱלָשׁ וַיִּגְוַע אָדָם וְאַיּוֹ׃

verses.english: Waters depart from a sea, and a river becomes parched and dry;
verses.hebrew: אָזְלוּ־מַיִם מִנִּי־יָם וְנָהָר יֶחֱרַב וְיָבֵשׁ׃

verses.english: so a man lies down and does not rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake nor be roused from their sleep.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ שָׁכַב וְלֹא־יָקוּם עַד־בִּלְתִּי שָׁמַיִם לֹא יָקִיצוּ וְלֹא־יֵעֹרוּ מִשְּׁנָתָם׃

verses.english: If only You would hide me in Sheol, conceal me until Your anger turns back, set a limit for me and remember me!
verses.hebrew: מִי יִתֵּן בִּשְׁאוֹל תַּצְפִּנֵנִי תַּסְתִּירֵנִי עַד־שׁוּב אַפֶּךָ תָּשִׁית לִי חֹק וְתִזְכְּרֵנִי׃

verses.english: If a man dies, will he live? All the days of my service I would wait until my renewal came.
verses.hebrew: אִם־יָמוּת גֶּבֶר הֲיִחְיֶה כָּל־יְמֵי צְבָאִי אֲיַחֵל עַד־בּוֹא חֲלִיפָתִי׃

verses.english: You would call, and I would answer You; You would long for the work of Your hands.
verses.hebrew: תִּקְרָא וְאָנֹכִי אֶעֱנֶךָּ לְמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ תִכְסֹף׃

verses.english: For now You count my steps; You do not watch over my sin.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־עַתָּה צְעָדַי תִּסְפּוֹר לֹא־תִשְׁמוֹר עַל־חַטָּאתִי׃

verses.english: My transgression is sealed in a bundle, and You plaster over my guilt.
verses.hebrew: חָתֻם בִּצְרוֹר פִּשְׁעִי וַתִּטְפֹּל עַל־עֲוֺנִי׃

verses.english: But a falling mountain crumbles, and a rock is moved from its place;
verses.hebrew: וְאוּלָם הַר־נוֹפֵל יִבּוֹל וְצוּר יֶעְתַּק מִמְּקֹמוֹ׃

verses.english: waters wear away stones; their outpourings wash away the earth’s dust, and You destroy a mortal’s hope.
verses.hebrew: אֲבָנִים שָׁחֲקוּ מַיִם תִּשְׁטֹף־סְפִיחֶיהָ עֲפַר־אָרֶץ וְתִקְוַת אֱנוֹשׁ הֶאֱבַדְתָּ׃

verses.english: You overpower him forever, and he goes away; You change his face and send him off.
verses.hebrew: תִּתְקְפֵהוּ לָנֶצַח וַיַּהֲלֹךְ מְשַׁנֶּה פָנָיו וַתְּשַׁלְּחֵהוּ׃

verses.english: His sons are honored, and he does not know; they are brought low, and he does not perceive it.
verses.hebrew: יִכְבְּדוּ בָנָיו וְלֹא יֵדָע וְיִצְעֲרוּ וְלֹא־יָבִין לָמוֹ׃

verses.english: Only his own flesh pains him, and his soul mourns for him.”
verses.hebrew: אַךְ־בְּשָׂרוֹ עָלָיו יִכְאָב וְנַפְשׁוֹ עָלָיו תֶּאֱבָל׃

verses.english: Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אֱלִיפַז הַתֵּימָנִי וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “Should a wise man answer with windy knowledge and fill his belly with the east wind,
verses.hebrew: הֶחָכָם יַעֲנֶה דַעַת־רוּחַ וִימַלֵּא קָדִים בִּטְנוֹ׃

verses.english: arguing with speech that does not help and words by which he gains no benefit?
verses.hebrew: הוֹכֵחַ בְּדָבָר לֹא יִסְכּוֹן וּמִלִּים לֹא־יוֹעִיל בָּם׃

verses.english: You even undermine reverence and diminish meditation before God.
verses.hebrew: אַף־אַתָּה תָּפֵר יִרְאָה וְתִגְרַע שִׂיחָה לִפְנֵי־אֵל׃

verses.english: For your guilt teaches your mouth, and you choose the tongue of the crafty.
verses.hebrew: כִּי יְאַלֵּף עֲוֺנְךָ פִיךָ וְתִבְחַר לְשׁוֹן עֲרוּמִים׃

verses.english: Your own mouth condemns you, not I; your lips testify against you.
verses.hebrew: יַרְשִׁיעֲךָ פִיךָ וְלֹא־אָנִי וּשְׂפָתֶיךָ יַעֲנוּ־בָךְ׃

verses.english: Were you the first human born, or brought forth before the hills?
verses.hebrew: הֲרִאישׁוֹן אָדָם תִּוָּלֵד וְלִפְנֵי גְבָעוֹת חוֹלָלְתָּ׃

verses.english: Have you listened in God’s council, and confined wisdom to yourself?
verses.hebrew: הַבְסוֹד אֱלוֹהַ תִּשְׁמָע וְתִגְרַע אֵלֶיךָ חָכְמָה׃

verses.english: What do you know that we do not know? What do you understand that is not with us?
verses.hebrew: מַה־יָּדַעְתָּ וְלֹא נֵדָע תָּבִין וְלֹא־עִמָּנוּ הוּא׃

verses.english: Among us are both the gray-haired and the aged, older in days than your father.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־שָׂב גַּם־יָשִׁישׁ בָּנוּ כַּבִּיר מֵאָבִיךָ יָמִים׃

verses.english: Are God’s consolations too small for you, and a word spoken gently with you?
verses.hebrew: הַמְעַט מִמְּךָ תַּנְחֻמוֹת אֵל וְדָבָר לָאַט עִמָּךְ׃

verses.english: Why does your heart carry you away, and why do your eyes flash,
verses.hebrew: מַה־יִּקָּחֲךָ לִבֶּךָ וּמַה־יִּרְזְמוּן עֵינֶיךָ׃

verses.english: that you turn your spirit against God and let words come out of your mouth?
verses.hebrew: כִּי־תָשִׁיב אֶל־אֵל רוּחֶךָ וְהֹצֵאתָ מִפִּיךָ מִלִּין׃

verses.english: What is a mortal, that he should be clean, or one born of woman, that he should be righteous?
verses.hebrew: מָה־אֱנוֹשׁ כִּי־יִזְכֶּה וְכִי־יִצְדַּק יְלוּד אִשָּׁה׃

verses.english: Look, He puts no trust in His holy ones, and the heavens are not clean in His eyes;
verses.hebrew: הֵן בקדשו [בִּקְדֹשָׁיו] לֹא יַאֲמִין וְשָׁמַיִם לֹא־זַכּוּ בְעֵינָיו׃

verses.english: how much less one loathsome and corrupt, a man who drinks injustice like water!
verses.hebrew: אַף כִּי־נִתְעָב וְנֶאֱלָח אִישׁ־שֹׁתֶה כַמַּיִם עַוְלָה׃

verses.english: I will tell you—listen to me; what I have seen I will recount,
verses.hebrew: אֲחַוְךָ שְׁמַע־לִי וְזֶה־חָזִיתִי וַאֲסַפֵּרָה׃

verses.english: what the wise have declared, not concealing what came from their fathers,
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־חֲכָמִים יַגִּידוּ וְלֹא כִחֲדוּ מֵאֲבוֹתָם׃

verses.english: to whom alone the land was given, with no stranger passing among them.
verses.hebrew: לָהֶם לְבַדָּם נִתְּנָה הָאָרֶץ וְלֹא־עָבַר זָר בְּתוֹכָם׃

verses.english: All the days of the wicked he writhes in pain, and a number of years is stored up for the ruthless.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־יְמֵי רָשָׁע הוּא מִתְחוֹלֵל וּמִסְפַּר שָׁנִים נִצְפְּנוּ לֶעָרִיץ׃

verses.english: Sounds of terror are in his ears; while at peace, a destroyer comes upon him.
verses.hebrew: קוֹל־פְּחָדִים בְּאָזְנָיו בַּשָּׁלוֹם שׁוֹדֵד יְבוֹאֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: He does not trust that he will return from darkness; he is marked out for the sword.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יַאֲמִין שׁוּב מִנִּי־חֹשֶׁךְ וצפו [וְצָפוּי] הוּא אֱלֵי־חָרֶב׃

verses.english: He wanders for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that a day of darkness is ready at hand.
verses.hebrew: נֹדֵד הוּא לַלֶּחֶם אַיֵּה יָדַע כִּי־נָכוֹן בְּיָדוֹ יוֹם־חֹשֶׁךְ׃

verses.english: Distress and anguish terrify him; they overpower him like a king ready for battle,
verses.hebrew: יְבַעֲתֻהוּ צַר וּמְצוּקָה תִּתְקְפֵהוּ כְּמֶלֶךְ עָתִיד לַכִּידוֹר׃

verses.english: because he stretched out his hand against God and acted mightily against Shaddai,
verses.hebrew: כִּי־נָטָה אֶל־אֵל יָדוֹ וְאֶל־שַׁדַּי יִתְגַּבָּר׃

verses.english: running at Him with neck outstretched, with the thick bosses of his shields.
verses.hebrew: יָרוּץ אֵלָיו בְּצַוָּאר בַּעֲבִי גַּבֵּי מָגִנָּיו׃

verses.english: For he covered his face with his fat and made bulging fat upon his loins;
verses.hebrew: כִּי־כִסָּה פָנָיו בְּחֶלְבּוֹ וַיַּעַשׂ פִּימָה עֲלֵי־כָסֶל׃

verses.english: he dwelt in ruined cities, houses where no one would live, prepared to become heaps.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכּוֹן עָרִים נִכְחָדוֹת בָּתִּים לֹא־יֵשְׁבוּ לָמוֹ אֲשֶׁר הִתְעַתְּדוּ לְגַלִּים׃

verses.english: He will not be rich, and his wealth will not endure; their produce will not spread over the earth.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יֶעְשַׁר וְלֹא־יָקוּם חֵילוֹ וְלֹא־יִטֶּה לָאָרֶץ מִנְלָם׃

verses.english: He will not depart from darkness; a flame will dry up his shoots, and he will depart by the breath of His mouth.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יָסוּר מִנִּי־חֹשֶׁךְ יֹנַקְתּוֹ תְּיַבֵּשׁ שַׁלְהָבֶת וְיָסוּר בְּרוּחַ פִּיו׃

verses.english: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceived, for emptiness will be his recompense.
verses.hebrew: אַל־יַאֲמֵן בשו [בַּשָּׁיו] נִתְעָה כִּי־שָׁוְא תִּהְיֶה תְמוּרָתוֹ׃

verses.english: It will be fulfilled before his day, and his branch will not be green.
verses.hebrew: בְּלֹא־יוֹמוֹ תִּמָּלֵא וְכִפָּתוֹ לֹא רַעֲנָנָה׃

verses.english: He will shed his unripe grapes like a vine and cast off his blossom like an olive tree.
verses.hebrew: יַחְמֹס כַּגֶּפֶן בִּסְרוֹ וְיַשְׁלֵךְ כַּזַּיִת נִצָּתוֹ׃

verses.english: For the company of the godless is barren, and fire consumes the tents of bribery.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־עֲדַת חָנֵף גַּלְמוּד וְאֵשׁ אָכְלָה אָהֳלֵי־שֹׁחַד׃

verses.english: They conceive trouble and give birth to wrongdoing, and their womb prepares deceit.”
verses.hebrew: הָרֹה עָמָל וְיָלֹד אָוֶן וּבִטְנָם תָּכִין מִרְמָה׃

verses.english: Job answered and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “I have heard many such things; you are all comforters of trouble.
verses.hebrew: שָׁמַעְתִּי כְאֵלֶּה רַבּוֹת מְנַחֲמֵי עָמָל כֻּלְּכֶם׃

verses.english: Is there an end to windy words? What provokes you to answer?
verses.hebrew: הֲקֵץ לְדִבְרֵי־רוּחַ אוֹ מַה־יַּמְרִיצְךָ כִּי תַעֲנֶה׃

verses.english: I too could speak like you, if your life were in place of mine. I could string words together against you and shake my head at you.
verses.hebrew: גַּם אָנֹכִי כָּכֶם אֲדַבֵּרָה לוּ־יֵשׁ נַפְשְׁכֶם תַּחַת נַפְשִׁי אַחְבִּירָה עֲלֵיכֶם בְּמִלִּים וְאָנִיעָה עֲלֵיכֶם בְּמוֹ רֹאשִׁי׃

verses.english: I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the movement of my lips would bring relief.
verses.hebrew: אֲאַמִּצְכֶם בְּמוֹ־פִי וְנִיד שְׂפָתַי יַחְשֹׂךְ׃

verses.english: If I speak, my pain is not held back; if I cease, what leaves me?
verses.hebrew: אִם־אֲדַבְּרָה לֹא־יֵחָשֵׂךְ כְּאֵבִי וְאַחְדְּלָה מַה־מִנִּי יַהֲלֹךְ׃

verses.english: But now He has worn me out; You have devastated all my company.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ־עַתָּה הֶלְאָנִי הֲשִׁמּוֹתָ כָּל־עֲדָתִי׃

verses.english: You have shriveled me, and it has become a witness; my gauntness rises against me and answers to my face.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְמְטֵנִי לְעֵד הָיָה וַיָּקָם בִּי כַחֲשִׁי בְּפָנַי יַעֲנֶה׃

verses.english: His anger tears me and bears a grudge against me; He gnashes His teeth at me. My adversary sharpens his eyes against me.
verses.hebrew: אַפּוֹ טָרַף וַיִּשְׂטְמֵנִי חָרַק עָלַי בְּשִׁנָּיו צָרִי יִלְטוֹשׁ עֵינָיו לִי׃

verses.english: They gape at me with their mouths; in reproach they strike my cheeks; together they mass themselves against me.
verses.hebrew: פָּעֲרוּ עָלַי בְּפִיהֶם בְּחֶרְפָּה הִכּוּ לְחָיָי יַחַד עָלַי יִתְמַלָּאוּן׃

verses.english: God hands me over to the unjust and throws me into the hands of the wicked.
verses.hebrew: יַסְגִּירֵנִי אֵל אֶל עֲוִיל וְעַל־יְדֵי רְשָׁעִים יִרְטֵנִי׃

verses.english: I was at ease, and He shattered me; He seized me by the back of the neck and broke me to pieces, and set me up as His target.
verses.hebrew: שָׁלֵו הָיִיתִי וַיְפַרְפְּרֵנִי וְאָחַז בְּעָרְפִּי וַיְפַצְפְּצֵנִי וַיְקִימֵנִי לוֹ לְמַטָּרָה׃

verses.english: His archers surround me; He splits my kidneys without pity and pours my gall onto the earth.
verses.hebrew: יָסֹבּוּ עָלַי רַבָּיו יְפַלַּח כִּלְיוֹתַי וְלֹא יַחְמוֹל יִשְׁפֹּךְ לָאָרֶץ מְרֵרָתִי׃

verses.english: He breaches me, breach upon breach; He runs at me like a warrior.
verses.hebrew: יִפְרְצֵנִי פֶרֶץ עַל־פְּנֵי־פָרֶץ יָרֻץ עָלַי כְּגִבּוֹר׃

verses.english: I sewed sackcloth upon my skin and thrust my horn into the dust.
verses.hebrew: שַׂק תָּפַרְתִּי עֲלֵי גִלְדִּי וְעֹלַלְתִּי בֶעָפָר קַרְנִי׃

verses.english: My face is reddened with weeping, and death’s shadow is upon my eyelids,
verses.hebrew: פָּנַי חמרמרה [חֳמַרְמְרוּ] מִנִּי־בֶכִי וְעַל עַפְעַפַּי צַלְמָוֶת׃

verses.english: although there is no violence in my hands and my prayer is pure.
verses.hebrew: עַל לֹא־חָמָס בְּכַפָּי וּתְפִלָּתִי זַכָּה׃

verses.english: Earth, do not cover my blood, and let my cry find no resting place!
verses.hebrew: אֶרֶץ אַל־תְּכַסִּי דָמִי וְאַל־יְהִי מָקוֹם לְזַעֲקָתִי׃

verses.english: Even now, look, my witness is in heaven, and the one who testifies for me is on high.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־עַתָּה הִנֵּה־בַשָּׁמַיִם עֵדִי וְשָׂהֲדִי בַּמְּרוֹמִים׃

verses.english: My friends are my mockers; my eye pours tears toward God.
verses.hebrew: מְלִיצַי רֵעָי אֶל־אֱלוֹהַ דָּלְפָה עֵינִי׃

verses.english: Let him argue a man’s case with God, and a son of man’s case with his friend,
verses.hebrew: וְיוֹכַח לְגֶבֶר עִם־אֱלוֹהַּ וּבֶן־אָדָם לְרֵעֵהוּ׃

verses.english: for a few numbered years will come, and I will go on a path from which I will not return.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־שְׁנוֹת מִסְפָּר יֶאֱתָיוּ וְאֹרַח לֹא־אָשׁוּב אֶהֱלֹךְ׃

verses.english: “My spirit is broken; my days are extinguished; graves await me.
verses.hebrew: רוּחִי חֻבָּלָה יָמַי נִזְעָכוּ קְבָרִים לִי׃

verses.english: Surely mockers are with me, and my eye dwells upon their provocations.
verses.hebrew: אִם־לֹא הֲתֻלִים עִמָּדִי וּבְהַמְּרוֹתָם תָּלַן עֵינִי׃

verses.english: Please put down a pledge; be my guarantor with Yourself. Who else will strike hands with me?
verses.hebrew: שִׂימָה־נָּא עָרְבֵנִי עִמָּךְ מִי הוּא לְיָדִי יִתָּקֵעַ׃

verses.english: For You have hidden their heart from understanding; therefore You will not exalt them.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־לִבָּם צָפַנְתָּ מִּשָּׂכֶל עַל־כֵּן לֹא תְרֹמֵם׃

verses.english: One who denounces friends for a share of gain— his children’s eyes will fail.
verses.hebrew: לְחֵלֶק יַגִּיד רֵעִים וְעֵינֵי בָנָיו תִּכְלֶנָה׃

verses.english: He has made me a byword among peoples, and I have become one in whose face they spit.
verses.hebrew: וְהִצִּגַנִי לִמְשֹׁל עַמִּים וְתֹפֶת לְפָנִים אֶהְיֶה׃

verses.english: My eye is dim from vexation, and all my limbs are like a shadow.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּכַהּ מִכַּעַשׂ עֵינִי וִיצֻרַי כַּצֵּל כֻּלָּם׃

verses.english: The upright are appalled at this, and the innocent stir themselves against the godless.
verses.hebrew: יָשֹׁמּוּ יְשָׁרִים עַל־זֹאת וְנָקִי עַל־חָנֵף יִתְעֹרָר׃

verses.english: The righteous hold to their way, and the clean of hands grow stronger.
verses.hebrew: וְיֹאחֵז צַדִּיק דַּרְכּוֹ וּטֳהָר־יָדַיִם יֹסִיף אֹמֶץ׃

verses.english: But all of you, return and come now; I will not find a wise man among you.
verses.hebrew: וְאוּלָם כֻּלָּם תָּשֻׁבוּ וּבֹאוּ נָא וְלֹא־אֶמְצָא בָכֶם חָכָם׃

verses.english: My days have passed; my plans are torn apart, the possessions of my heart.
verses.hebrew: יָמַי עָבְרוּ זִמֹּתַי נִתְּקוּ מוֹרָשֵׁי לְבָבִי׃

verses.english: They turn night into day; light is near in the face of darkness.
verses.hebrew: לַיְלָה לְיוֹם יָשִׂימוּ אוֹר קָרוֹב מִפְּנֵי־חֹשֶׁךְ׃

verses.english: If I wait for Sheol as my house, if I spread my bed in darkness,
verses.hebrew: אִם־אֲקַוֶּה שְׁאוֹל בֵּיתִי בַּחֹשֶׁךְ רִפַּדְתִּי יְצוּעָי׃

verses.english: if I call to the pit, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother and my sister,’
verses.hebrew: לַשַּׁחַת קָרָאתִי אָבִי אָתָּה אִמִּי וַאֲחֹתִי לָרִמָּה׃

verses.english: where, then, is my hope? Who will see my hope?
verses.hebrew: וְאַיֵּה אֵפוֹ תִקְוָתִי וְתִקְוָתִי מִי יְשׁוּרֶנָּה׃

verses.english: Will they go down to the bars of Sheol, when together there is rest upon the dust?”
verses.hebrew: בַּדֵּי שְׁאֹל תֵּרַדְנָה אִם־יַחַד עַל־עָפָר נָחַת׃

verses.english: Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן בִּלְדַּד הַשֻּׁחִי וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “How long will you set traps for words? Understand, and afterward we will speak.
verses.hebrew: עַד־אָנָה תְּשִׂימוּן קִנְצֵי לְמִלִּין תָּבִינוּ וְאַחַר נְדַבֵּר׃

verses.english: Why are we counted as animals, regarded as unclean in your eyes?
verses.hebrew: מַדּוּעַ נֶחְשַׁבְנוּ כַבְּהֵמָה נִטְמִינוּ בְּעֵינֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: You who tear yourself in your anger— will the earth be abandoned for your sake, or a rock moved from its place?
verses.hebrew: טֹרֵף נַפְשׁוֹ בְּאַפּוֹ הַלְמַעַנְךָ תֵּעָזַב אָרֶץ וְיֶעְתַּק־צוּר מִמְּקֹמוֹ׃

verses.english: Indeed, the light of the wicked will be extinguished, and the flame of his fire will not shine.
verses.hebrew: גַּם אוֹר רְשָׁעִים יִדְעָךְ וְלֹא־יִגַּהּ שְׁבִיב אִשּׁוֹ׃

verses.english: Light grows dark in his tent, and the lamp above him is extinguished.
verses.hebrew: אוֹר חָשַׁךְ בְּאָהֳלוֹ וְנֵרוֹ עָלָיו יִדְעָךְ׃

verses.english: His vigorous steps are narrowed, and his own counsel throws him down.
verses.hebrew: יֵצְרוּ צַעֲדֵי אוֹנוֹ וְתַשְׁלִיכֵהוּ עֲצָתוֹ׃

verses.english: For his feet drive him into a net, and he walks upon a snare.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־שֻׁלַּח בְּרֶשֶׁת בְּרַגְלָיו וְעַל־שְׂבָכָה יִתְהַלָּךְ׃

verses.english: A trap grasps his heel; a snare takes firm hold of him.
verses.hebrew: יֹאחֵז בְּעָקֵב פָּח יַחֲזֵק עָלָיו צַמִּים׃

verses.english: His cord is hidden in the earth, and his trap upon the path.
verses.hebrew: טָמוּן בָּאָרֶץ חַבְלוֹ וּמַלְכֻּדְתּוֹ עֲלֵי נָתִיב׃

verses.english: Terrors frighten him on every side and scatter him at his feet.
verses.hebrew: סָבִיב בִּעֲתֻהוּ בַלָּהוֹת וֶהֱפִיצֻהוּ לְרַגְלָיו׃

verses.english: His strength is famished, and calamity stands ready at his side.
verses.hebrew: יְהִי־רָעֵב אֹנוֹ וְאֵיד נָכוֹן לְצַלְעוֹ׃

verses.english: It devours the parts of his skin; the firstborn of death devours his limbs.
verses.hebrew: יֹאכַל בַּדֵּי עוֹרוֹ יֹאכַל בַּדָּיו בְּכוֹר מָוֶת׃

verses.english: His security is torn from his tent, and he is marched to the king of terrors.
verses.hebrew: יִנָּתֵק מֵאָהֳלוֹ מִבְטַחוֹ וְתַצְעִדֵהוּ לְמֶלֶךְ בַּלָּהוֹת׃

verses.english: What is not his dwells in his tent; sulfur is scattered over his dwelling.
verses.hebrew: תִּשְׁכּוֹן בְּאָהֳלוֹ מִבְּלִי־לוֹ יְזֹרֶה עַל־נָוֵהוּ גָפְרִית׃

verses.english: Below, his roots dry up; above, his branches wither.
verses.hebrew: מִתַּחַת שָׁרָשָׁיו יִבָשׁוּ וּמִמַּעַל יִמַּל קְצִירוֹ׃

verses.english: His memory perishes from the earth, and he has no name in the open country.
verses.hebrew: זִכְרוֹ־אָבַד מִנִּי־אָרֶץ וְלֹא־שֵׁם לוֹ עַל־פְּנֵי־חוּץ׃

verses.english: They thrust him from light into darkness and drive him from the inhabited world.
verses.hebrew: יֶהְדְּפֻהוּ מֵאוֹר אֶל־חֹשֶׁךְ וּמִתֵּבֵל יְנִדֻּהוּ׃

verses.english: He has no offspring or descendant among his people, and no survivor where he dwells.
verses.hebrew: לֹא נִין לוֹ וְלֹא־נֶכֶד בְּעַמּוֹ וְאֵין שָׂרִיד בִּמְגוּרָיו׃

verses.english: Those who come after are appalled at his day, and those who came before are seized by shuddering.
verses.hebrew: עַל־יוֹמוֹ נָשַׁמּוּ אַחֲרֹנִים וְקַדְמֹנִים אָחֲזוּ שָׂעַר׃

verses.english: Surely these are the dwellings of the unjust, and this is the place of one who does not know God.”
verses.hebrew: אַךְ־אֵלֶּה מִשְׁכְּנוֹת עַוָּל וְזֶה מְקוֹם לֹא־יָדַע־אֵל׃

verses.english: Job answered and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “How long will you grieve my soul and crush me with words?
verses.hebrew: עַד־אָנָה תּוֹגְיוּן נַפְשִׁי וּתְדַכְּאוּנַנִי בְמִלִּים׃

verses.english: These ten times you have shamed me; you are not ashamed to deal harshly with me.
verses.hebrew: זֶה עֶשֶׂר פְּעָמִים תַּכְלִימוּנִי לֹא־תֵבֹשׁוּ תַּהְכְּרוּ־לִי׃

verses.english: Even if I have indeed gone astray, my error lodges with me.
verses.hebrew: וְאַף־אָמְנָם שָׁגִיתִי אִתִּי תָּלִין מְשׁוּגָתִי׃

verses.english: — [No corresponding Hebrew source unit.]
verses.hebrew: וְאַף־אָמְנָם שָׁגִיתִי אִתִּי תָּלִין מְשׁוּגָתִי׃

verses.english: If indeed you magnify yourselves against me and use my disgrace as an argument against me,
verses.hebrew: אִם־אָמְנָם עָלַי תַּגְדִּילוּ וְתוֹכִיחוּ עָלַי חֶרְפָּתִּי׃

verses.english: know, then, that God has wronged me and drawn His net around me.
verses.hebrew: דְּעוּ־אֵפוֹ כִּי־אֱלוֹהַּ עִוְּתָנִי וּמְצוּדוֹ עָלַי הִקִּיף׃

verses.english: Look, I cry, ‘Violence!’ but receive no answer; I cry for help, but there is no judgment.
verses.hebrew: הֵן אֶצְעַק חָמָס וְלֹא אֵעָנֶה אֲשַׁוַּע וְאֵין מִשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: He has walled off my path, so I cannot pass, and has put darkness upon my paths.
verses.hebrew: אָרְחִי גָדַר וְלֹא אֶעֱבוֹר וְעַל נְתִיבוֹתַי חֹשֶׁךְ יָשִׂים׃

verses.english: He has stripped my glory from me and removed the crown from my head.
verses.hebrew: כְּבוֹדִי מֵעָלַי הִפְשִׁיט וַיָּסַר עֲטֶרֶת רֹאשִׁי׃

verses.english: He tears me down on every side, and I am gone; He uproots my hope like a tree.
verses.hebrew: יִתְּצֵנִי סָבִיב וָאֵלַךְ וַיַּסַּע כָּעֵץ תִּקְוָתִי׃

verses.english: His anger burns against me, and He counts me among His adversaries.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּחַר עָלַי אַפּוֹ וַיַּחְשְׁבֵנִי לוֹ כְצָרָיו׃

verses.english: His troops come together, raise their way against me, and camp around my tent.
