verses.hebrew: יַחַד יָבֹאוּ גְדוּדָיו וַיָּסֹלּוּ עָלַי דַּרְכָּם וַיַּחֲנוּ סָבִיב לְאָהֳלִי׃

verses.english: He has put my brothers far from me, and my acquaintances are completely estranged from me.
verses.hebrew: אַחַי מֵעָלַי הִרְחִיק וְיֹדְעַי אַךְ־זָרוּ מִמֶּנִּי׃

verses.english: My relatives have ceased to come, and my acquaintances have forgotten me.
verses.hebrew: חָדְלוּ קְרוֹבָי וּמְיֻדָּעַי שְׁכֵחוּנִי׃

verses.english: Those staying in my house and my maidservants count me as a stranger; I have become a foreigner in their eyes.
verses.hebrew: גָּרֵי בֵיתִי וְאַמְהֹתַי לְזָר תַּחְשְׁבֻנִי נָכְרִי הָיִיתִי בְעֵינֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: I call my servant, but he does not answer; with my own mouth I plead with him.
verses.hebrew: לְעַבְדִּי קָרָאתִי וְלֹא יַעֲנֶה בְּמוֹ־פִי אֶתְחַנֶּן־לוֹ׃

verses.english: My breath is strange to my wife, and I plead with the sons of my body.
verses.hebrew: רוּחִי זָרָה לְאִשְׁתִּי וְחַנֹּתִי לִבְנֵי בִטְנִי׃

verses.english: Even young children reject me; when I rise, they speak against me.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־עֲוִילִים מָאֲסוּ בִי אָקוּמָה וַיְדַבְּרוּ־בִי׃

verses.english: All my intimate friends abhor me; those I loved have turned against me.
verses.hebrew: תִּעֲבוּנִי כָּל־מְתֵי סוֹדִי וְזֶה־אָהַבְתִּי נֶהְפְּכוּ־בִי׃

verses.english: My bones cling to my skin and flesh, and I have escaped with the skin of my teeth.
verses.hebrew: בְּעוֹרִי וּבִבְשָׂרִי דָּבְקָה עַצְמִי וָאֶתְמַלְּטָה בְּעוֹר שִׁנָּי׃

verses.english: Have mercy on me, have mercy on me, you my friends, for God’s hand has touched me!
verses.hebrew: חָנֻּנִי חָנֻּנִי אַתֶּם רֵעָי כִּי יַד־אֱלוֹהַּ נָגְעָה בִּי׃

verses.english: Why do you pursue me like God and never have enough of my flesh?
verses.hebrew: לָמָּה תִּרְדְּפֻנִי כְמוֹ־אֵל וּמִבְּשָׂרִי לֹא תִשְׂבָּעוּ׃

verses.english: If only my words were written! If only they were inscribed in a book,
verses.hebrew: מִי־יִתֵּן אֵפוֹ וְיִכָּתְבוּן מִלָּי מִי־יִתֵּן בַּסֵּפֶר וְיֻחָקוּ׃

verses.english: with an iron stylus and lead, carved into rock forever!
verses.hebrew: בְּעֵט־בַּרְזֶל וְעֹפָרֶת לָעַד בַּצּוּר יֵחָצְבוּן׃

verses.english: But I know that my redeemer lives, and at the last he will stand upon the dust.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי יָדַעְתִּי גֹּאֲלִי חָי וְאַחֲרוֹן עַל־עָפָר יָקוּם׃

verses.english: After they have struck off this skin of mine, yet from my flesh I will behold God,
verses.hebrew: וְאַחַר עוֹרִי נִקְּפוּ־זֹאת וּמִבְּשָׂרִי אֶחֱזֶה אֱלוֹהַּ׃

verses.english: whom I myself will behold for myself; my eyes will see, and not a stranger. My kidneys are spent within my breast.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי אֶחֱזֶה־לִּי וְעֵינַי רָאוּ וְלֹא־זָר כָּלוּ כִלְיֹתַי בְּחֵקִי׃

verses.english: If you say, ‘How we will pursue him!’ and, ‘The root of the matter is found in me,’
verses.hebrew: כִּי תֹאמְרוּ מַה־נִּרְדָּף־לוֹ וְשֹׁרֶשׁ דָּבָר נִמְצָא־בִי׃

verses.english: be afraid of the sword yourselves, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, so that you may know there is judgment.”
verses.hebrew: גּוּרוּ לָכֶם מִפְּנֵי־חֶרֶב כִּי־חֵמָה עֲוֺנוֹת חָרֶב לְמַעַן תֵּדְעוּן שדין [שַׁדּוּן׃]

verses.english: Zophar the Naamathite answered and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן צֹפַר הַנַּעֲמָתִי וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “Therefore my troubled thoughts make me answer, because of my inward haste.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן שְׂעִפַּי יְשִׁיבוּנִי וּבַעֲבוּר חוּשִׁי בִי׃

verses.english: I hear a correction that shames me, and a spirit from my understanding answers me.
verses.hebrew: מוּסַר כְּלִמָּתִי אֶשְׁמָע וְרוּחַ מִבִּינָתִי יַעֲנֵנִי׃

verses.english: Do you know this from of old, since humankind was placed upon the earth:
verses.hebrew: הֲזֹאת יָדַעְתָּ מִנִּי־עַד מִנִּי שִׂים אָדָם עֲלֵי־אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: that the exulting of the wicked is brief, and the joy of the godless lasts but a moment?
verses.hebrew: כִּי רִנְנַת רְשָׁעִים מִקָּרוֹב וְשִׂמְחַת חָנֵף עֲדֵי־רָגַע׃

verses.english: Though his height rises to the heavens and his head reaches the cloud,
verses.hebrew: אִם־יַעֲלֶה לַשָּׁמַיִם שִׂיאוֹ וְרֹאשׁוֹ לָעָב יַגִּיעַ׃

verses.english: he will perish forever like his dung; those who saw him will say, ‘Where is he?’
verses.hebrew: כְּגֶלֲלוֹ לָנֶצַח יֹאבֵד רֹאָיו יֹאמְרוּ אַיּוֹ׃

verses.english: He flies away like a dream, and they cannot find him; he is chased away like a vision of the night.
verses.hebrew: כַּחֲלוֹם יָעוּף וְלֹא יִמְצָאוּהוּ וְיֻדַּד כְּחֶזְיוֹן לָיְלָה׃

verses.english: The eye that glimpsed him will see him no more, and his place will no longer behold him.
verses.hebrew: עַיִן שְׁזָפַתּוּ וְלֹא תוֹסִיף וְלֹא־עוֹד תְּשׁוּרֶנּוּ מְקוֹמוֹ׃

verses.english: His sons will appease the poor, and his hands will return his wealth.
verses.hebrew: בָּנָיו יְרַצּוּ דַלִּים וְיָדָיו תָּשֵׁבְנָה אוֹנוֹ׃

verses.english: His bones are full of his youthful strength, and it will lie with him upon the dust.
verses.hebrew: עַצְמוֹתָיו מָלְאוּ עלומו [עֲלוּמָיו] וְעִמּוֹ עַל־עָפָר תִּשְׁכָּב׃

verses.english: Though evil tastes sweet in his mouth and he hides it under his tongue,
verses.hebrew: אִם־תַּמְתִּיק בְּפִיו רָעָה יַכְחִידֶנָּה תַּחַת לְשׁוֹנוֹ׃

verses.english: though he cherishes it and will not let it go, but holds it inside his palate,
verses.hebrew: יַחְמֹל עָלֶיהָ וְלֹא יַעַזְבֶנָּה וְיִמְנָעֶנָּה בְּתוֹךְ חִכּוֹ׃

verses.english: his food turns in his bowels; it is the gall of asps within him.
verses.hebrew: לַחְמוֹ בְּמֵעָיו נֶהְפָּךְ מְרוֹרַת פְּתָנִים בְּקִרְבּוֹ׃

verses.english: He swallowed wealth, but will vomit it up; God will drive it out of his belly.
verses.hebrew: חַיִל בָּלַע וַיְקִאֶנּוּ מִבִּטְנוֹ יוֹרִשֶׁנּוּ אֵל׃

verses.english: He will suck the venom of asps; a viper’s tongue will kill him.
verses.hebrew: רֹאשׁ־פְּתָנִים יִינָק תַּהַרְגֵהוּ לְשׁוֹן אֶפְעֶה׃

verses.english: May he not look upon the channels, the rivers, the streams of honey and curds.
verses.hebrew: אַל־יֵרֶא בִפְלַגּוֹת נַהֲרֵי נַחֲלֵי דְּבַשׁ וְחֶמְאָה׃

verses.english: He returns the fruit of his toil and does not swallow it; he will not rejoice in the wealth of his exchange.
verses.hebrew: מֵשִׁיב יָגָע וְלֹא יִבְלָע כְּחֵיל תְּמוּרָתוֹ וְלֹא יַעֲלֹס׃

verses.english: For he crushed and abandoned the poor; he seized a house that he did not build.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־רִצַּץ עָזַב דַּלִּים בַּיִת גָּזַל וְלֹא יִבֶנֵהוּ׃

verses.english: For he knew no ease in his belly; he will not escape with what he desired.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־יָדַע שָׁלֵו בְּבִטְנוֹ בַּחֲמוּדוֹ לֹא יְמַלֵּט׃

verses.english: Nothing remained for him to eat; therefore his prosperity will not endure.
verses.hebrew: אֵין־שָׂרִיד לְאָכְלוֹ עַל־כֵּן לֹא־יָחִיל טוּבוֹ׃

verses.english: In the fullness of his abundance he will be in distress; every hand of the troubled will come upon him.
verses.hebrew: בִּמְלֹאות שִׂפְקוֹ יֵצֶר לוֹ כָּל־יַד עָמֵל תְּבוֹאֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: When he is about to fill his belly, He will send His burning anger against him and rain it upon him as his food.
verses.hebrew: יְהִי לְמַלֵּא בִטְנוֹ יְשַׁלַּח־בּוֹ חֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ וְיַמְטֵר עָלֵימוֹ בִּלְחוּמוֹ׃

verses.english: He will flee from an iron weapon; a bronze bow will pierce him.
verses.hebrew: יִבְרַח מִנֵּשֶׁק בַּרְזֶל תַּחְלְפֵהוּ קֶשֶׁת נְחוּשָׁה׃

verses.english: He draws it, and it comes out of his body; the flashing point comes out of his gall. Terrors are upon him.
verses.hebrew: שָׁלַף וַיֵּצֵא מִגֵּוָה וּבָרָק מִמְּרֹרָתוֹ יַהֲלֹךְ עָלָיו אֵמִים׃

verses.english: Every darkness is stored up for his treasures; a fire not fanned will consume him; it will go badly for the survivor in his tent.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־חֹשֶׁךְ טָמוּן לִצְפּוּנָיו תְּאָכְלֵהוּ אֵשׁ לֹא־נֻפָּח יֵרַע שָׂרִיד בְּאָהֳלוֹ׃

verses.english: The heavens will uncover his guilt, and the earth will rise against him.
verses.hebrew: יְגַלּוּ שָׁמַיִם עֲוֺנוֹ וְאֶרֶץ מִתְקוֹמָמָה לוֹ׃

verses.english: The produce of his house will depart, flowing away in the day of His anger.
verses.hebrew: יִגֶל יְבוּל בֵּיתוֹ נִגָּרוֹת בְּיוֹם אַפּוֹ׃

verses.english: This is the wicked person’s portion from God, and the inheritance appointed to him by God.”
verses.hebrew: זֶה חֵלֶק־אָדָם רָשָׁע מֵאֱלֹהִים וְנַחֲלַת אִמְרוֹ מֵאֵל׃

verses.english: Job answered and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “Listen carefully to my word, and let this be your consolation.
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ שָׁמוֹעַ מִלָּתִי וּתְהִי־זֹאת תַּנְחוּמֹתֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: Bear with me, and I will speak; after I have spoken, you may mock.
verses.hebrew: שָׂאוּנִי וְאָנֹכִי אֲדַבֵּר וְאַחַר דַּבְּרִי תַלְעִיג׃

verses.english: As for me, is my complaint addressed to a human? And if so, why should my spirit not grow short?
verses.hebrew: הֶאָנֹכִי לְאָדָם שִׂיחִי וְאִם־מַדּוּעַ לֹא־תִקְצַר רוּחִי׃

verses.english: Turn toward me and be appalled; put a hand over your mouth.
verses.hebrew: פְּנוּ־אֵלַי וְהָשַׁמּוּ וְשִׂימוּ יָד עַל־פֶּה׃

verses.english: When I remember, I am terrified, and shuddering seizes my flesh.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־זָכַרְתִּי וְנִבְהָלְתִּי וְאָחַז בְּשָׂרִי פַּלָּצוּת׃

verses.english: Why do the wicked live, grow old and even become mighty in wealth?
verses.hebrew: מַדּוּעַ רְשָׁעִים יִחְיוּ עָתְקוּ גַּם־גָּבְרוּ חָיִל׃

verses.english: Their offspring are established before them, with them, and their descendants are before their eyes.
verses.hebrew: זַרְעָם נָכוֹן לִפְנֵיהֶם עִמָּם וְצֶאֱצָאֵיהֶם לְעֵינֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Their houses are at peace, without fear, and God’s rod is not upon them.
verses.hebrew: בָּתֵּיהֶם שָׁלוֹם מִפָּחַד וְלֹא שֵׁבֶט אֱלוֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Their bull breeds and does not fail; their cow calves and does not miscarry.
verses.hebrew: שׁוֹרוֹ עִבַּר וְלֹא יַגְעִל תְּפַלֵּט פָּרָתוֹ וְלֹא תְשַׁכֵּל׃

verses.english: They send out their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.
verses.hebrew: יְשַׁלְּחוּ כַצֹּאן עֲוִילֵיהֶם וְיַלְדֵיהֶם יְרַקֵּדוּן׃

verses.english: They raise their voices to tambourine and lyre and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.
verses.hebrew: יִשְׂאוּ כְּתֹף וְכִנּוֹר וְיִשְׂמְחוּ לְקוֹל עוּגָב׃

verses.english: They spend their days in prosperity, and in a moment they go down to Sheol.
verses.hebrew: יבלו [יְכַלּוּ] בַטּוֹב יְמֵיהֶם וּבְרֶגַע שְׁאוֹל יֵחָתּוּ׃

verses.english: They say to God, ‘Turn away from us! We have no desire to know Your ways.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָאֵל סוּר מִמֶּנּוּ וְדַעַת דְּרָכֶיךָ לֹא חָפָצְנוּ׃

verses.english: What is Shaddai, that we should serve Him, and what would we gain by entreating Him?’
verses.hebrew: מַה־שַׁדַּי כִּי־נַעַבְדֶנּוּ וּמַה־נּוֹעִיל כִּי נִפְגַּע־בּוֹ׃

verses.english: Look, their prosperity is not in their own hands; the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.hebrew: הֵן לֹא בְיָדָם טוּבָם עֲצַת רְשָׁעִים רָחֲקָה מֶנִּי׃

verses.english: How often is the lamp of the wicked put out, and their calamity comes upon them, and He apportions pains in His anger?
verses.hebrew: כַּמָּה נֵר־רְשָׁעִים יִדְעָךְ וְיָבֹא עָלֵימוֹ אֵידָם חֲבָלִים יְחַלֵּק בְּאַפּוֹ׃

verses.english: How often do they become like straw before the wind, like chaff that a storm steals away?
verses.hebrew: יִהְיוּ כְּתֶבֶן לִפְנֵי־רוּחַ וּכְמֹץ גְּנָבַתּוּ סוּפָה׃

verses.english: ‘God stores up his wrongdoing for his sons.’ Let Him repay the man himself, so that he knows!
verses.hebrew: אֱלוֹהַּ יִצְפֹּן־לְבָנָיו אוֹנוֹ יְשַׁלֵּם אֵלָיו וְיֵדָע׃

verses.english: Let his own eyes see his ruin, and let him drink from Shaddai’s fury!
verses.hebrew: יִרְאוּ עינו [עֵינָיו] כִּידוֹ וּמֵחֲמַת שַׁדַּי יִשְׁתֶּה׃

verses.english: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months has been cut off?
verses.hebrew: כִּי מַה־חֶפְצוֹ בְּבֵיתוֹ אַחֲרָיו וּמִסְפַּר חֳדָשָׁיו חֻצָּצוּ׃

verses.english: Will anyone teach knowledge to God, when He judges the exalted?
verses.hebrew: הַלְאֵל יְלַמֶּד־דָּעַת וְהוּא רָמִים יִשְׁפּוֹט׃

verses.english: One person dies in the fullness of his vigor, entirely carefree and at ease;
verses.hebrew: זֶה יָמוּת בְּעֶצֶם תֻּמּוֹ כֻּלּוֹ שַׁלְאֲנַן וְשָׁלֵיו׃

verses.english: his pails are full of milk, and the marrow of his bones is well watered.
verses.hebrew: עֲטִינָיו מָלְאוּ חָלָב וּמֹחַ עַצְמוֹתָיו יְשֻׁקֶּה׃

verses.english: Another dies with a bitter soul, never having eaten amid prosperity.
verses.hebrew: וְזֶה יָמוּת בְּנֶפֶשׁ מָרָה וְלֹא־אָכַל בַּטּוֹבָה׃

verses.english: Together they lie upon the dust, and worms cover them.
verses.hebrew: יַחַד עַל־עָפָר יִשְׁכָּבוּ וְרִמָּה תְּכַסֶּה עֲלֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Look, I know your thoughts and the schemes by which you wrong me.
verses.hebrew: הֵן יָדַעְתִּי מַחְשְׁבוֹתֵיכֶם וּמְזִמּוֹת עָלַי תַּחְמֹסוּ׃

verses.english: For you say, ‘Where is the nobleman’s house, and where is the tent, the dwelling of the wicked?’
verses.hebrew: כִּי תֹאמְרוּ אַיֵּה בֵית־נָדִיב וְאַיֵּה אֹהֶל מִשְׁכְּנוֹת רְשָׁעִים׃

verses.english: Have you not asked those who travel the road? Do not refuse to recognize their signs,
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא שְׁאֶלְתֶּם עוֹבְרֵי דָרֶךְ וְאֹתֹתָם לֹא תְנַכֵּרוּ׃

verses.english: that the evil person is spared for the day of calamity, and they are led away for the day of outbursts of wrath?
verses.hebrew: כִּי לְיוֹם אֵיד יֵחָשֶׂךְ רָע לְיוֹם עֲבָרוֹת יוּבָלוּ׃

verses.english: Who declares his way to his face? And what he has done—who repays him?
verses.hebrew: מִי־יַגִּיד עַל־פָּנָיו דַּרְכּוֹ וְהוּא־עָשָׂה מִי יְשַׁלֶּם־לוֹ׃

verses.english: He is carried to the graves, and he keeps watch over a mound.
verses.hebrew: וְהוּא לִקְבָרוֹת יוּבָל וְעַל־גָּדִישׁ יִשְׁקוֹד׃

verses.english: The clods of the valley are sweet to him; every human trails after him, and those before him are beyond number.
verses.hebrew: מָתְקוּ־לוֹ רִגְבֵי נָחַל וְאַחֲרָיו כָּל־אָדָם יִמְשׁוֹךְ וּלְפָנָיו אֵין מִסְפָּר׃

verses.english: How, then, can you comfort me with emptiness, when what remains of your answers is treachery?”
verses.hebrew: וְאֵיךְ תְּנַחֲמוּנִי הָבֶל וּתְשׁוּבֹתֵיכֶם נִשְׁאַר־מָעַל׃

verses.english: Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אֱלִיפַז הַתֵּמָנִי וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “Can a man be of use to God? Indeed, the wise person is of use to himself.
verses.hebrew: הַלְאֵל יִסְכָּן־גָּבֶר כִּי־יִסְכֹּן עָלֵימוֹ מַשְׂכִּיל׃

verses.english: Does Shaddai take pleasure in your righteousness, or gain anything when you make your ways blameless?
verses.hebrew: הַחֵפֶץ לְשַׁדַּי כִּי תִצְדָּק וְאִם־בֶּצַע כִּי־תַתֵּם דְּרָכֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Is it because of your reverence that He corrects you and enters into judgment with you?
verses.hebrew: הֲמִיִּרְאָתְךָ יֹכִיחֶךָ יָבוֹא עִמְּךָ בַּמִּשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: Is not your wickedness great, and are not your iniquities without end?
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא רָעָתְךָ רַבָּה וְאֵין־קֵץ לַעֲוֺנֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: For you took pledges from your brothers without cause and stripped the clothes from the naked.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־תַחְבֹּל אַחֶיךָ חִנָּם וּבִגְדֵי עֲרוּמִּים תַּפְשִׁיט׃

verses.english: You gave the weary no water to drink, and withheld bread from the hungry.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־מַיִם עָיֵף תַּשְׁקֶה וּמֵרָעֵב תִּמְנַע־לָחֶם׃

verses.english: The man of strength possessed the land, and the favored man lived in it.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ זְרוֹעַ לוֹ הָאָרֶץ וּנְשׂוּא פָנִים יֵשֶׁב בָּהּ׃

verses.english: You sent widows away empty, and the arms of orphans were crushed.
verses.hebrew: אַלְמָנוֹת שִׁלַּחְתָּ רֵיקָם וּזְרֹעוֹת יְתֹמִים יְדֻכָּא׃

verses.english: Therefore snares surround you, and sudden dread terrifies you,
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן סְבִיבוֹתֶיךָ פַחִים וִיבַהֶלְךָ פַּחַד פִּתְאֹם׃

verses.english: or darkness, so that you cannot see, and an abundance of water covers you.
verses.hebrew: אוֹ־חֹשֶׁךְ לֹא־תִרְאֶה וְשִׁפְעַת־מַיִם תְּכַסֶּךָּ׃

verses.english: Is not God high in the heavens? See the height of the stars, how lofty they are!
verses.hebrew: הֲ‍לֹא־אֱלוֹהַּ גֹּבַהּ שָׁמָיִם וּרְאֵה רֹאשׁ כּוֹכָבִים כִּי־רָמּוּ׃

verses.english: Yet you say, ‘What does God know? Can He judge through thick darkness?
verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ מַה־יָּדַע אֵל הַבְעַד עֲרָפֶל יִשְׁפּוֹט׃

verses.english: Clouds are His hiding place, so He does not see; He walks around the vault of heaven.’
verses.hebrew: עָבִים סֵתֶר־לוֹ וְלֹא יִרְאֶה וְחוּג שָׁמַיִם יִתְהַלָּךְ׃

verses.english: Will you keep to the ancient path that men of wrongdoing trod,
verses.hebrew: הַאֹרַח עוֹלָם תִּשְׁמֹר אֲשֶׁר דָּרְכוּ מְתֵי־אָוֶן׃

verses.english: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured away as a river?
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־קֻמְּטוּ וְלֹא־עֵת נָהָר יוּצַק יְסוֹדָם׃

verses.english: They said to God, ‘Turn away from us!’ And what could Shaddai do to them?
verses.hebrew: הָאֹמְרִים לָאֵל סוּר מִמֶּנּוּ וּמַה־יִּפְעַל שַׁדַּי לָמוֹ׃

verses.english: Yet He filled their houses with good things; the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.hebrew: וְהוּא מִלֵּא בָתֵּיהֶם טוֹב וַעֲצַת רְשָׁעִים רָחֲקָה מֶנִּי׃

verses.english: The righteous see and rejoice, and the innocent mock them:
verses.hebrew: יִרְאוּ צַדִּיקִים וְיִשְׂמָחוּ וְנָקִי יִלְעַג־לָמוֹ׃

verses.english: ‘Surely our adversary is wiped out, and fire has consumed their remainder!’
verses.hebrew: אִם־לֹא נִכְחַד קִימָנוּ וְיִתְרָם אָכְלָה אֵשׁ׃

verses.english: Come now, be reconciled with Him and be at peace; through these things good will come to you.
verses.hebrew: הַסְכֶּן־נָא עִמּוֹ וּשְׁלם בָּהֶם תְּבוֹאַתְךָ טוֹבָה׃

verses.english: Receive instruction from His mouth, and place His sayings in your heart.
verses.hebrew: קַח־נָא מִפִּיו תּוֹרָה וְשִׂים אֲמָרָיו בִּלְבָבֶךָ׃

verses.english: If you return to Shaddai, you will be built up; put wrongdoing far from your tents.
verses.hebrew: אִם־תָּשׁוּב עַד־שַׁדַּי תִּבָּנֶה תַּרְחִיק עַוְלָה מֵאָהֳלֶךָ׃

verses.english: Place gold ore upon the dust, and Ophir among the rocks of the torrents;
verses.hebrew: וְשִׁית־עַל־עָפָר בָּצֶר וּבְצוּר נְחָלִים אוֹפִיר׃

verses.english: then Shaddai will be your gold ore and precious silver to you.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה שַׁדַּי בְּצָרֶיךָ וְכֶסֶף תּוֹעָפוֹת לָךְ׃

verses.english: For then you will delight in Shaddai and lift your face toward God.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אָז עַל־שַׁדַּי תִּתְעַנָּג וְתִשָּׂא אֶל־אֱלוֹהַּ פָּנֶיךָ׃

verses.english: You will plead with Him, and He will hear you; you will fulfill your vows.
verses.hebrew: תַּעְתִּיר אֵלָיו וְיִשְׁמָעֶךָּ וּנְדָרֶיךָ תְשַׁלֵּם׃

verses.english: You will decide on a matter, and it will be established for you; light will shine upon your ways.
verses.hebrew: וְתִגְזַר־אוֹמֶר וְיָקָם לָךְ וְעַל־דְּרָכֶיךָ נָגַהּ אוֹר׃

verses.english: When they bring low, you will say, ‘A lifting up!’ He saves the one whose eyes are lowered.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִשְׁפִּילוּ וַתֹּאמֶר גֵּוָה וְשַׁח עֵינַיִם יוֹשִׁעַ׃

verses.english: He will deliver even the one who is not innocent; he will escape through the purity of your hands.”
verses.hebrew: יְמַלֵּט אִי־נָקִי וְנִמְלַט בְּבֹר כַּפֶּיךָ׃

verses.english: Job answered and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “Even today my complaint is rebellious; my hand is heavy over my groaning.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־הַיּוֹם מְרִי שִׂחִי יָדִי כָּבְדָה עַל־אַנְחָתִי׃

verses.english: If only I knew where to find Him! I would come even to His established place.
verses.hebrew: מִי־יִתֵּן יָדַעְתִּי וְאֶמְצָאֵהוּ אָבוֹא עַד־תְּכוּנָתוֹ׃

verses.english: I would arrange my case before Him and fill my mouth with arguments.
verses.hebrew: אֶעֶרְכָה לְפָנָיו מִשְׁפָּט וּפִי אֲמַלֵּא תוֹכָחוֹת׃

verses.english: I would know the words He would answer me and understand what He would say to me.
verses.hebrew: אֵדְעָה מִלִּים יַעֲנֵנִי וְאָבִינָה מַה־יֹּאמַר לִי׃

verses.english: Would He contend with me in the greatness of His strength? No; He would only pay attention to me.
verses.hebrew: הַבְּרָב־כֹּחַ יָרִיב עִמָּדִי לֹא אַךְ־הוּא יָשִׂם בִּי׃

verses.english: There an upright person could argue with Him, and I would escape forever from my Judge.
verses.hebrew: שָׁם יָשָׁר נוֹכָח עִמּוֹ וַאֲפַלְּטָה לָנֶצַח מִשֹּׁפְטִי׃

verses.english: Look, I go forward, but He is not there; backward, but I do not perceive Him.
verses.hebrew: הֵן קֶדֶם אֶהֱלֹךְ וְאֵינֶנּוּ וְאָחוֹר וְלֹא־אָבִין לוֹ׃

verses.english: To the left, where He works, I do not behold Him; He wraps Himself on the right, and I do not see.
verses.hebrew: שְׂמֹאול בַּעֲשֹׂתוֹ וְלֹא־אָחַז יַעְטֹף יָמִין וְלֹא אֶרְאֶה׃

verses.english: For He knows the way that is with me; when He has tested me, I will come out like gold.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־יָדַע דֶּרֶךְ עִמָּדִי בְּחָנַנִי כַּזָּהָב אֵצֵא׃

verses.english: My foot has held to His step; I have kept His way and have not turned aside.
verses.hebrew: בַּאֲשֻׁרוֹ אָחֲזָה רַגְלִי דַּרְכּוֹ שָׁמַרְתִּי וְלֹא־אָט׃

verses.english: I have not departed from the command of His lips; more than my allotted portion I have treasured the sayings of His mouth.
verses.hebrew: מִצְוַת שְׂפָתָיו וְלֹא אָמִישׁ מֵחֻקִּי צָפַנְתִּי אִמְרֵי־פִיו׃

verses.english: But He is one, and who can turn Him back? Whatever His soul desires, He does.
verses.hebrew: וְהוּא בְאֶחָד וּמִי יְשִׁיבֶנּוּ וְנַפְשׁוֹ אִוְּתָה וַיָּעַשׂ׃

verses.english: Therefore I am terrified before Him; I consider, and I am afraid of Him.
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן מִפָּנָיו אֶבָּהֵל אֶתְבּוֹנֵן וְאֶפְחַד מִמֶּנּוּ׃

verses.english: — [No additional Hebrew source unit.]
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן מִפָּנָיו אֶבָּהֵל אֶתְבּוֹנֵן וְאֶפְחַד מִמֶּנּוּ׃

verses.english: God has made my heart faint, and Shaddai has terrified me.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵל הֵרַךְ לִבִּי וְשַׁדַּי הִבְהִילָנִי׃

verses.english: For I was not cut off before darkness, and He concealed gloom from my face.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־לֹא נִצְמַתִּי מִפְּנֵי־חֹשֶׁךְ וּמִפָּנַי כִּסָּה־אֹפֶל׃

verses.english: “Why are times not stored up by Shaddai, and why do those who know Him not see His days?
verses.hebrew: מַדּוּעַ מִשַּׁדַּי לֹא־נִצְפְּנוּ עִתִּים וידעו [וְיֹדְעָיו] לֹא־חָזוּ יָמָיו׃

verses.english: People move boundary markers; they seize a flock and pasture it.
verses.hebrew: גְּבֻלוֹת יַשִּׂיגוּ עֵדֶר גָּזְלוּ וַיִּרְעוּ׃

verses.english: They drive away the orphan’s donkey; they take a widow’s ox as a pledge.
verses.hebrew: חֲמוֹר יְתוֹמִים יִנְהָגוּ יַחְבְּלוּ שׁוֹר אַלְמָנָה׃

verses.english: They push the needy off the road; the poor of the earth hide together.
verses.hebrew: יַטּוּ אֶבְיוֹנִים מִדָּרֶךְ יַחַד חֻבְּאוּ עֲנִיֵּי־אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Look, like wild donkeys in the wilderness, they go out to their labor, seeking food early; the wasteland provides him bread for the young.
verses.hebrew: הֵן פְּרָאִים בַּמִּדְבָּר יָצְאוּ בְּפָעֳלָם מְשַׁחֲרֵי לַטָּרֶף עֲרָבָה לוֹ לֶחֶם לַנְּעָרִים׃

verses.english: In a field they reap his fodder, and they glean the wicked man’s vineyard.
verses.hebrew: בַּשָּׂדֶה בְּלִילוֹ יקצירו [יִקְצוֹרוּ] וְכֶרֶם רָשָׁע יְלַקֵּשׁוּ׃

verses.english: They spend the night naked, without clothing, with no covering in the cold.
verses.hebrew: עָרוֹם יָלִינוּ מִבְּלִי לְבוּשׁ וְאֵין כְּסוּת בַּקָּרָה׃

verses.english: They are drenched by the mountain downpour and embrace a rock for lack of shelter.
verses.hebrew: מִזֶּרֶם הָרִים יִרְטָבוּ וּמִבְּלִי מַחְסֶה חִבְּקוּ־צוּר׃

verses.english: They snatch an orphan from the breast and take a pledge from the poor.
verses.hebrew: יִגְזְלוּ מִשֹּׁד יָתוֹם וְעַל־עָנִי יַחְבֹּלוּ׃

verses.english: They go about naked, without clothing, and carry sheaves while hungry.
verses.hebrew: עָרוֹם הִלְּכוּ בְּלִי לְבוּשׁ וּרְעֵבִים נָשְׂאוּ עֹמֶר׃

verses.english: Between their walls they press oil; they tread winepresses and remain thirsty.
verses.hebrew: בֵּין־שׁוּרֹתָם יַצְהִירוּ יְקָבִים דָּרְכוּ וַיִּצְמָאוּ׃

verses.english: From the city men groan, and the life of the wounded cries for help; yet God does not charge wrongdoing.
verses.hebrew: מֵעִיר מְתִים יִנְאָקוּ וְנֶפֶשׁ־חֲלָלִים תְּשַׁוֵּעַ וֶאֱלוֹהַּ לֹא־יָשִׂים תִּפְלָה׃

verses.english: They are among those who rebel against light; they do not recognize its ways and do not remain in its paths.
verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה הָיוּ בְּמֹרְדֵי־אוֹר לֹא־הִכִּירוּ דְרָכָיו וְלֹא יָשְׁבוּ בִּנְתִיבֹתָיו׃

verses.english: At the light the murderer rises; he kills the poor and needy, and at night he is like a thief.
verses.hebrew: לָאוֹר יָקוּם רוֹצֵחַ יִקְטָל־עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן וּבַלַּיְלָה יְהִי כַגַּנָּב׃

verses.english: The adulterer’s eye watches for twilight, saying, ‘No eye will behold me,’ and he puts a covering over his face.
verses.hebrew: וְעֵין נֹאֵף שָׁמְרָה נֶשֶׁף לֵאמֹר לֹא־תְשׁוּרֵנִי עָיִן וְסֵתֶר פָּנִים יָשִׂים׃

verses.english: In darkness he digs into houses; by day they shut themselves in; they do not know the light.
verses.hebrew: חָתַר בַּחֹשֶׁךְ בָּתִּים יוֹמָם חִתְּמוּ־לָמוֹ לֹא־יָדְעוּ אוֹר׃

verses.english: For morning is deep darkness to all of them; for he knows the terrors of deep darkness.
verses.hebrew: כִּי יַחְדָּו בֹּקֶר לָמוֹ צַלְמָוֶת כִּי־יַכִּיר בַּלְהוֹת צַלְמָוֶת׃

verses.english: He is swift upon the surface of water; may their portion in the land be cursed; he does not turn toward the way of vineyards.
verses.hebrew: קַל־הוּא עַל־פְּנֵי־מַיִם תְּקֻלַּל חֶלְקָתָם בָּאָרֶץ לֹא־יִפְנֶה דֶּרֶךְ כְּרָמִים׃

verses.english: Drought and heat snatch away snow-water; Sheol snatches those who have sinned.
verses.hebrew: צִיָּה גַם־חֹם יִגְזְלוּ מֵימֵי־שֶׁלֶג שְׁאוֹל חָטָאוּ׃

verses.english: The womb forgets him; worms find him sweet; he is remembered no more, and injustice is broken like a tree.
verses.hebrew: יִשְׁכָּחֵהוּ רֶחֶם מְתָקוֹ רִמָּה עוֹד לֹא־יִזָּכֵר וַתִּשָּׁבֵר כָּעֵץ עַוְלָה׃

verses.english: He preys on the barren woman who does not bear, and does no good to the widow.
verses.hebrew: רֹעֶה עֲקָרָה לֹא תֵלֵד וְאַלְמָנָה לֹא יְיֵטִיב׃

verses.english: He draws away the mighty by His strength; when He rises, no one is sure of life.
verses.hebrew: וּמָשַׁךְ אַבִּירִים בְּכֹחוֹ יָקוּם וְלֹא־יַאֲמִין בַּחַיִּין׃

verses.english: He gives him security, and he rests on it, but His eyes are upon their ways.
verses.hebrew: יִתֶּן־לוֹ לָבֶטַח וְיִשָּׁעֵן וְעֵינֵיהוּ עַל־דַּרְכֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: They are exalted for a little while, then he is no more; they are brought low and gathered in like everyone, cut off like the head of a grain stalk.
verses.hebrew: רוֹמּוּ מְּעַט וְאֵינֶנּוּ וְהֻמְּכוּ כַּכֹּל יִקָּפְצוּן וּכְרֹאשׁ שִׁבֹּלֶת יִמָּלוּ׃

verses.english: If it is not so, then who will prove me false and make my word amount to nothing?”
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־לֹא אֵפוֹ מִי יַכְזִיבֵנִי וְיָשֵׂם לְאַל מִלָּתִי׃

verses.english: Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן בִּלְדַּד הַשֻּׁחִי וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “Dominion and dread are with Him; He makes peace in His heights.
verses.hebrew: הַמְשֵׁל וָפַחַד עִמּוֹ עֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו׃

verses.english: Can His troops be numbered? Upon whom does His light not rise?
verses.hebrew: הֲיֵשׁ מִסְפָּר לִגְדוּדָיו וְעַל־מִי לֹא־יָקוּם אוֹרֵהוּ׃

verses.english: How can a mortal be righteous before God, and how can one born of woman be pure?
verses.hebrew: וּמַה־יִּצְדַּק אֱנוֹשׁ עִם־אֵל וּמַה־יִּזְכֶּה יְלוּד אִשָּׁה׃

verses.english: Look, even the moon does not shine brightly, and the stars are not pure in His eyes;
verses.hebrew: הֵן עַד־יָרֵחַ וְלֹא יַאֲהִיל וְכוֹכָבִים לֹא־זַכּוּ בְעֵינָיו׃

verses.english: how much less a mortal, a maggot, a son of humanity, a worm!”
verses.hebrew: אַף כִּי־אֱנוֹשׁ רִמָּה וּבֶן־אָדָם תּוֹלֵעָה׃

verses.english: Job answered and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “How you have helped one without strength, saved an arm without power!
verses.hebrew: מֶה־עָזַרְתָּ לְלֹא־כֹחַ הוֹשַׁעְתָּ זְרוֹעַ לֹא־עֹז׃

verses.english: How you have advised one without wisdom and made sound judgment abundantly known!
verses.hebrew: מַה־יָּעַצְתָּ לְלֹא חָכְמָה וְתוּשִׁיָּה לָרֹב הוֹדָעְתָּ׃

verses.english: To whom have you declared words, and whose breath has gone out from you?
verses.hebrew: אֶת־מִי הִגַּדְתָּ מִלִּין וְנִשְׁמַת־מִי יָצְאָה מִמֶּךָּ׃

verses.english: The shades writhe beneath the waters and their inhabitants.
verses.hebrew: הָרְפָאִים יְחוֹלָלוּ מִתַּחַת מַיִם וְשֹׁכְנֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Sheol is naked before Him, and Abaddon has no covering.
verses.hebrew: עָרוֹם שְׁאוֹל נֶגְדּוֹ וְאֵין כְּסוּת לָאֲבַדּוֹן׃

verses.english: He stretches the north over emptiness and hangs the earth upon nothing.
verses.hebrew: נֹטֶה צָפוֹן עַל־תֹּהוּ תֹּלֶה אֶרֶץ עַל־בְּלִי־מָה׃

verses.english: He binds waters in His clouds, and the cloud does not split beneath them.
verses.hebrew: צֹרֵר־מַיִם בְּעָבָיו וְלֹא־נִבְקַע עָנָן תַּחְתָּם׃

verses.english: He encloses the face of the throne, spreading His cloud over it.
verses.hebrew: מְאַחֵז פְּנֵי־כִסֵּה פַּרְשֵׁז עָלָיו עֲנָנוֹ׃

verses.english: He draws a circular boundary upon the waters’ face, at the limit of light with darkness.
verses.hebrew: חֹק־חָג עַל־פְּנֵי־מָיִם עַד־תַּכְלִית אוֹר עִם־חֹשֶׁךְ׃

verses.english: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at His rebuke.
verses.hebrew: עַמּוּדֵי שָׁמַיִם יְרוֹפָפוּ וְיִתְמְהוּ מִגַּעֲרָתוֹ׃

verses.english: By His strength He stirred the sea, and by His understanding He shattered Rahab.
verses.hebrew: בְּכֹחוֹ רָגַע הַיָּם ובתובנתו [וּבִתְבוּנָתוֹ] מָחַץ רָהַב׃

verses.english: By His breath the heavens are made fair; His hand pierced the fleeing serpent.
verses.hebrew: בְּרוּחוֹ שָׁמַיִם שִׁפְרָה חֹלֲלָה יָדוֹ נָחָשׁ בָּרִיחַ׃

verses.english: Look, these are the edges of His ways, and how faint a whisper of a word we hear of Him! But who can understand the thunder of His mighty deeds?”
verses.hebrew: הֶן־אֵלֶּה קְצוֹת דרכו [דְּרָכָיו] וּמַה־שֵּׁמֶץ דָּבָר נִשְׁמַע־בּוֹ וְרַעַם גבורתו [גְּבוּרוֹתָיו] מִי יִתְבּוֹנָן׃

verses.english: Job again took up his discourse and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף אִיּוֹב שְׂאֵת מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “As God lives, who has taken away my justice, and Shaddai, who has embittered my soul,
verses.hebrew: חַי־אֵל הֵסִיר מִשְׁפָּטִי וְשַׁדַּי הֵמַר נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: as long as my breath is in me and God’s spirit is in my nostrils,
verses.hebrew: כִּי־כָל־עוֹד נִשְׁמָתִי בִי וְרוּחַ אֱלוֹהַּ בְּאַפִּי׃

verses.english: my lips will not speak injustice, and my tongue will not utter deceit.
verses.hebrew: אִם־תְּדַבֵּרְנָה שְׂפָתַי עַוְלָה וּלְשׁוֹנִי אִם־יֶהְגֶּה רְמִיָּה׃

verses.english: Far be it from me to declare you righteous! Until I expire, I will not put my integrity away from me.
verses.hebrew: חָלִילָה לִּי אִם־אַצְדִּיק אֶתְכֶם עַד־אֶגְוָע לֹא־אָסִיר תֻּמָּתִי מִמֶּנִּי׃

verses.english: I hold fast to my righteousness and will not let it go; my heart will not reproach any of my days.
verses.hebrew: בְּצִדְקָתִי הֶחֱזַקְתִּי וְלֹא אַרְפֶּהָ לֹא־יֶחֱרַף לְבָבִי מִיָּמָי׃

verses.english: Let my enemy be like a wicked person, and the one rising against me like an unjust person.
verses.hebrew: יְהִי כְרָשָׁע אֹיְבִי וּמִתְקוֹמְמִי כְעַוָּל׃

verses.english: For what hope has the godless person when he gains, when God draws out his soul?
verses.hebrew: כִּי מַה־תִּקְוַת חָנֵף כִּי יִבְצָע כִּי יֵשֶׁל אֱלוֹהַּ נַפְשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: Will God hear his cry when distress comes upon him?
verses.hebrew: הַצַעֲקָתוֹ יִשְׁמַע אֵל כִּי־תָבוֹא עָלָיו צָרָה׃

verses.english: Will he delight in Shaddai and call upon God at every time?
verses.hebrew: אִם־עַל־שַׁדַּי יִתְעַנָּג יִקְרָא אֱלוֹהַּ בְּכָל־עֵת׃

verses.english: I will teach you concerning God’s hand; what is with Shaddai I will not conceal.
verses.hebrew: אוֹרֶה אֶתְכֶם בְּיַד־אֵל אֲשֶׁר עִם־שַׁדַּי לֹא אֲכַחֵד׃

verses.english: Look, all of you have seen it; why, then, do you become so utterly empty?
verses.hebrew: הֵן־אַתֶּם כֻּלְּכֶם חֲזִיתֶם וְלָמָּה־זֶּה הֶבֶל תֶּהְבָּלוּ׃

verses.english: This is the wicked person’s portion with God, and the inheritance the ruthless receive from Shaddai:
verses.hebrew: זֶה חֵלֶק־אָדָם רָשָׁע עִם־אֵל וְנַחֲלַת עָרִיצִים מִשַּׁדַּי יִקָּחוּ׃

verses.english: if his sons become many, they are for the sword, and his descendants will not have enough bread.
verses.hebrew: אִם־יִרְבּוּ בָנָיו לְמוֹ־חָרֶב וְצֶאֱצָאָיו לֹא יִשְׂבְּעוּ־לָחֶם׃

verses.english: His survivors will be buried by death, and his widows will not weep.
verses.hebrew: שרידו [שְׂרִידָיו] בַּמָּוֶת יִקָּבֵרוּ וְאַלְמְנֹתָיו לֹא תִבְכֶּינָה׃

verses.english: Though he heaps up silver like dust and prepares clothing like clay,
verses.hebrew: אִם־יִצְבֹּר כֶּעָפָר כָּסֶף וְכַחֹמֶר יָכִין מַלְבּוּשׁ׃

verses.english: he may prepare it, but the righteous will wear it, and the innocent will divide the silver.
verses.hebrew: יָכִין וְצַדִּיק יִלְבָּשׁ וְכֶסֶף נָקִי יַחֲלֹק׃

verses.english: He builds his house like a moth, like a shelter that a watchman makes.
verses.hebrew: בָּנָה כָעָשׁ בֵּיתוֹ וּכְסֻכָּה עָשָׂה נֹצֵר׃

verses.english: He lies down rich, but will not be gathered; he opens his eyes, and he is no more.
verses.hebrew: עָשִׁיר יִשְׁכַּב וְלֹא יֵאָסֵף עֵינָיו פָּקַח וְאֵינֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: Terrors overtake him like waters; a storm steals him away at night.
verses.hebrew: תַּשִּׂיגֵהוּ כַמַּיִם בַּלָּהוֹת לַיְלָה גְּנָבַתּוּ סוּפָה׃

verses.english: The east wind carries him off, and he is gone; it sweeps him from his place.
verses.hebrew: יִשָּׂאֵהוּ קָדִים וְיֵלַךְ וִישָׂעֲרֵהוּ מִמְּקֹמוֹ׃

verses.english: He hurls against him and does not spare; from his hand he desperately flees.
verses.hebrew: וְיַשְׁלֵךְ עָלָיו וְלֹא יַחְמֹל מִיָּדוֹ בָּרוֹחַ יִבְרָח׃

verses.english: He claps his hands over him and hisses at him from his place.”
verses.hebrew: יִשְׂפֹּק עָלֵימוֹ כַפֵּימוֹ וְיִשְׁרֹק עָלָיו מִמְּקֹמוֹ׃

verses.english: “For silver has a source, and gold a place where they refine it.
verses.hebrew: כִּי יֵשׁ לַכֶּסֶף מוֹצָא וּמָקוֹם לַזָּהָב יָזֹקּוּ׃

verses.english: Iron is taken from dust, and copper is poured from stone.
verses.hebrew: בַּרְזֶל מֵעָפָר יֻקָּח וְאֶבֶן יָצוּק נְחוּשָׁה׃

verses.english: A person puts an end to darkness and searches to every limit, for stone in gloom and deep darkness.
verses.hebrew: קֵץ שָׂם לַחֹשֶׁךְ וּלְכָל־תַּכְלִית הוּא חוֹקֵר אֶבֶן אֹפֶל וְצַלְמָוֶת׃

verses.english: He breaks open a shaft away from the settler; forgotten by the foot, they hang far from humanity and sway.
verses.hebrew: פָּרַץ נַחַל מֵעִם־גָּר הַנִּשְׁכָּחִים מִנִּי־רָגֶל דַּלּוּ מֵאֱנוֹשׁ נָעוּ׃

verses.english: Earth—from it comes bread, but beneath it is overturned as by fire.
verses.hebrew: אֶרֶץ מִמֶּנָּה יֵצֵא־לָחֶם וְתַחְתֶּיהָ נֶהְפַּךְ כְּמוֹ־אֵשׁ׃

verses.english: Its stones are the place of sappir, and it has dust of gold.
verses.hebrew: מְקוֹם־סַפִּיר אֲבָנֶיהָ וְעַפְרֹת זָהָב לוֹ׃

verses.english: A path no bird of prey knows, that the kite’s eye has not glimpsed,
verses.hebrew: נָתִיב לֹא־יְדָעוֹ עָיִט וְלֹא שְׁזָפַתּוּ עֵין אַיָּה׃

verses.english: that proud beasts have not trodden, nor a lion passed over—
verses.hebrew: לֹא־הִדְרִיכֻהוּ בְנֵי־שָׁחַץ לֹא־עָדָה עָלָיו שָׁחַל׃

verses.english: he stretches his hand against flint and overturns mountains from their roots.
verses.hebrew: בַּחַלָּמִישׁ שָׁלַח יָדוֹ הָפַךְ מִשֹּׁרֶשׁ הָרִים׃

verses.english: He splits channels in the rocks, and his eye sees every precious thing.
verses.hebrew: בַּצּוּרוֹת יְאֹרִים בִּקֵּעַ וְכָל־יְקָר רָאֲתָה עֵינוֹ׃

verses.english: He binds streams so they do not trickle, and brings hidden things out to light.
verses.hebrew: מִבְּכִי נְהָרוֹת חִבֵּשׁ וְתַעֲלֻמָהּ יֹצִא אוֹר׃

verses.english: But where can wisdom be found, and where is the place of understanding?
verses.hebrew: וְהַחָכְמָה מֵאַיִן תִּמָּצֵא וְאֵי זֶה מְקוֹם בִּינָה׃

verses.english: A mortal does not know its worth, and it is not found in the land of the living.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יָדַע אֱנוֹשׁ עֶרְכָּהּ וְלֹא תִמָּצֵא בְּאֶרֶץ הַחַיִּים׃

verses.english: The deep says, ‘It is not in me,’ and the sea says, ‘It is not with me.’
verses.hebrew: תְּהוֹם אָמַר לֹא בִי־הִיא וְיָם אָמַר אֵין עִמָּדִי׃

verses.english: Closed-up gold cannot be given for it, nor can silver be weighed as its price.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יֻתַּן סְגוֹר תַּחְתֶּיהָ וְלֹא יִשָּׁקֵל כֶּסֶף מְחִירָהּ׃

verses.english: It cannot be weighed against Ophir gold, precious shoham or sappir.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־תְסֻלֶּה בְּכֶתֶם אוֹפִיר בְּשֹׁהַם יָקָר וְסַפִּיר׃

verses.english: Gold and glass cannot equal it, nor can vessels of fine gold be its exchange.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יַעַרְכֶנָּה זָהָב וּזְכוֹכִית וּתְמוּרָתָהּ כְּלִי־פָז׃

verses.english: Coral and crystal are not worth mentioning; the drawing of wisdom is beyond precious stones.
verses.hebrew: רָאמוֹת וְגָבִישׁ לֹא יִזָּכֵר וּמֶשֶׁךְ חָכְמָה מִפְּנִינִים׃

verses.english: The pitdah of Cush cannot equal it; it cannot be weighed against pure gold.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יַעַרְכֶנָּה פִּטְדַת־כּוּשׁ בְּכֶתֶם טָהוֹר לֹא תְסֻלֶּה׃

verses.english: From where, then, does wisdom come, and where is the place of understanding?
verses.hebrew: וְהַחָכְמָה מֵאַיִן תָּבוֹא וְאֵי זֶה מְקוֹם בִּינָה׃

verses.english: It is hidden from the eyes of every living thing and concealed from the birds of the heavens.
verses.hebrew: וְנֶעֶלְמָה מֵעֵינֵי כָל־חָי וּמֵעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם נִסְתָּרָה׃

verses.english: Abaddon and Death say, ‘With our ears we have heard a report of it.’
verses.hebrew: אֲבַדּוֹן וָמָוֶת אָמְרוּ בְּאָזְנֵינוּ שָׁמַעְנוּ שִׁמְעָהּ׃

verses.english: God understands its way, and He knows its place.
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים הֵבִין דַּרְכָּהּ וְהוּא יָדַע אֶת־מְקוֹמָהּ׃

verses.english: For He looks to the ends of the earth and sees everything beneath the heavens,
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הוּא לִקְצוֹת־הָאָרֶץ יַבִּיט תַּחַת כָּל־הַשָּׁמַיִם יִרְאֶה׃

verses.english: when He made a weight for the wind and apportioned the waters by measure,
verses.hebrew: לַעֲשׂוֹת לָרוּחַ מִשְׁקָל וּמַיִם תִּכֵּן בְּמִדָּה׃

verses.english: when He made a statute for rain and a way for the lightning of thunder,
verses.hebrew: בַּעֲשֹׂתוֹ לַמָּטָר חֹק וְדֶרֶךְ לַחֲזִיז קֹלוֹת׃

verses.english: then He saw wisdom and declared it; He established it and also searched it out.
verses.hebrew: אָז רָאָהּ וַיְסַפְּרָהּ הֱכִינָהּ וְגַם־חֲקָרָהּ׃

verses.english: And He said to humankind, ‘Look, the fear of the Lord—that is wisdom, and turning from evil is understanding.’
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָאָדָם הֵן יִרְאַת אֲדֹנָי הִיא חָכְמָה וְסוּר מֵרָע בִּינָה׃

verses.english: Job again took up his discourse and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף אִיּוֹב שְׂאֵת מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “If only I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God guarded me,
verses.hebrew: מִי־יִתְּנֵנִי כְיַרְחֵי־קֶדֶם כִּימֵי אֱלוֹהַּ יִשְׁמְרֵנִי׃

verses.english: when His lamp shone over my head, and by His light I walked through darkness,
verses.hebrew: בְּהִלּוֹ נֵרוֹ עֲלֵי רֹאשִׁי לְאוֹרוֹ אֵלֶךְ חֹשֶׁךְ׃

verses.english: as I was in the days of my prime, when God’s intimate counsel was over my tent,
verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר הָיִיתִי בִּימֵי חָרְפִּי בְּסוֹד אֱלוֹהַּ עֲלֵי אָהֳלִי׃

verses.english: when Shaddai was still with me and my young ones surrounded me,
verses.hebrew: רָאוּנִי נְעָרִים וְנֶחְבָּאוּ וִישִׁישִׁים קָמוּ עָמָדוּ׃

verses.english: when my steps were washed in curds and the rock poured streams of oil beside me,
verses.hebrew: בִּרְחֹץ הֲלִיכַי בְּחֵמָה וְצוּר יָצוּק עִמָּדִי פַּלְגֵי־שָׁמֶן׃

verses.english: when I went out to the gate by the city and set my seat in the square.
verses.hebrew: בְּצֵאתִי שַׁעַר עֲלֵי־קָרֶת בָּרְחוֹב אָכִין מוֹשָׁבִי׃

verses.english: Young men saw me and hid, and old men rose and stood.
verses.hebrew: רָאוּנִי נְעָרִים וְנֶחְבָּאוּ וִישִׁישִׁים קָמוּ עָמָדוּ׃

verses.english: Officials held back their words and placed a hand over their mouths.
verses.hebrew: שָׂרִים עָצְרוּ בְמִלִּים וְכַף יָשִׂימוּ לְפִיהֶם׃

verses.english: The voice of nobles was hushed, and their tongues clung to their palates.
verses.hebrew: קוֹל־נְגִידִים נֶחְבָּאוּ וּלְשׁוֹנָם לְחִכָּם דָּבֵקָה׃

verses.english: For the ear that heard called me blessed, and the eye that saw bore witness for me.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֹזֶן שָׁמְעָה וַתְּאַשְּׁרֵנִי וְעַיִן רָאֲתָה וַתְּעִידֵנִי׃

verses.english: For I delivered the poor who cried for help, and the orphan who had no helper.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אֲמַלֵּט עָנִי מְשַׁוֵּעַ וְיָתוֹם וְלֹא־עֹזֵר לוֹ׃

verses.english: The blessing of the perishing came upon me, and I made the widow’s heart sing for joy.
verses.hebrew: בִּרְכַּת אֹבֵד עָלַי תָּבֹא וְלֵב אַלְמָנָה אַרְנִן׃

verses.english: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me; my justice was like a robe and a turban.
verses.hebrew: צֶדֶק לָבַשְׁתִּי וַיִּלְבָּשֵׁנִי כִּמְעִיל וְצָנִיף מִשְׁפָּטִי׃

verses.english: I was eyes to the blind and feet to the lame.
verses.hebrew: עֵינַיִם הָיִיתִי לַעִוֵּר וְרַגְלַיִם לַפִּסֵּחַ אָנִי׃

verses.english: I was a father to the needy, and I investigated a case I did not know.
verses.hebrew: אָב אָנֹכִי לָאֶבְיוֹנִים וְרִב לֹא־יָדַעְתִּי אֶחְקְרֵהוּ׃

verses.english: I broke the jaws of the unjust and cast the prey out of his teeth.
verses.hebrew: וָאֲשַׁבְּרָה מְתַלְּעוֹת עַוָּל וּמִשִּׁנָּיו אַשְׁלִיךְ טָרֶף׃

verses.english: I said, ‘I will expire with my nest, and multiply my days like sand.
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר עִם־קִנִּי אֶגְוָע וְכַחוֹל אַרְבֶּה יָמִים׃

verses.english: My root is spread toward water, and dew lodges on my branches.
verses.hebrew: שָׁרְשִׁי פָתוּחַ אֱלֵי־מָיִם וְטַל יָלִין בִּקְצִירִי׃

verses.english: My glory remains fresh with me, and my bow is renewed in my hand.’
verses.hebrew: כְּבוֹדִי חָדָשׁ עִמָּדִי וְקַשְׁתִּי בְּיָדִי תַחֲלִיף׃

verses.english: They listened to me and waited; they kept silent for my counsel.
verses.hebrew: לִי־שָׁמְעוּ וְיִחֵלּוּ וְיִדְּמוּ לְמוֹ עֲצָתִי׃

verses.english: After my word they did not speak again, and my speech dropped gently upon them.
verses.hebrew: אַחֲרֵי דְבָרִי לֹא יִשְׁנוּ וְעָלֵימוֹ תִּטֹּף מִלָּתִי׃

verses.english: They waited for me as for rain and opened their mouths for the late rain.
verses.hebrew: וְיִחֲלוּ כַמָּטָר לִי וּפִיהֶם פָּעֲרוּ לְמַלְקוֹשׁ׃

verses.english: I smiled toward them when they did not believe, and they did not cast down the light of my face.
verses.hebrew: אֶשְׂחַק אֲלֵהֶם לֹא יַאֲמִינוּ וְאוֹר פָּנַי לֹא יַפִּילוּן׃

verses.english: I chose their way and sat as chief; I dwelt like a king among a troop, like one who comforts mourners.”
verses.hebrew: אֶבֲחַר דַּרְכָּם וְאֵשֵׁב רֹאשׁ וְאֶשְׁכּוֹן כְּמֶלֶךְ בַּגְּדוּד כַּאֲשֶׁר אֲבֵלִים יְנַחֵם׃

verses.english: “But now those younger than I in days laugh at me, whose fathers I refused to place with the dogs of my flock.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שָׂחֲקוּ עָלַי צְעִירִים מִמֶּנִּי לְיָמִים אֲשֶׁר־מָאַסְתִּי אֲבוֹתָם לָשִׁית עִם־כַּלְבֵי צֹאנִי׃

verses.english: What use to me was even their hands’ strength? Vigor had perished in them.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־כֹּחַ יְדֵיהֶם לָמָּה לִּי עָלֵימוֹ אָבַד כָּלַח׃

verses.english: Wasted by want and hunger, they gnaw the dry ground, yesterday’s desolation and waste,
verses.hebrew: בְּחֶסֶר וּבְכָפָן גַּלְמוּד הַעֹרְקִים צִיָּה אֶמֶשׁ שׁוֹאָה וּמְשֹׁאָה׃

verses.english: plucking salt plants beside the bushes, with broom roots as their bread.
verses.hebrew: הַקֹּטְפִים מַלּוּחַ עֲלֵי־שִׂיחַ וְשֹׁרֶשׁ רְתָמִים לַחְמָם׃

verses.english: They are driven from the community; people shout against them as against a thief,
verses.hebrew: מִן־גֵּו יְגֹרָשׁוּ יָרִיעוּ עָלֵימוֹ כַּגַּנָּב׃

verses.english: to dwell in the clefts of ravines, in holes of earth and rocks.
verses.hebrew: בַּעֲרוּץ נְחָלִים לִשְׁכֹּן חֹרֵי עָפָר וְכֵפִים׃

verses.english: Among bushes they bray; under nettles they huddle,
verses.hebrew: בֵּין־שִׂיחִים יִנְהָקוּ תַּחַת חָרוּל יְסֻפָּחוּ׃

verses.english: sons of fools, even sons without a name, whipped out of the land.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־נָבָל גַּם־בְּנֵי בְלִי־שֵׁם נִכְּאוּ מִן־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: But now I have become their mocking song, and I am a byword to them.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה נְגִינָתָם הָיִיתִי וָאֱהִי לָהֶם לְמִלָּה׃

verses.english: They abhor me and stay far away; they do not withhold spit from my face.
verses.hebrew: תִּעֲבוּנִי רָחֲקוּ מֶנִּי וּמִפָּנַי לֹא־חָשְׂכוּ רֹק׃

verses.english: For He loosened His cord and afflicted me, and they cast off the bridle before me.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־יתרו [יִתְרִי] פִתַּח וַיְעַנֵּנִי וְרֶסֶן מִפָּנַי שִׁלֵּחוּ׃

verses.english: At my right a brood rises; they push my feet away and raise their roads of calamity against me.
verses.hebrew: עַל־יָמִין פִּרְחַח יָקוּמוּ רַגְלַי שִׁלֵּחוּ וַיָּסֹלּוּ עָלַי אָרְחוֹת אֵידָם׃

verses.english: They tear up my path and advance my ruin; they have no helper.
verses.hebrew: נָתְסוּ נְתִיבָתִי לְהַוָּתִי יֹעִילוּ לֹא עֹזֵר לָמוֹ׃

verses.english: They come as through a wide breach; amid devastation they roll onward.
verses.hebrew: כְּפֶרֶץ רָחָב יֶאֱתָיוּ תַּחַת שֹׁאָה הִתְגַּלְגָּלוּ׃

verses.english: Terrors are turned against me; my dignity is pursued like wind, and my deliverance passes like a cloud.
verses.hebrew: הָהְפַּךְ עָלַי בַּלָּהוֹת תִּרְדֹּף כָּרוּחַ נְדִבָתִי וּכְעָב עָבְרָה יְשֻׁעָתִי׃

verses.english: And now my soul pours itself out upon me; days of affliction seize me.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה עָלַי תִּשְׁתַּפֵּךְ נַפְשִׁי יֹאחֲזוּנִי יְמֵי־עֹנִי׃

verses.english: Night pierces my bones from off me, and my gnawing pains do not lie down.
verses.hebrew: לַיְלָה עֲצָמַי נִקַּר מֵעָלָי וְעֹרְקַי לֹא יִשְׁכָּבוּן׃

verses.english: With great force my garment is distorted; it binds me like the collar of my tunic.
verses.hebrew: בְּרָב־כֹּחַ יִתְחַפֵּשׂ לְבוּשִׁי כְּפִי כֻתָּנְתִּי יַאַזְרֵנִי׃

verses.english: He cast me into clay, and I have become like dust and ashes.
verses.hebrew: הֹרָנִי לַחֹמֶר וָאֶתְמַשֵּׁל כֶּעָפָר וָאֵפֶר׃

verses.english: I cry to You, but You do not answer; I stand, and You gaze at me.
verses.hebrew: אֲשַׁוַּע אֵלֶיךָ וְלֹא תַעֲנֵנִי עָמַדְתִּי וַתִּתְבֹּנֶן בִּי׃

verses.english: You have turned cruel toward me; with the strength of Your hand You oppose me.
verses.hebrew: תֵּהָפֵךְ לְאַכְזָר לִי בְּעֹצֶם יָדְךָ תִשְׂטְמֵנִי׃

verses.english: You lift me to the wind and make me ride; You dissolve me in my substance.
verses.hebrew: תִּשָּׂאֵנִי אֶל־רוּחַ תַּרְכִּיבֵנִי וּתְמֹגְגֵנִי תשוה [תּוּשִׁיָּה׃]

verses.english: For I know You will bring me back to death, to the house appointed for every living thing.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־יָדַעְתִּי מָוֶת תְּשִׁיבֵנִי וּבֵית מוֹעֵד לְכָל־חָי׃

verses.english: Yet does one not stretch out a hand in ruin, when in his disaster there is a cry for them?
verses.hebrew: כִּי טוֹב קִוִּיתִי וַיָּבֹא רָע וַאֲיַחֲלָה לְאוֹר וַיָּבֹא אֹפֶל׃

verses.english: Did I not weep for one whose day was hard? Did not my soul grieve for the needy?
verses.hebrew: אִם־לֹא בָכִיתִי לִקְשֵׁה־יוֹם עָגְמָה נַפְשִׁי לָאֶבְיוֹן׃

verses.english: For I hoped for good, but evil came; I waited for light, but gloom came.
verses.hebrew: כִּי טוֹב קִוִּיתִי וַיָּבֹא רָע וַאֲיַחֲלָה לְאוֹר וַיָּבֹא אֹפֶל׃

verses.english: My inward parts boil and do not become still; days of affliction have met me.
verses.hebrew: מֵעַי רֻתְּחוּ וְלֹא־דָמּוּ קִדְּמֻנִי יְמֵי־עֹנִי׃

verses.english: I go about darkened, without the sun; I rise in the assembly and cry for help.
verses.hebrew: קֹדֵר הִלַּכְתִּי בְּלֹא חַמָּה קַמְתִּי בַקָּהָל אֲשַׁוֵּעַ׃

verses.english: I have become a brother to jackals and a companion to ostriches.
verses.hebrew: אָח הָיִיתִי לְתַנִּים וְרֵעַ לִבְנוֹת יַעֲנָה׃

verses.english: My skin has blackened upon me, and my bones burn from heat.
verses.hebrew: עוֹרִי שָׁחַר מֵעָלָי וְעַצְמִי־חָרָה מִנִּי־חֹרֶב׃

verses.english: My lyre has turned to mourning, and my pipe to the sound of weepers.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לְאֵבֶל כִּנֹּרִי וְעֻגָבִי לְקוֹל בֹּכִים׃

verses.english: “I made a covenant with my eyes; how, then, could I gaze intently at a virgin?
verses.hebrew: בְּרִית כָּרַתִּי לְעֵינָי וּמָה אֶתְבּוֹנֵן עַל־בְּתוּלָה׃

verses.english: What would be God’s portion from above, and Shaddai’s inheritance from the heights?
verses.hebrew: וּמֶה חֵלֶק אֱלוֹהַּ מִמָּעַל וְנַחֲלַת שַׁדַּי מִמְּרֹמִים׃

verses.english: Is it not calamity for the unjust, and disaster for those who do wrongdoing?
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־אֵיד לְעַוָּל וְנֵכֶר לְפֹעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃

verses.english: Does He not see my ways and count all my steps?
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־הוּא יִרְאֶה דְרָכָי וְכָל־צְעָדַי יִסְפּוֹר׃

verses.english: If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried toward deceit,
verses.hebrew: אִם־הָלַכְתִּי עִם־שָׁוְא וַתַּחַשׁ עַל־מִרְמָה רַגְלִי׃

verses.english: let Him weigh me in just scales, and let God know my integrity.
verses.hebrew: יִשְׁקְלֵנִי בְמֹאזְנֵי־צֶדֶק וְיֵדַע אֱלוֹהַּ תֻּמָּתִי׃

verses.english: If my step has turned from the way, my heart followed my eyes, or a stain clung to my hands,
verses.hebrew: אִם תִּטֶּה אַשֻּׁרִי מִנִּי הַדָּרֶךְ וְאַחַר עֵינַי הָלַךְ לִבִּי וּבְכַפַּי דָּבַק מֻאוּם׃

verses.english: let me sow and another eat, and let my offspring be uprooted.
verses.hebrew: אֶזְרְעָה וְאַחֵר יֹאכֵל וְצֶאֱצָאַי יְשֹׁרָשׁוּ׃

verses.english: If my heart has been enticed by a woman, and I have lain in wait at my neighbor’s door,
verses.hebrew: אִם־נִפְתָּה לִבִּי עַל־אִשָּׁה וְעַל־פֶּתַח רֵעִי אָרָבְתִּי׃

verses.english: let my wife grind for another, and let others bend over her.
verses.hebrew: תִּטְחַן לְאַחֵר אִשְׁתִּי וְעָלֶיהָ יִכְרְעוּן אֲחֵרִין׃

verses.english: For that is a shameful deed, and an offense for judges;
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הוא [הִיא] זִמָּה והיא [וְהוּא] עָוֺן פְּלִילִים׃

verses.english: for it is a fire that consumes to Abaddon and uproots all my produce.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵשׁ הִיא עַד־אֲבַדּוֹן תֹּאכֵל וּבְכָל־תְּבוּאָתִי תְשָׁרֵשׁ׃

verses.english: If I rejected the claim of my servant or maidservant when they disputed with me,
verses.hebrew: אִם־אֶמְאַס מִשְׁפַּט עַבְדִּי וַאֲמָתִי בְּרִבָם עִמָּדִי׃

verses.english: what would I do when God rose up, and what would I answer Him when He inspected?
verses.hebrew: וּמָה אֶעֱשֶׂה כִּי־יָקוּם אֵל וְכִי־יִפְקֹד מָה אֲשִׁיבֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: Did not He who made me in the womb make him, and did not One establish us in the womb?
verses.hebrew: הֲ‍לֹא־בַבֶּטֶן עֹשֵׂנִי עָשָׂהוּ וַיְכֻנֶנּוּ בָּרֶחֶם אֶחָד׃

verses.english: If I withheld what the poor desired or made a widow’s eyes fail,
verses.hebrew: אִם־אֶמְנַע מֵחֵפֶץ דַּלִּים וְעֵינֵי אַלְמָנָה אֲכַלֶּה׃

verses.english: or ate my morsel alone, while the orphan did not eat from it—
verses.hebrew: וְאֹכַל פִּתִּי לְבַדִּי וְלֹא־אָכַל יָתוֹם מִמֶּנָּה׃

verses.english: for from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, and from my mother’s womb I guided her—
verses.hebrew: כִּי מִנְּעוּרַי גְּדֵלַנִי כְאָב וּמִבֶּטֶן אִמִּי אַנְחֶנָּה׃

verses.english: if I saw someone perishing without clothing, or a needy person with no covering,
verses.hebrew: אִם־אֶרְאֶה אוֹבֵד מִבְּלִי לְבוּשׁ וְאֵין כְּסוּת לָאֶבְיוֹן׃

verses.english: if his loins did not bless me, and he was not warmed by the fleece of my sheep,
verses.hebrew: אִם־לֹא בֵרֲכוּנִי חלצו [חֲלָצָיו] וּמִגֵּז כְּבָשַׂי יִתְחַמָּם׃

verses.english: if I raised my hand against an orphan because I saw support for myself at the gate,
verses.hebrew: אִם־הֲנִיפוֹתִי עַל־יָתוֹם יָדִי כִּי־אֶרְאֶה בַשַּׁעַר עֶזְרָתִי׃

verses.english: let my shoulder fall from its shoulder blade, and my arm break from its socket.
verses.hebrew: כְּתֵפִי מִשִּׁכְמָה תִפּוֹל וְאֶזְרֹעִי מִקָּנָה תִשָּׁבֵר׃

verses.english: For calamity from God was a terror to me, and I could not endure His majesty.
verses.hebrew: כִּי פַחַד אֵלַי אֵיד אֵל וּמִשְּׂאֵתוֹ לֹא אוּכָל׃

verses.english: If I made gold my confidence or said to fine gold, ‘My trust,’
verses.hebrew: אִם־שַׂמְתִּי זָהָב כִּסְלִי וְלַכֶּתֶם אָמַרְתִּי מִבְטַחִי׃

verses.english: if I rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand acquired much,
verses.hebrew: אִם־אֶשְׂמַח כִּי־רַב חֵילִי וְכִי־כַבִּיר מָצְאָה יָדִי׃

verses.english: if I saw the light when it shone, or the moon moving in splendor,
verses.hebrew: אִם־אֶרְאֶה אוֹר כִּי יָהֵל וְיָרֵחַ יָקָר הֹלֵךְ׃

verses.english: and my heart was secretly enticed, and my hand kissed my mouth,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְתְּ בַּסֵּתֶר לִבִּי וַתִּשַּׁק יָדִי לְפִי׃

verses.english: that too would be a judicial offense, for I would have denied God above.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־הוּא עָוֺן פְּלִילִי כִּי־כִחַשְׁתִּי לָאֵל מִמָּעַל׃

verses.english: If I rejoiced at the disaster of one who hated me, or exulted when evil found him—
verses.hebrew: אִם־אֶשְׂמַח בְּפִיד מְשַׂנְאִי וְהִתְעֹרַרְתִּי כִּי־מְצָאוֹ רָע׃

verses.english: I did not allow my palate to sin by asking for his life with a curse—
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־נָתַתִּי לַחֲטֹא חִכִּי לִשְׁאֹל בְּאָלָה נַפְשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: if the men of my tent did not say, ‘Who can point to someone not filled with his meat?’—
verses.hebrew: אִם־לֹא אָמְרוּ מְתֵי אָהֳלִי מִי־יִתֵּן מִבְּשָׂרוֹ לֹא נִשְׂבָּע׃

verses.english: no stranger spent the night outside; I opened my doors to the traveler—
verses.hebrew: בַּחוּץ לֹא־יָלִין גֵּר דְּלָתַי לָאֹרַח אֶפְתָּח׃

verses.english: if I covered my transgressions like a human, hiding my guilt in my breast,
verses.hebrew: אִם־כִּסִּיתִי כְאָדָם פְּשָׁעָי לִטְמוֹן בְּחֻבִּי עֲוֺנִי׃

verses.english: because I feared the great crowd, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I was silent and did not go out the door—
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֶעֱרוֹץ הָמוֹן רַבָּה וּבוּז־מִשְׁפָּחוֹת יְחִתֵּנִי וָאֶדֹּם לֹא־אֵצֵא פָתַח׃

verses.english: if only I had someone to hear me! Look, here is my mark; let Shaddai answer me! If only my adversary had written a document!
verses.hebrew: מִי יִתֶּן־לִי שֹׁמֵעַ לִי הֶן־תָּוִי שַׁדַּי יַעֲנֵנִי וְסֵפֶר כָּתַב אִישׁ רִיבִי׃

verses.english: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder and bind it upon myself like crowns.
verses.hebrew: אִם־לֹא עַל־שִׁכְמִי אֶשָּׂאֶנּוּ אֶעֶנְדֶנּוּ עֲטָרוֹת לִי׃

verses.english: I would tell Him the number of my steps; like a prince I would approach Him.
verses.hebrew: מִסְפַּר צְעָדַי אַגִּידֶנּוּ כְּמוֹ־נָגִיד אֲקָרֲבֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: if my land cried out against me, and its furrows wept together,
verses.hebrew: אִם־עָלַי אַדְמָתִי תִזְעָק וְיַחַד תְּלָמֶיהָ יִבְכָּיוּן׃

verses.english: if I ate its yield without payment or caused its owners’ lives to expire,
verses.hebrew: אִם־כֹּחָהּ אָכַלְתִּי בְלִי־כָסֶף וְנֶפֶשׁ בְּעָלֶיהָ הִפָּחְתִּי׃

verses.english: let thorn grow instead of wheat, and foul weeds instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended.
verses.hebrew: תַּחַת חִטָּה יֵצֵא חוֹחַ וְתַחַת־שְׂעֹרָה בָאְשָׁה תַּמּוּ דִּבְרֵי אִיּוֹב׃

verses.english: These three men ceased answering Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁבְּתוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה מֵעֲנוֹת אֶת־אִיּוֹב כִּי הוּא צַדִּיק בְּעֵינָיו׃

verses.english: Then the anger of Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram, burned. His anger burned against Job because he justified himself rather than God.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר אַף אֱלִיהוּא בֶן־בַּרַכְאֵל הַבּוּזִי מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת רָם בְּאִיּוֹב חָרָה אַפּוֹ עַל־צַדְּקוֹ נַפְשׁוֹ מֵאֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: His anger also burned against his three friends, because they had found no answer, yet condemned Job.
verses.hebrew: וּבִשְׁלֹשֶׁת רֵעָיו חָרָה אַפּוֹ עַל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־מָצְאוּ מַעֲנֶה וַיַּרְשִׁיעוּ אֶת־אִיּוֹב׃

verses.english: Elihu had waited for Job in the matter of words, because they were older than he in days.
verses.hebrew: וֶאֱלִיהוּ חִכָּה אֶת־אִיּוֹב בִּדְבָרִים כִּי זְקֵנִים־הֵמָּה מִמֶּנּוּ לְיָמִים׃

verses.english: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of the three men, his anger burned.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֱלִיהוּא כִּי אֵין מַעֲנֶה בְּפִי שְׁלֹשֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיִּחַר אַפּוֹ׃

verses.english: Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said: “I am young in days, and you are aged; therefore I shrank back and feared to declare my knowledge to you.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אֱלִיהוּא בֶן־בַּרַכְאֵל הַבּוּזִי וַיֹּאמַר צָעִיר אֲנִי לְיָמִים וְאַתֶּם יְשִׁישִׁים עַל־כֵּן זָחַלְתִּי וָאִירָא מֵחַוֺּת דֵּעִי אֶתְכֶם׃

verses.english: I said, ‘Days should speak, and many years should make wisdom known.’
verses.hebrew: אָמַרְתִּי יָמִים יְדַבֵּרוּ וְרֹב שָׁנִים יֹדִיעוּ חָכְמָה׃

verses.english: Yet it is a spirit in a mortal, and Shaddai’s breath gives them understanding.
verses.hebrew: אָכֵן רוּחַ־הִיא בֶאֱנוֹשׁ וְנִשְׁמַת שַׁדַּי תְּבִינֵם׃

verses.english: It is not the great who are wise, nor the old who understand justice.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־רַבִּים יֶחְכָּמוּ וּזְקֵנִים יָבִינוּ מִשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I too will declare my knowledge.’
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן אָמַרְתִּי שִׁמְעָה־לִּי אֲחַוֶּה דֵּעִי אַף־אָנִי׃

verses.english: Look, I waited for your words; I listened for your understandings while you searched for words.
verses.hebrew: הֵן הוֹחַלְתִּי לְדִבְרֵיכֶם אָזִין עַד־תְּבוּנֹתֵיכֶם עַד־תַּחְקְרוּן מִלִּין׃

verses.english: I paid close attention to you, and look, none of you refuted Job or answered his sayings.
verses.hebrew: וְעָדֵיכֶם אֶתְבּוֹנָן וְהִנֵּה אֵין לְאִיּוֹב מוֹכִיחַ עוֹנֶה אֲמָרָיו מִכֶּם׃

verses.english: Do not say, ‘We have found wisdom; God will drive him away, not a man.’
verses.hebrew: פֶּן־תֹּאמְרוּ מָצָאנוּ חָכְמָה אֵל יִדְּפֶנּוּ לֹא־אִישׁ׃

verses.english: He did not arrange his words against me, and I will not answer him with your sayings.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־עָרַךְ אֵלַי מִלִּין וּבְאִמְרֵיכֶם לֹא אֲשִׁיבֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: They are dismayed and answer no more; words have departed from them.
verses.hebrew: חַתּוּ לֹא־עָנוּ עוֹד הֶעְתִּיקוּ מֵהֶם מִלִּים׃

verses.english: Shall I wait because they do not speak, because they stand and answer no more?
verses.hebrew: וְהוֹחַלְתִּי כִּי־לֹא יְדַבֵּרוּ כִּי עָמְדוּ לֹא־עָנוּ עוֹד׃

verses.english: I too will answer my part; I too will declare my knowledge.
verses.hebrew: אַעֲנֶה אַף־אֲנִי חֶלְקִי אֲחַוֶּה דֵעִי אַף־אָנִי׃

verses.english: For I am full of words; the spirit of my belly presses me.
verses.hebrew: כִּי מָלֵתִי מִלִּים הֱצִיקַתְנִי רוּחַ בִּטְנִי׃

verses.english: Look, my belly is like unopened wine; like new wineskins it is about to burst.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה־בִטְנִי כְּיַיִן לֹא־יִפָּתֵחַ כְּאֹבוֹת חֲדָשִׁים יִבָּקֵעַ׃

verses.english: Let me speak, so that I may have relief; let me open my lips and answer.
verses.hebrew: אֲדַבְּרָה וְיִרְוַח־לִי אֶפְתַּח שְׂפָתַי וְאֶעֱנֶה׃

verses.english: Let me not show partiality to a person, and I will not flatter a human.
verses.hebrew: אַל־נָא אֶשָּׂא פְנֵי־אִישׁ וְאֶל־אָדָם לֹא אֲכַנֶּה׃

verses.english: For I do not know how to flatter; my Maker would soon carry me away.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא יָדַעְתִּי אֲכַנֶּה כִּמְעַט יִשָּׂאֵנִי עֹשֵׂנִי׃

verses.english: “But now, Job, listen to my words; give ear to all I say.
verses.hebrew: וְאוּלָם שְׁמַע־נָא אִיּוֹב מִלָּי וְכָל־דְּבָרַי הַאֲזִינָה׃

verses.english: Look now, I have opened my mouth; my tongue speaks within my palate.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה־נָא פָּתַחְתִּי פִי דִּבְּרָה לְשׁוֹנִי בְחִכִּי׃

verses.english: My sayings are the uprightness of my heart; my lips speak knowledge purely.
verses.hebrew: יֹשֶׁר־לִבִּי אֲמָרָי וְדַעַת שְׂפָתַי בָּרוּר מִלֵּלוּ׃

verses.english: God’s spirit made me, and Shaddai’s breath gives me life.
verses.hebrew: רוּחַ־אֵל עָשָׂתְנִי וְנִשְׁמַת שַׁדַּי תְּחַיֵּנִי׃

verses.english: If you can, answer me; arrange your case before me; take your stand.
verses.hebrew: אִם־תּוּכַל הֲשִׁיבֵנִי עֶרְכָה לְפָנַי הִתְיַצָּבָה׃

verses.english: Look, before God I am like you; I too was pinched from clay.
verses.hebrew: הֵן־אֲנִי כְפִיךָ לָאֵל מֵחֹמֶר קֹרַצְתִּי גַם־אָנִי׃

verses.english: Look, my terror will not frighten you, and my pressure will not be heavy upon you.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה אֵמָתִי לֹא תְבַעֲתֶךָּ וְאַכְפִּי עָלֶיךָ לֹא־יִכְבָּד׃

verses.english: Yet you spoke in my ears, and I heard the sound of words:
verses.hebrew: אַךְ אָמַרְתָּ בְאָזְנָי וְקוֹל מִלִּין אֶשְׁמָע׃

verses.english: ‘I am clean, without transgression; I am pure, and there is no guilt in me.
verses.hebrew: זַךְ אֲנִי בְּלִי פָשַׁע חַף אָנֹכִי וְלֹא עָוֺן לִי׃

verses.english: Look, He finds pretexts against me; He counts me as His enemy.
verses.hebrew: הֵן תְּנוּאוֹת עָלַי יִמְצָא יַחְשְׁבֵנִי לְאוֹיֵב לוֹ׃

verses.english: He puts my feet in the stocks and watches all my paths.’
verses.hebrew: יָשֵׂם בַּסַּד רַגְלָי יִשְׁמֹר כָּל־אָרְחֹתָי׃

verses.english: Look, in this you are not right, I answer you, for God is greater than a mortal.
verses.hebrew: הֶן־זֹאת לֹא־צָדַקְתָּ אֶעֱנֶךָּ כִּי־יִרְבֶּה אֱלוֹהַ מֵאֱנוֹשׁ׃

verses.english: Why do you contend with Him, because He answers none of His matters?
verses.hebrew: מַדּוּעַ אֵלָיו רִיבוֹתָ כִּי כָל־דְּבָרָיו לֹא־יַעֲנֶה׃

verses.english: For God speaks once, even twice, but one does not perceive it.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־בְאַחַת יְדַבֶּר־אֵל וּבִשְׁתַּיִם לֹא יְשׁוּרֶנָּה׃

verses.english: In a dream, a vision of night, when deep sleep falls upon people, in slumber upon the bed,
verses.hebrew: בַּחֲלוֹם חֶזְיוֹן לַיְלָה בִּנְפֹל תַּרְדֵּמָה עַל־אֲנָשִׁים בִּתְנוּמוֹת עֲלֵי מִשְׁכָּב׃

verses.english: then He uncovers people’s ears and seals their correction,
verses.hebrew: אָז יִגְלֶה אֹזֶן אֲנָשִׁים וּבְמֹסָרָם יַחְתֹּם׃

verses.english: to turn a human from his deed and conceal pride from a man.
verses.hebrew: לְהָסִיר אָדָם מַעֲשֶׂה וְגֵוָה מִגֶּבֶר יְכַסֶּה׃

verses.english: He keeps his soul from the pit and his life from passing by the weapon.
verses.hebrew: יַחְשֹׂךְ נַפְשׁוֹ מִנִּי־שָׁחַת וְחַיָּתוֹ מֵעֲבֹר בַּשָּׁלַח׃

verses.english: He is corrected with pain upon his bed, and the strife of his bones is continual,
verses.hebrew: וְהוּכַח בְּמַכְאוֹב עַל־מִשְׁכָּבוֹ וריב [וְרוֹב] עֲצָמָיו אֵתָן׃

verses.english: so that his life loathes bread, and his soul desirable food.
verses.hebrew: וְזִהֲמַתּוּ חַיָּתוֹ לָחֶם וְנַפְשׁוֹ מַאֲכַל תַּאֲוָה׃

verses.english: His flesh wastes away from sight, and his bones stand bare, once unseen.
verses.hebrew: יִכֶל בְּשָׂרוֹ מֵרֹאִי ושפי [וְשֻׁפּוּ] עַצְמוֹתָיו לֹא רֻאּוּ׃

verses.english: His soul draws near to the pit, and his life to those who bring death.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְרַב לַשַּׁחַת נַפְשׁוֹ וְחַיָּתוֹ לַמְמִתִים׃

verses.english: If there is an angel over him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to declare to a human what is right for him,
verses.hebrew: אִם־יֵשׁ עָלָיו מַלְאָךְ מֵלִיץ אֶחָד מִנִּי־אָלֶף לְהַגִּיד לְאָדָם יָשְׁרוֹ׃

verses.english: and He is gracious to him and says, ‘Release him from going down to the pit; I have found a ransom,’
verses.hebrew: וַיְחֻנֶּנּוּ וַיֹּאמֶר פְּדָעֵהוּ מֵרֶדֶת שָׁחַת מָצָאתִי כֹפֶר׃

verses.english: his flesh becomes fresher than in youth; he returns to the days of his youthful strength.
verses.hebrew: רֻטֲפַשׁ בְּשָׂרוֹ מִנֹּעַר יָשׁוּב לִימֵי עֲלוּמָיו׃

verses.english: He pleads with God, and He accepts him; he sees His face with a shout of joy, and He restores righteousness to the mortal.
verses.hebrew: יֶעְתַּר אֶל־אֱלוֹהַּ וַיִּרְצֵהוּ וַיַּרְא פָּנָיו בִּתְרוּעָה וַיָּשֶׁב לֶאֱנוֹשׁ צִדְקָתוֹ׃

verses.english: He sings before people and says, ‘I sinned and perverted what was right, but it was not repaid to me.
verses.hebrew: יָשֹׁר עַל־אֲנָשִׁים וַיֹּאמֶר חָטָאתִי וְיָשָׁר הֶעֱוֵיתִי וְלֹא־שָׁוָה לִי׃

verses.english: He redeemed my soul from passing into the pit, and my life will see the light.’
verses.hebrew: פָּדָה נפשי [נַפְשׁוֹ] מֵעֲבֹר בַּשָּׁחַת וחיתי [וְחַיָּתוֹ] בָּאוֹר תִּרְאֶה׃

verses.english: Look, God does all these things twice, three times, with a man,
verses.hebrew: הֶן־כָּל־אֵלֶּה יִפְעַל־אֵל פַּעֲמַיִם שָׁלוֹשׁ עִם־גָּבֶר׃

verses.english: to bring back his soul from the pit, to be lighted with the light of the living.
verses.hebrew: לְהָשִׁיב נַפְשׁוֹ מִנִּי־שָׁחַת לֵאוֹר בְּאוֹר הַחַיִּים׃

verses.english: Pay attention, Job; listen to me; be silent, and I will speak.
verses.hebrew: הַקְשֵׁב אִיּוֹב שְׁמַע־לִי הַחֲרֵשׁ וְאָנֹכִי אֲדַבֵּר׃

verses.english: If you have words, answer me; speak, for I desire to declare you righteous.
verses.hebrew: אִם־יֵשׁ־מִלִּין הֲשִׁיבֵנִי דַּבֵּר כִּי־חָפַצְתִּי צַדְּקֶךָּ׃

verses.english: If not, listen to me; be silent, and I will teach you wisdom.”
verses.hebrew: אִם־אַיִן אַתָּה שְׁמַע־לִי הַחֲרֵשׁ וַאֲאַלֶּפְךָ חָכְמָה׃

verses.english: Elihu answered and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אֱלִיהוּא וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “Hear my words, you wise; give ear to me, you who know.
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ חֲכָמִים מִלָּי וְיֹדְעִים הַאֲזִינוּ לִי׃

verses.english: For the ear tests words, and the palate tastes what is eaten.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אֹזֶן מִלִּין תִּבְחָן וְחֵךְ יִטְעַם לֶאֱכֹל׃

verses.english: Let us choose justice for ourselves; let us know among ourselves what is good.
verses.hebrew: מִשְׁפָּט נִבְחֲרָה־לָּנוּ נֵדְעָה בֵינֵינוּ מַה־טּוֹב׃

verses.english: For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, but God has removed my justice.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אָמַר אִיּוֹב צָדַקְתִּי וְאֵל הֵסִיר מִשְׁפָּטִי׃

verses.english: Must I lie about my justice? My arrow wound is incurable, though I have not transgressed.’
verses.hebrew: עַל־מִשְׁפָּטִי אֲכַזֵּב אָנוּשׁ חִצִּי בְלִי־פָשַׁע׃

verses.english: What man is like Job, who drinks mockery like water,
verses.hebrew: מִי־גֶבֶר כְּאִיּוֹב יִשְׁתֶּה־לַּעַג כַּמָּיִם׃

verses.english: who travels in company with workers of wrongdoing and walks with wicked men?
verses.hebrew: וְאָרַח לְחֶבְרָה עִם־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן וְלָלֶכֶת עִם־אַנְשֵׁי־רֶשַׁע׃

verses.english: For he has said, ‘A man gains nothing by taking pleasure with God.’
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אָמַר לֹא יִסְכָּן־גָּבֶר בִּרְצֹתוֹ עִם־אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: Therefore, men of understanding, hear me: far be it from God to act wickedly, and from Shaddai to do injustice.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן אַנֲשֵׁי לֵבָב שִׁמְעוּ לִי חָלִלָה לָאֵל מֵרֶשַׁע וְשַׁדַּי מֵעָוֶל׃

verses.english: For He repays a human according to his work and makes each man find what accords with his way.
verses.hebrew: כִּי פֹעַל אָדָם יְשַׁלֶּם־לוֹ וּכְאֹרַח אִישׁ יַמְצִאֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: Indeed, surely God does not act wickedly, and Shaddai does not distort justice.
verses.hebrew: אַף־אָמְנָם אֵל לֹא־יַרְשִׁיעַ וְשַׁדַּי לֹא־יְעַוֵּת מִשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: Who appointed Him over the earth, and who set the whole inhabited world in place?
verses.hebrew: מִי־פָקַד עָלָיו אָרְצָה וּמִי שָׂם תֵּבֵל כֻּלָּהּ׃

verses.english: If He set His heart upon Himself and gathered His spirit and breath to Himself,
verses.hebrew: אִם־יָשִׂים אֵלָיו לִבּוֹ רוּחוֹ וְנִשְׁמָתוֹ אֵלָיו יֶאֱסֹף׃

verses.english: all flesh would expire together, and humanity would return to dust.
verses.hebrew: יִגְוַע כָּל־בָּשָׂר יָחַד וְאָדָם עַל־עָפָר יָשׁוּב׃

verses.english: If you have understanding, hear this; give ear to the sound of my words.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־בִּינָה שִׁמְעָה־זֹּאת הַאֲזִינָה לְקוֹל מִלָּי׃

verses.english: Can one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn the righteous, mighty One?
verses.hebrew: הַאַף שׂוֹנֵא מִשְׁפָּט יַחֲבוֹשׁ וְאִם־צַדִּיק כַּבִּיר תַּרְשִׁיעַ׃

verses.english: Is one to say to a king, ‘Worthless one,’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked one’?
verses.hebrew: הַאֲמֹר לְמֶלֶךְ בְּלִיָּעַל רָשָׁע אֶל־נְדִיבִים׃

verses.english: He shows no partiality to officials and does not favor the rich before the poor, for all are the work of His hands.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נָשָׂא פְּנֵי שָׂרִים וְלֹא נִכַּר־שׁוֹעַ לִפְנֵי־דָל כִּי־מַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו כֻּלָּם׃

verses.english: In a moment they die; at midnight a people is shaken and passes away, and the mighty are removed without a hand.
verses.hebrew: רֶגַע יָמֻתוּ וַחֲצוֹת לָיְלָה יְגֹעֲשׁוּ עָם וְיַעֲבֹרוּ וְיָסִירוּ אַבִּיר לֹא בְיָד׃

verses.english: For His eyes are upon a man’s ways, and He sees all his steps.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־עֵינָיו עַל־דַּרְכֵי־אִישׁ וְכָל־צְעָדָיו יִרְאֶה׃

verses.english: There is no darkness or deep darkness where workers of wrongdoing may hide.
verses.hebrew: אֵין־חֹשֶׁךְ וְאֵין צַלְמָוֶת לְהִסָּתֶר שָׁם פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃

verses.english: For He does not appoint a person another time to go before God in judgment.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא עַל־אִישׁ יָשִׂים עוֹד לַהֲלֹךְ אֶל־אֵל בַּמִּשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: He shatters mighty men without inquiry and sets others in their place.
verses.hebrew: יָרֹעַ כַּבִּירִים לֹא־חֵקֶר וַיַּעֲמֵד אֲחֵרִים תַּחְתָּם׃

verses.english: Therefore He recognizes their deeds; He overturns them at night, and they are crushed.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן יַכִּיר מַעְבָּדֵיהֶם וְהָפַךְ לַיְלָה וְיִדַּכָּאוּ׃

verses.english: He strikes them as wicked people in a place where people see,
verses.hebrew: תַּחַת־רְשָׁעִים סְפָקָם בִּמְקוֹם רֹאִים׃

verses.english: because they turned away from following Him and did not understand any of His ways,
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר עַל־כֵּן סָרוּ מֵאַחֲרָיו וְכָל־דְּרָכָיו לֹא הִשְׂכִּילוּ׃

verses.english: causing the poor person’s cry to come to Him; He hears the cry of the afflicted.
verses.hebrew: לְהָבִיא עָלָיו צַעֲקַת־דָּל וְצַעֲקַת עֲנִיִּים יִשְׁמָע׃

verses.english: When He gives quiet, who can condemn? When He hides His face, who can behold Him? He acts upon a nation and upon a human alike,
verses.hebrew: וְהוּא יַשְׁקִט וּמִי יַרְשִׁעַ וְיַסְתֵּר פָּנִים וּמִי יְשׁוּרֶנּוּ וְעַל־גּוֹי וְעַל־אָדָם יָחַד׃

verses.english: so that a godless human may not reign, and a people may not be ensnared.
verses.hebrew: מִמְּלֹךְ אָדָם חָנֵף מִמֹּקְשֵׁי עָם׃

verses.english: For has anyone said to God, ‘I have borne it; I will do no wrong;
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אֶל־אֵל הֶאָמַר נָשָׂאתִי לֹא אֶחְבֹּל׃

verses.english: what I do not see, teach me; if I have done injustice, I will not do it again’?
verses.hebrew: בִּלְעֲדֵי אֶחֱזֶה אַתָּה הֹרֵנִי אִם־עָוֶל פָּעַלְתִּי לֹא אֹסִיף׃

verses.english: Must He repay on your terms because you reject it? For you must choose, not I; so speak what you know.
verses.hebrew: הַמֵעִמְּךָ יְשַׁלְמֶנָּה כִּי־מָאַסְתָּ כִּי־אַתָּה תִבְחַר וְלֹא־אָנִי וּמַה־יָדַעְתָּ דַבֵּר׃

verses.english: Men of understanding will say to me, and a wise man who hears me,
verses.hebrew: אַנְשֵׁי לֵבָב יֹאמְרוּ לִי וְגֶבֶר חָכָם שֹׁמֵעַ לִי׃

verses.english: ‘Job speaks without knowledge, and his words lack insight.’
verses.hebrew: אִיּוֹב לֹא־בְדַעַת יְדַבֵּר וּדְבָרָיו לֹא בְהַשְׂכֵּיל׃

verses.english: I wish Job would be tested to the end because of answers like those of wicked men.
verses.hebrew: אָבִי יִבָּחֵן אִיּוֹב עַד־נֶצַח עַל־תְּשֻׁבֹת בְּאַנְשֵׁי־אָוֶן׃

verses.english: For he adds rebellion to his sin; he claps among us and multiplies his sayings against God.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי יֹסִיף עַל־חַטָּאתוֹ פֶשַׁע בֵּינֵינוּ יִסְפּוֹק וְיֶרֶב אֲמָרָיו לָאֵל׃

verses.english: Elihu answered and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אֱלִיהוּ וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “Do you consider this just? You say, ‘My righteousness exceeds God’s.’
verses.hebrew: הֲזֹאת חָשַׁבְתָּ לְמִשְׁפָּט אָמַרְתָּ צִדְקִי מֵאֵל׃

verses.english: For you say, ‘What benefit is it to you? What do I gain beyond my sin?’
verses.hebrew: כִּי־תֹאמַר מַה־יִּסְכָּן־לָךְ מָה־אֹעִיל מֵחַטָּאתִי׃

verses.english: I will answer you with words, and your friends with you.
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי אֲשִׁיבְךָ מִלִּין וְאֶת־רֵעֶיךָ עִמָּךְ׃

verses.english: Look at the heavens and see; behold the clouds, high above you.
verses.hebrew: הַבֵּט שָׁמַיִם וּרְאֵה וְשׁוּר שְׁחָקִים גָּבְהוּ מִמֶּךָּ׃

verses.english: If you sin, what do you do to Him? If your transgressions multiply, what do you accomplish against Him?
verses.hebrew: אִם־חָטָאתָ מַה־תִּפְעָל־בּוֹ וְרַבּוּ פְשָׁעֶיךָ מַה־תַּעֲשֶׂה־לּוֹ׃

verses.english: If you are righteous, what do you give Him, or what does He receive from your hand?
verses.hebrew: אִם־צָדַקְתָּ מַה־תִּתֶּן־לוֹ אוֹ מַה־מִיָּדְךָ יִקָּח׃

verses.english: Your wickedness affects a man like you, and your righteousness a son of humanity.
verses.hebrew: לְאִישׁ־כָּמוֹךָ רִשְׁעֶךָ וּלְבֶן־אָדָם צִדְקָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: Because of abundant oppressions they cry out; they cry for help because of the arm of the mighty.
verses.hebrew: מֵרֹב עֲשׁוּקִים יַזְעִיקוּ יְשַׁוְּעוּ מִזְּרוֹעַ רַבִּים׃

verses.english: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־אָמַר אַיֵּה אֱלוֹהַּ עֹשָׂי נֹתֵן זְמִרוֹת בַּלָּיְלָה׃

verses.english: who teaches us more than the beasts of the earth and makes us wiser than the birds of the heavens?’
verses.hebrew: מַלְּפֵנוּ מִבַּהֲמוֹת אָרֶץ וּמֵעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם יְחַכְּמֵנוּ׃

verses.english: There they cry out, but He does not answer, because of the pride of evil people.
verses.hebrew: שָׁם יִצְעֲקוּ וְלֹא יַעֲנֶה מִפְּנֵי גְּאוֹן רָעִים׃

verses.english: Surely God does not hear emptiness, and Shaddai does not regard it.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ־שָׁוְא לֹא־יִשְׁמַע אֵל וְשַׁדַּי לֹא יְשׁוּרֶנָּה׃

verses.english: Even though you say you do not see Him, the case is before Him, and you must wait for Him.
verses.hebrew: אַף כִּי־תֹאמַר לֹא תְשׁוּרֶנּוּ דִּין לְפָנָיו וּתְחוֹלֵל לוֹ׃

verses.english: And now, because His anger has not punished, and He has not taken much notice of excess,
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה כִּי־אַיִן פָּקַד אַפּוֹ וְלֹא־יָדַע בַּפַּשׁ מְאֹד׃

verses.english: Job opens his mouth in emptiness and multiplies words without knowledge.”
verses.hebrew: וְאִיּוֹב הֶבֶל יִפְצֶה־פִּיהוּ בִּבְלִי־דַעַת מִלִּין יַכְבִּר׃

verses.english: Elihu continued and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף אֱלִיהוּא וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “Wait for me a little, and I will show you, for there are still words on God’s behalf.
verses.hebrew: כַּתַּר־לִי זְעֵיר וַאֲחַוֶּךָּ כִּי עוֹד לֶאֱלוֹהַּ מִלִּים׃

verses.english: I will bring my knowledge from afar and ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
verses.hebrew: אֶשָּׂא דֵעִי לְמֵרָחוֹק וּלְפֹעֲלִי אֶתֵּן־צֶדֶק׃

verses.english: For truly my words are not false; one complete in knowledge is with you.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אָמְנָם לֹא־שֶׁקֶר מִלָּי תְּמִים דֵּעוֹת עִמָּךְ׃

verses.english: Look, God is mighty and does not despise; He is mighty in strength of heart.
verses.hebrew: הֶן־אֵל כַּבִּיר וְלֹא יִמְאָס כַּבִּיר כֹּחַ לֵב׃

verses.english: He does not keep the wicked alive, but gives justice to the afflicted.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יְחַיֶּה רָשָׁע וּמִשְׁפַּט עֲנִיִּים יִתֵּן׃

verses.english: He does not withdraw His eyes from the righteous; with kings upon the throne He seats them forever, and they are exalted.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יִגְרַע מִצַּדִּיק עֵינָיו וְאֶת־מְלָכִים לַכִּסֵּא וַיֹּשִׁיבֵם לָנֶצַח וַיִּגְבָּהוּ׃

verses.english: If they are bound in fetters and caught in cords of affliction,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־אֲסוּרִים בַּזִּקִּים יִלָּכְדוּן בְּחַבְלֵי־עֹנִי׃

verses.english: He tells them their deeds and their transgressions, that they have acted proudly.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֵּד לָהֶם פָּעֳלָם וּפִשְׁעֵיהֶם כִּי יִתְגַּבָּרוּ׃

verses.english: He uncovers their ear for correction and tells them to turn from wrongdoing.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגֶל אָזְנָם לַמּוּסָר וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי־יְשֻׁבוּן מֵאָוֶן׃

verses.english: If they listen and serve, they finish their days in prosperity and their years in pleasures.
verses.hebrew: אִם־יִשְׁמְעוּ וְיַעֲבֹדוּ יְכַלּוּ יְמֵיהֶם בַּטּוֹב וּשְׁנֵיהֶם בַּנְּעִימִים׃

verses.english: But if they do not listen, they pass away by the weapon and expire without knowledge.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־לֹא יִשְׁמְעוּ בְּשֶׁלַח יַעֲבֹרוּ וְיִגְוְעוּ כִּבְלִי־דָעַת׃

verses.english: The godless in heart store up anger; they do not cry for help when He binds them.
verses.hebrew: וְחַנְפֵי־לֵב יָשִׂימוּ אָף לֹא יְשַׁוְּעוּ כִּי אֲסָרָם׃

verses.english: Their soul dies in youth, and their life ends among the consecrated men.
verses.hebrew: תָּמֹת בַּנֹּעַר נַפְשָׁם וְחַיָּתָם בַּקְּדֵשִׁים׃

verses.english: He rescues the afflicted through their affliction and uncovers their ear through oppression.
verses.hebrew: יְחַלֵּץ עָנִי בְעָנְיוֹ וְיִגֶל בַּלַּחַץ אָזְנָם׃

verses.english: He also entices you from the mouth of distress to a broad place with no constraint beneath it; what rests on your table is full of richness.
verses.hebrew: וְאַף הֲסִיתְךָ מִפִּי־צָר רַחַב לֹא־מוּצָק תַּחְתֶּיהָ וְנַחַת שֻׁלְחָנְךָ מָלֵא דָשֶׁן׃

verses.english: But you are filled with the judgment of the wicked; judgment and justice take hold.
verses.hebrew: וְדִין־רָשָׁע מָלֵאתָ דִּין וּמִשְׁפָּט יִתְמֹכוּ׃

verses.english: For anger—beware lest it entice you into scoffing; let no great ransom turn you aside.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־חֵמָה פֶּן־יְסִיתְךָ בְסָפֶק וְרָב־כֹּפֶר אַל־יַטֶּךָּ׃

verses.english: Will your cry put you beyond distress, or all exertions of strength?
verses.hebrew: הֲיַעֲרֹךְ שׁוּעֲךָ לֹא בְצָר וְכֹל מַאֲמַצֵּי־כֹחַ׃

verses.english: Do not pant for the night, when peoples rise away from their place.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּשְׁאַף הַלָּיְלָה לַעֲלוֹת עַמִּים תַּחְתָּם׃

verses.english: Take care; do not turn toward wrongdoing, for you have chosen this rather than affliction.
verses.hebrew: הִשָּׁמֶר אַל־תֵּפֶן אֶל־אָוֶן כִּי־עַל־זֶה בָּחַרְתָּ מֵעֹנִי׃

verses.english: Look, God is exalted in His strength; who is a teacher like Him?
verses.hebrew: הֶן־אֵל יַשְׂגִּיב בְּכֹחוֹ מִי כָמֹהוּ מוֹרֶה׃

verses.english: Who appointed His way for Him, or who said, ‘You have done injustice’?
verses.hebrew: מִי־פָקַד עָלָיו דַּרְכּוֹ וּמִי־אָמַר פָּעַלְתָּ עַוְלָה׃

verses.english: Remember to magnify His work, which people have sung.
verses.hebrew: זְכֹר כִּי־תַשְׂגִּיא פָעֳלוֹ אֲשֶׁר שֹׁרְרוּ אֲנָשִׁים׃

verses.english: Every human has seen it; a mortal looks from afar.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־אָדָם חָזוּ־בוֹ אֱנוֹשׁ יַבִּיט מֵרָחוֹק׃

verses.english: Look, God is great, and we do not know Him; the number of His years is beyond searching.
verses.hebrew: הֶן־אֵל שַׂגִּיא וְלֹא נֵדָע מִסְפַּר שָׁנָיו וְלֹא־חֵקֶר׃

verses.english: For He draws away drops of water; they distill rain from His mist,
verses.hebrew: כִּי יְגָרַע נִטְפֵי־מָיִם יָזֹקּוּ מָטָר לְאֵדוֹ׃

verses.english: which the clouds pour down and shower abundantly upon humankind.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־יִזְּלוּ שְׁחָקִים יִרְעֲפוּ עֲלֵי אָדָם רָב׃

verses.english: — [No corresponding Hebrew source unit.]
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־יִזְּלוּ שְׁחָקִים יִרְעֲפוּ עֲלֵי אָדָם רָב׃

verses.english: — [No corresponding Hebrew source unit.]
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־יִזְּלוּ שְׁחָקִים יִרְעֲפוּ עֲלֵי אָדָם רָב׃

verses.english: Can anyone understand the spreading of clouds, the thunderings of His shelter?
verses.hebrew: אַף אִם־יָבִין מִפְרְשֵׂי־עָב תְּשֻׁאוֹת סֻכָּתוֹ׃

verses.english: look, He spreads His light over it and covers the roots of the sea.
verses.hebrew: הֵן־פָּרַשׂ עָלָיו אוֹרוֹ וְשָׁרְשֵׁי הַיָּם כִּסָּה׃

verses.english: For by these He judges peoples and gives food in abundance.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־בָם יָדִין עַמִּים יִתֶּן־אֹכֶל לְמַכְבִּיר׃

verses.english: He covers light with His palms and commands it where to strike.
verses.hebrew: עַל־כַּפַּיִם כִּסָּה־אוֹר וַיְצַו עָלֶיהָ בְמַפְגִּיעַ׃

verses.english: His thunder announces Him; the cattle also announce what is coming.
verses.hebrew: יַגִּיד עָלָיו רֵעוֹ מִקְנֶה אַף עַל־עוֹלֶה׃

verses.english: “At this too my heart trembles and leaps out of its place.
verses.hebrew: אַף־לְזֹאת יֶחֱרַד לִבִּי וְיִתַּר מִמְּקוֹמוֹ׃

verses.english: Listen carefully to the agitation of His voice, the rumbling that goes out from His mouth.
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ שָׁמוֹעַ בְּרֹגֶז קֹלוֹ וְהֶגֶה מִפִּיו יֵצֵא׃

verses.english: He lets it loose beneath the whole heaven, and His light to the earth’s wings.
verses.hebrew: תַּחַת־כָּל־הַשָּׁמַיִם יִשְׁרֵהוּ וְאוֹרוֹ עַל־כַּנְפוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: After it a voice roars; He thunders with His majestic voice, and does not restrain them when His voice is heard.
verses.hebrew: אַחֲרָיו יִשְׁאַג־קוֹל יַרְעֵם בְּקוֹל גְּאוֹנוֹ וְלֹא יְעַקְּבֵם כִּי־יִשָּׁמַע קוֹלוֹ׃

verses.english: God thunders wondrously with His voice; He does great things we do not know.
verses.hebrew: יַרְעֵם אֵל בְּקוֹלוֹ נִפְלָאוֹת עֹשֶׂה גְדֹלוֹת וְלֹא נֵדָע׃
