verses.english: For He says to snow, ‘Be upon the earth,’ and to a downpour of rain, and to a downpour of His mighty rains.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לַשֶּׁלַג יֹאמַר הֱוֵא אָרֶץ וְגֶשֶׁם מָטָר וְגֶשֶׁם מִטְרוֹת עֻזּוֹ׃

verses.english: He seals up every human hand, so that all people may know His work.
verses.hebrew: בְּיַד־כָּל־אָדָם יַחְתּוֹם לָדַעַת כָּל־אַנְשֵׁי מַעֲשֵׂהוּ׃

verses.english: The wild animal goes into its lair and dwells in its dens.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא חַיָּה בְמוֹ־אָרֶב וּבִמְעוֹנֹתֶיהָ תִשְׁכֹּן׃

verses.english: From the chamber comes a whirlwind, and from the scattering winds, cold.
verses.hebrew: מִן־הַחֶדֶר תָּבוֹא סוּפָה וּמִמְּזָרִים קָרָה׃

verses.english: By God’s breath ice is given, and broad waters are held tight.
verses.hebrew: מִנִּשְׁמַת־אֵל יִתֶּן־קָרַח וְרֹחַב מַיִם בְּמוּצָק׃

verses.english: He loads the cloud with moisture; He scatters His cloud of light.
verses.hebrew: אַף־בְּרִי יַטְרִיחַ עָב יָפִיץ עֲנַן אוֹרוֹ׃

verses.english: It turns in circles under His guidance, to perform everything He commands them upon the face of the inhabited earth,
verses.hebrew: וְהוּא מְסִבּוֹת מִתְהַפֵּךְ בתחבולתו [בְּתַחְבּוּלֹתָיו] לְפָעֳלָם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יְצַוֵּם עַל־פְּנֵי תֵבֵל אָרְצָה׃

verses.english: whether for a rod, or for His land, or for loyal love, He causes it to come.
verses.hebrew: אִם־לְשֵׁבֶט אִם־לְאַרְצוֹ אִם־לְחֶסֶד יַמְצִאֵהוּ׃

verses.english: Give ear to this, Job; stand and consider God’s wonders.
verses.hebrew: הַאֲזִינָה זֹּאת אִיּוֹב עֲמֹד וְהִתְבּוֹנֵן נִפְלְאוֹת אֵל׃

verses.english: Do you know how God lays His command upon them and makes His cloud’s light shine?
verses.hebrew: הֲתֵדַע בְּשׂוּם־אֱלוֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶם וְהוֹפִיעַ אוֹר עֲנָנוֹ׃

verses.english: Do you know the balancing of clouds, the wonders of One complete in knowledge?
verses.hebrew: הֲתֵדַע עַל־מִפְלְשֵׂי־עָב מִפְלְאוֹת תְּמִים דֵּעִים׃

verses.english: You whose garments become hot when the earth grows quiet from the south wind,
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־בְּגָדֶיךָ חַמִּים בְּהַשְׁקִט אֶרֶץ מִדָּרוֹם׃

verses.english: can you hammer out the skies with Him, hard as a cast mirror?
verses.hebrew: תַּרְקִיעַ עִמּוֹ לִשְׁחָקִים חֲזָקִים כִּרְאִי מוּצָק׃

verses.english: Teach us what to say to Him; we cannot arrange a case because of darkness.
verses.hebrew: הוֹדִיעֵנוּ מַה־נֹּאמַר לוֹ לֹא־נַעֲרֹךְ מִפְּנֵי־חֹשֶׁךְ׃

verses.english: Will He be told that I would speak? If a man speaks, will he be swallowed up?
verses.hebrew: הַיְסֻפַּר־לוֹ כִּי אֲדַבֵּר אִם־אָמַר אִישׁ כִּי יְבֻלָּע׃

verses.english: Now people do not see the light, though it is bright in the clouds; a wind passes and clears them.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לֹא רָאוּ אוֹר בָּהִיר הוּא בַּשְּׁחָקִים וְרוּחַ עָבְרָה וַתְּטַהֲרֵם׃

verses.english: From the north comes gold; awesome majesty surrounds God.
verses.hebrew: מִצָּפוֹן זָהָב יֶאֱתֶה עַל־אֱלוֹהַּ נוֹרָא הוֹד׃

verses.english: Shaddai—we cannot find Him; He is great in strength, and in justice and abundant righteousness He does not afflict.
verses.hebrew: שַׁדַּי לֹא־מְצָאנֻהוּ שַׂגִּיא־כֹחַ וּמִשְׁפָּט וְרֹב־צְדָקָה לֹא יְעַנֶּה׃

verses.english: Therefore people fear Him; He does not regard any who are wise in heart.”
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן יְרֵאוּהוּ אֲנָשִׁים לֹא־יִרְאֶה כָּל־חַכְמֵי־לֵב׃

verses.english: YHWH answered Job from the whirlwind and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן־יְהוָה אֶת־אִיּוֹב מנ הסערה [מִן ] [הַסְּעָרָה] וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “Who is this who darkens counsel with words without knowledge?
verses.hebrew: מִי זֶה מַחְשִׁיךְ עֵצָה בְמִלִּין בְּלִי־דָעַת׃

verses.english: Gird your loins like a man; I will question you, and you make it known to Me.
verses.hebrew: אֱזָר־נָא כְגֶבֶר חֲלָצֶיךָ וְאֶשְׁאָלְךָ וְהוֹדִיעֵנִי׃

verses.english: Where were you when I founded the earth? Tell Me, if you know understanding.
verses.hebrew: אֵיפֹה הָיִיתָ בְּיָסְדִי־אָרֶץ הַגֵּד אִם־יָדַעְתָּ בִינָה׃

verses.english: Who set its measurements—surely you know! Or who stretched a measuring line over it?
verses.hebrew: מִי־שָׂם מְמַדֶּיהָ כִּי תֵדָע אוֹ מִי־נָטָה עָלֶיהָ קָּו׃

verses.english: Upon what were its bases sunk, or who laid its cornerstone,
verses.hebrew: עַל־מָה אֲדָנֶיהָ הָטְבָּעוּ אוֹ מִי־יָרָה אֶבֶן פִּנָּתָהּ׃

verses.english: when the morning stars sang together and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
verses.hebrew: בְּרָן־יַחַד כּוֹכְבֵי בֹקֶר וַיָּרִיעוּ כָּל־בְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: Who shut in the sea with doors when it burst out from the womb,
verses.hebrew: וַיָּסֶךְ בִּדְלָתַיִם יָם בְּגִיחוֹ מֵרֶחֶם יֵצֵא׃

verses.english: when I made cloud its garment and thick darkness its swaddling band,
verses.hebrew: בְּשׂוּמִי עָנָן לְבֻשׁוֹ וַעֲרָפֶל חֲתֻלָּתוֹ׃

verses.english: when I broke out My boundary for it and set bar and doors,
verses.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁבֹּר עָלָיו חֻקִּי וָאָשִׂים בְּרִיחַ וּדְלָתָיִם׃

verses.english: and said, ‘Thus far you may come, and no farther; here the pride of your waves must stop’?
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר עַד־פֹּה תָבוֹא וְלֹא תֹסִיף וּפֹא־יָשִׁית בִּגְאוֹן גַּלֶּיךָ׃

verses.english: Have you, in your days, commanded morning and made dawn know its place,
verses.hebrew: הְמִיָּמֶיךָ צִוִּיתָ בֹּקֶר ידעתה שחר [יִדַּעְתָּה] [הַשַּׁחַר] מְקֹמוֹ׃

verses.english: to take hold of the earth’s wings and shake the wicked out of it?
verses.hebrew: לֶאֱחֹז בְּכַנְפוֹת הָאָרֶץ וְיִנָּעֲרוּ רְשָׁעִים מִמֶּנָּה׃

verses.english: It changes like clay under a seal, and they stand forth like a garment.
verses.hebrew: תִּתְהַפֵּךְ כְּחֹמֶר חוֹתָם וְיִתְיַצְּבוּ כְּמוֹ לְבוּשׁ׃

verses.english: Their light is withheld from the wicked, and a raised arm is broken.
verses.hebrew: וְיִמָּנַע מֵרְשָׁעִים אוֹרָם וּזְרוֹעַ רָמָה תִּשָּׁבֵר׃

verses.english: Have you come to the springs of the sea and walked in the searching depths of the deep?
verses.hebrew: הֲבָאתָ עַד־נִבְכֵי־יָם וּבְחֵקֶר תְּהוֹם הִתְהַלָּכְתָּ׃

verses.english: Have the gates of death been revealed to you, and have you seen the gates of deep darkness?
verses.hebrew: הֲנִגְלוּ לְךָ שַׁעֲרֵי־מָוֶת וְשַׁעֲרֵי צַלְמָוֶת תִּרְאֶה׃

verses.english: Have you understood the earth’s breadth? Tell Me, if you know it all.
verses.hebrew: הִתְבֹּנַנְתָּ עַד־רַחֲבֵי־אָרֶץ הַגֵּד אִם־יָדַעְתָּ כֻלָּהּ׃

verses.english: Where is the way to where light dwells, and darkness—where is its place,
verses.hebrew: אֵי־זֶה הַדֶּרֶךְ יִשְׁכָּן־אוֹר וְחֹשֶׁךְ אֵי־זֶה מְקֹמוֹ׃

verses.english: that you may take it to its boundary and understand the paths to its house?
verses.hebrew: כִּי תִקָּחֶנּוּ אֶל־גְּבוּלוֹ וְכִי־תָבִין נְתִיבוֹת בֵּיתוֹ׃

verses.english: You know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!
verses.hebrew: יָדַעְתָּ כִּי־אָז תִּוָּלֵד וּמִסְפַּר יָמֶיךָ רַבִּים׃

verses.english: Have you entered the storehouses of snow or seen the storehouses of hail,
verses.hebrew: הֲבָאתָ אֶל־אֹצְרוֹת שָׁלֶג וְאֹצְרוֹת בָּרָד תִּרְאֶה׃

verses.english: which I have reserved for a time of distress, for a day of battle and war?
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־חָשַׂכְתִּי לְעֶת־צָר לְיוֹם קְרָב וּמִלְחָמָה׃

verses.english: Where is the way by which light is divided, and the east wind scattered upon earth?
verses.hebrew: אֵי־זֶה הַדֶּרֶךְ יֵחָלֶק אוֹר יָפֵץ קָדִים עֲלֵי־אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Who cut a channel for the downpour and a way for the lightning of thunder,
verses.hebrew: מִי־פִלַּג לַשֶּׁטֶף תְּעָלָה וְדֶרֶךְ לַחֲזִיז קֹלוֹת׃

verses.english: to rain upon a land where no one lives, a wilderness without a human,
verses.hebrew: לְהַמְטִיר עַל־אֶרֶץ לֹא־אִישׁ מִדְבָּר לֹא־אָדָם בּוֹ׃

verses.english: to satisfy desolation and waste and make green grass sprout?
verses.hebrew: לְהַשְׂבִּיעַ שֹׁאָה וּמְשֹׁאָה וּלְהַצְמִיחַ מֹצָא דֶשֶׁא׃

verses.english: Does the rain have a father, or who begot the drops of dew?
verses.hebrew: הֲיֵשׁ־לַמָּטָר אָב אוֹ מִי־הוֹלִיד אֶגְלֵי־טָל׃

verses.english: From whose womb came the ice, and who gave birth to heaven’s frost?
verses.hebrew: מִבֶּטֶן מִי יָצָא הַקָּרַח וּכְפֹר שָׁמַיִם מִי יְלָדוֹ׃

verses.english: Waters hide as though stone, and the face of the deep is bound fast.
verses.hebrew: כָּאֶבֶן מַיִם יִתְחַבָּאוּ וּפְנֵי תְהוֹם יִתְלַכָּדוּ׃

verses.english: Can you bind Kimah’s bands or loosen Kesil’s cords?
verses.hebrew: הַתְקַשֵּׁר מַעֲדַנּוֹת כִּימָה אוֹ־מֹשְׁכוֹת כְּסִיל תְּפַתֵּחַ׃

verses.english: Can you bring out Mazzarot in its season, and guide Ayish with her children?
verses.hebrew: הֲתֹצִיא מַזָּרוֹת בְּעִתּוֹ וְעַיִשׁ עַל־בָּנֶיהָ תַנְחֵם׃

verses.english: Do you know heaven’s statutes, or establish its rule upon the earth?
verses.hebrew: הֲיָדַעְתָּ חֻקּוֹת שָׁמָיִם אִם־תָּשִׂים מִשְׁטָרוֹ בָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Can you lift your voice to the cloud, so that abundant waters cover you?
verses.hebrew: הֲתָרִים לָעָב קוֹלֶךָ וְשִׁפְעַת־מַיִם תְּכַסֶּךָּ׃

verses.english: Can you send lightning bolts so that they go and say to you, ‘Here we are’?
verses.hebrew: הַתְשַׁלַּח בְּרָקִים וְיֵלֵכוּ וְיֹאמְרוּ לְךָ הִנֵּנוּ׃

verses.english: Who put wisdom in the inward parts, or gave understanding to the mind?
verses.hebrew: מִי־שָׁת בַּטֻּחוֹת חָכְמָה אוֹ מִי־נָתַן לַשֶּׂכְוִי בִינָה׃

verses.english: Who counts the clouds with wisdom, and who tips the jars of heaven,
verses.hebrew: מִי־יְסַפֵּר שְׁחָקִים בְּחָכְמָה וְנִבְלֵי שָׁמַיִם מִי יַשְׁכִּיב׃

verses.english: when dust runs into a solid mass and clods cling together?
verses.hebrew: בְּצֶקֶת עָפָר לַמּוּצָק וּרְגָבִים יְדֻבָּקוּ׃

verses.english: Can you hunt prey for the lioness and fill the appetite of young lions,
verses.hebrew: הֲתָצוּד לְלָבִיא טָרֶף וְחַיַּת כְּפִירִים תְּמַלֵּא׃

verses.english: when they crouch in their dens and sit in cover to lie in wait?
verses.hebrew: כִּי־יָשֹׁחוּ בַמְּעוֹנוֹת יֵשְׁבוּ בַסֻּכָּה לְמוֹ־אָרֶב׃

verses.english: Who prepares food for the raven when its young cry to God and wander for lack of food?”
verses.hebrew: מִי יָכִין לָעֹרֵב צֵידוֹ כִּי־ילדו [יְלָדָיו] אֶל־אֵל יְשַׁוֵּעוּ יִתְעוּ לִבְלִי־אֹכֶל׃

verses.english: “Do you know the time when the rock goats give birth, or watch the does’ labor?
verses.hebrew: הֲיָדַעְתָּ עֵת לֶדֶת יַעֲלֵי־סָלַע חֹלֵל אַיָּלוֹת תִּשְׁמֹר׃

verses.english: Do you count the months they fulfill and know the time of their giving birth?
verses.hebrew: תִּסְפֹּר יְרָחִים תְּמַלֶּאנָה וְיָדַעְתָּ עֵת לִדְתָּנָה׃

verses.english: They crouch and deliver their young; they cast off their birth pains.
verses.hebrew: תִּכְרַעְנָה יַלְדֵיהֶן תְּפַלַּחְנָה חֶבְלֵיהֶם תְּשַׁלַּחְנָה׃

verses.english: Their young grow strong and become great in the open country; they go out and do not return to them.
verses.hebrew: יַחְלְמוּ בְנֵיהֶם יִרְבּוּ בַבָּר יָצְאוּ וְלֹא־שָׁבוּ לָמוֹ׃

verses.english: Who sent the wild donkey free, and who loosened the onager’s bonds,
verses.hebrew: מִי־שִׁלַּח פֶּרֶא חָפְשִׁי וּמֹסְרוֹת עָרוֹד מִי פִתֵּחַ׃

verses.english: whose home I made the wasteland, and his dwellings the salt land?
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־שַׂמְתִּי עֲרָבָה בֵיתוֹ וּמִשְׁכְּנוֹתָיו מְלֵחָה׃

verses.english: He laughs at the city’s clamor and does not hear a driver’s shouting.
verses.hebrew: יִשְׂחַק לַהֲמוֹן קִרְיָה תְּשֻׁאוֹת נוֹגֵשׂ לֹא יִשְׁמָע׃

verses.english: He searches mountains for his pasture and seeks every green thing.
verses.hebrew: יְתוּר הָרִים מִרְעֵהוּ וְאַחַר כָּל־יָרוֹק יִדְרוֹשׁ׃

verses.english: Will the wild ox be willing to serve you, or lodge beside your feeding trough?
verses.hebrew: הֲיֹאבֶה רֵּים עָבְדֶךָ אִם־יָלִין עַל־אֲבוּסֶךָ׃

verses.english: Can you bind the wild ox with its rope in a furrow, or will it harrow valleys behind you?
verses.hebrew: הֲ‍תִקְשָׁר־רֵים בְּתֶלֶם עֲבֹתוֹ אִם־יְשַׂדֵּד עֲמָקִים אַחֲרֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Will you trust it because its strength is great, and leave your labor to it?
verses.hebrew: הֲתִבְטַח־בּוֹ כִּי־רַב כֹּחוֹ וְתַעֲזֹב אֵלָיו יְגִיעֶךָ׃

verses.english: Will you trust it to return your seed and gather your threshing-floor grain?
verses.hebrew: הֲתַאֲמִין בּוֹ כִּי־ישוב [יָשִׁיב] זַרְעֶךָ וְגָרְנְךָ יֶאֱסֹף׃

verses.english: The wing of the jubilant bird flaps joyfully; is it the pinion and plumage of a stork?
verses.hebrew: כְּנַף־רְנָנִים נֶעֱלָסָה אִם־אֶבְרָה חֲסִידָה וְנֹצָה׃

verses.english: For she leaves her eggs on the ground and warms them upon dust,
verses.hebrew: כִּי־תַעֲזֹב לָאָרֶץ בֵּצֶיהָ וְעַל־עָפָר תְּחַמֵּם׃

verses.english: forgetting that a foot may scatter them or a wild beast trample them.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּשְׁכַּח כִּי־רֶגֶל תְּזוּרֶהָ וְחַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה תְּדוּשֶׁהָ׃

verses.english: She deals harshly with her young, as though not hers; her labor may be in vain, without fear.
verses.hebrew: הִקְשִׁיחַ בָּנֶיהָ לְּלֹא־לָהּ לְרִיק יְגִיעָהּ בְּלִי־פָחַד׃

verses.english: For God made her forget wisdom and gave her no share in understanding.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִשָּׁהּ אֱלוֹהַּ חָכְמָה וְלֹא־חָלַק לָהּ בַּבִּינָה׃

verses.english: When she lifts herself high, she laughs at horse and rider.
verses.hebrew: כָּעֵת בַּמָּרוֹם תַּמְרִיא תִּשְׂחַק לַסּוּס וּלְרֹכְבוֹ׃

verses.english: Do you give the horse strength, or clothe its neck with a mane?
verses.hebrew: הֲתִתֵּן לַסּוּס גְּבוּרָה הֲתַלְבִּישׁ צַוָּארוֹ רַעְמָה׃

verses.english: Do you make it leap like a locust? Its majestic snorting is terrifying.
verses.hebrew: הְתַרְעִישֶׁנּוּ כָּאַרְבֶּה הוֹד נַחְרוֹ אֵימָה׃

verses.english: Its feet dig in the valley, and it rejoices in strength; it goes out to meet weapons.
verses.hebrew: יַחְפְּרוּ בָעֵמֶק וְיָשִׂישׂ בְּכֹחַ יֵצֵא לִקְרַאת־נָשֶׁק׃

verses.english: It laughs at fear and is not dismayed; it does not turn back from the sword.
verses.hebrew: יִשְׂחַק לְפַחַד וְלֹא יֵחָת וְלֹא־יָשׁוּב מִפְּנֵי־חָרֶב׃

verses.english: A quiver rattles over it, the flashing spear and javelin.
verses.hebrew: עָלָיו תִּרְנֶה אַשְׁפָּה לַהַב חֲנִית וְכִידוֹן׃

verses.english: With trembling and rage it gulps down the earth; it cannot believe when the trumpet sounds.
verses.hebrew: בְּרַעַשׁ וְרֹגֶז יְגַמֶּא־אָרֶץ וְלֹא־יַאֲמִין כִּי־קוֹל שׁוֹפָר׃

verses.english: At each trumpet blast it says, ‘Aha!’ From afar it smells battle, the thunder of commanders and the war cry.
verses.hebrew: בְּדֵי שֹׁפָר יֹאמַר הֶאָח וּמֵרָחוֹק יָרִיחַ מִלְחָמָה רַעַם שָׂרִים וּתְרוּעָה׃

verses.english: Is it by your understanding that the hawk takes wing and spreads its wings toward the south?
verses.hebrew: הֲ‍מִבִּינָתְךָ יַאֲבֶר־נֵץ יִפְרֹשׂ כנפו [כְּנָפָיו] לְתֵימָן׃

verses.english: Is it at your command that the eagle rises and lifts its nest high?
verses.hebrew: אִם־עַל־פִּיךָ יַגְבִּיהַּ נָשֶׁר וְכִי יָרִים קִנּוֹ׃

verses.english: It dwells and spends the night upon rock, on a rock’s tooth and a stronghold.
verses.hebrew: סֶלַע יִשְׁכֹּן וְיִתְלֹנָן עַל־שֶׁן־סֶלַע וּמְצוּדָה׃

verses.english: From there it searches for food; its eyes look far away.
verses.hebrew: מִשָּׁם חָפַר־אֹכֶל לְמֵרָחוֹק עֵינָיו יַבִּיטוּ׃

verses.english: Its young gulp blood, and where the slain are, there it is.”
verses.hebrew: ואפרחו [וְאֶפְרֹחָיו] יְעַלְעוּ־דָם וּבַאֲשֶׁר חֲלָלִים שָׁם הוּא׃

verses.english: YHWH answered Job and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב אֶת־יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “Will one who contends with Shaddai instruct Him? Let the one reproving God answer this.”
verses.hebrew: הֲרֹב עִם־שַׁדַּי יִסּוֹר מוֹכִיחַ אֱלוֹהַּ יַעֲנֶנָּה׃

verses.english: Job answered YHWH and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב אֶת־יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “Look, I am of little account; what can I answer You? I place my hand over my mouth.
verses.hebrew: הֵן קַלֹּתִי מָה אֲשִׁיבֶךָּ יָדִי שַׂמְתִּי לְמוֹ־פִי׃

verses.english: Once I spoke, but I will not answer; twice, but I will add no more.”
verses.hebrew: אַחַת דִּבַּרְתִּי וְלֹא אֶעֱנֶה וּשְׁתַּיִם וְלֹא אוֹסִיף׃

verses.english: YHWH answered Job from the whirlwind and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן־יְהוָה אֶת־אִיּוֹב מנ סערה [מִן ] [סְעָרָה] וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “Gird your loins like a man; I will question you, and you make it known to Me.
verses.hebrew: אֱזָר־נָא כְגֶבֶר חֲלָצֶיךָ אֶשְׁאָלְךָ וְהוֹדִיעֵנִי׃

verses.english: Will you even annul My judgment? Will you condemn Me so that you may be righteous?
verses.hebrew: הַאַף תָּפֵר מִשְׁפָּטִי תַּרְשִׁיעֵנִי לְמַעַן תִּצְדָּק׃

verses.english: Do you have an arm like God’s, and can you thunder with a voice like His?
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־זְרוֹעַ כָּאֵל לָךְ וּבְקוֹל כָּמֹהוּ תַרְעֵם׃

verses.english: Adorn yourself with majesty and height; clothe yourself in splendor and glory.
verses.hebrew: עֲדֵה נָא גָאוֹן וָגֹבַהּ וְהוֹד וְהָדָר תִּלְבָּשׁ׃

verses.english: Pour out the outbursts of your anger; look at every proud person and bring him low.
verses.hebrew: רְאֵה כָל־גֵּאֶה הַכְנִיעֵהוּ וַהֲדֹךְ רְשָׁעִים תַּחְתָּם׃

verses.english: Look at every proud person and abase him; crush the wicked where they stand.
verses.hebrew: רְאֵה כָל־גֵּאֶה הַכְנִיעֵהוּ וַהֲדֹךְ רְשָׁעִים תַּחְתָּם׃

verses.english: Hide them together in dust; bind their faces in the hidden place.
verses.hebrew: טָמְנֵם בֶּעָפָר יָחַד פְּנֵיהֶם חֲבֹשׁ בַּטָּמוּן׃

verses.english: Then I too will acknowledge you, that your own right hand can save you.
verses.hebrew: וְגַם־אֲנִי אוֹדֶךָּ כִּי־תוֹשִׁעַ לְךָ יְמִינֶךָ׃

verses.english: Look now at Behemoth, which I made with you; it eats grass like cattle.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה־נָא בְהֵמוֹת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתִי עִמָּךְ חָצִיר כַּבָּקָר יֹאכֵל׃

verses.english: Look now, its strength is in its loins, and its power in the muscles of its belly.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה־נָא כֹחוֹ בְמָתְנָיו וְאֹנוֹ בִּשְׁרִירֵי בִטְנוֹ׃

verses.english: It stiffens its tail like a cedar; the sinews of its thighs are woven together.
verses.hebrew: יַחְפֹּץ זְנָבוֹ כְמוֹ־אָרֶז גִּידֵי פחדו [פַחֲדָיו] יְשֹׂרָגוּ׃

verses.english: Its bones are tubes of bronze; its limbs are like bars of iron.
verses.hebrew: עֲצָמָיו אֲפִיקֵי נְחוּשָׁה גְּרָמָיו כִּמְטִיל בַּרְזֶל׃

verses.english: It is the first of God’s ways; its Maker brings near His sword.
verses.hebrew: הוּא רֵאשִׁית דַּרְכֵי־אֵל הָעֹשׂוֹ יַגֵּשׁ חַרְבּוֹ׃

verses.english: For the mountains bear it produce, and all the wild animals play there.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־בוּל הָרִים יִשְׂאוּ־לוֹ וְכָל־חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה יְשַׂחֲקוּ־שָׁם׃

verses.english: It lies beneath lotus trees, in the shelter of reeds and marsh.
verses.hebrew: תַּחַת־צֶאֱלִים יִשְׁכָּב בְּסֵתֶר קָנֶה וּבִצָּה׃

verses.english: Lotus trees cover it with their shade; the willows of the stream surround it.
verses.hebrew: יְסֻכֻּהוּ צֶאֱלִים צִלֲלוֹ יְסֻבּוּהוּ עַרְבֵי־נָחַל׃

verses.english: Look, though a river surges, it is not alarmed; it is confident though Jordan bursts against its mouth.
verses.hebrew: הֵן יַעֲשֹׁק נָהָר לֹא יַחְפּוֹז יִבְטַח כִּי־יָגִיחַ יַרְדֵּן אֶל־פִּיהוּ׃

verses.english: Can anyone take it before its eyes or pierce its nose with snares?
verses.hebrew: בְּעֵינָיו יִקָּחֶנּוּ בְּמוֹקְשִׁים יִנְקָב־אָף׃

verses.english: Can you draw Leviathan with a hook or press down its tongue with a cord?
verses.hebrew: תִּמְשֹׁךְ לִוְיָתָן בְּחַכָּה וּבְחֶבֶל תַּשְׁקִיעַ לְשֹׁנוֹ׃

verses.english: Can you put a rush cord in its nose or pierce its jaw with a hook?
verses.hebrew: הֲתָשִׂים אַגְמוֹן בְּאַפּוֹ וּבְחוֹחַ תִּקּוֹב לֶחֱיוֹ׃

verses.english: Will it multiply pleas to you or speak tenderly to you?
verses.hebrew: הֲיַרְבֶּה אֵלֶיךָ תַּחֲנוּנִים אִם־יְדַבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ רַכּוֹת׃

verses.english: Will it make a covenant with you, so that you take it as a servant forever?
verses.hebrew: הֲיִכְרֹת בְּרִית עִמָּךְ תִּקָּחֶנּוּ לְעֶבֶד עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: Will you play with it as with a bird or bind it for your young women?
verses.hebrew: הַתְשַׂחֶק־בּוֹ כַּצִּפּוֹר וְתִקְשְׁרֶנּוּ לְנַעֲרוֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Will companions bargain over it or divide it among merchants?
verses.hebrew: יִכְרוּ עָלָיו חַבָּרִים יֶחֱצוּהוּ בֵּין כְּנַעֲנִים׃

verses.english: Can you fill its skin with harpoons and its head with fish spears?
verses.hebrew: הַתְמַלֵּא בְשֻׂכּוֹת עוֹרוֹ וּבְצִלְצַל דָּגִים רֹאשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: Lay your palm upon it; remember the battle, and do not do it again.”
verses.hebrew: שִׂים־עָלָיו כַּפֶּךָ זְכֹר מִלְחָמָה אַל־תּוֹסַף׃

verses.english: “Look, the hope of capturing it is proved false; is one not thrown down even at its appearance?
verses.hebrew: הֵן־תֹּחַלְתּוֹ נִכְזָבָה הֲגַם אֶל־מַרְאָיו יֻטָל׃

verses.english: No one is so fierce as to rouse it; who, then, can stand before Me?
verses.hebrew: לֹא־אַכְזָר כִּי יְעוּרֶנּוּ וּמִי הוּא לְפָנַי יִתְיַצָּב׃

verses.english: Who has first given to Me, that I must repay? Whatever is beneath all heaven is Mine.
verses.hebrew: מִי הִקְדִּימַנִי וַאֲשַׁלֵּם תַּחַת כָּל־הַשָּׁמַיִם לִי־הוּא׃

verses.english: I will not keep silent about its limbs, its mighty strength and the grace of its frame.
verses.hebrew: לא־[לוֹ־] אַחֲרִישׁ בַּדָּיו וּדְבַר־גְּבוּרוֹת וְחִין עֶרְכּוֹ׃

verses.english: Who can uncover the face of its garment, or enter within its double bridle?
verses.hebrew: מִי־גִלָּה פְּנֵי לְבוּשׁוֹ בְּכֶפֶל רִסְנוֹ מִי יָבוֹא׃

verses.english: Who can open the doors of its face? Terror surrounds its teeth.
verses.hebrew: דַּלְתֵי פָנָיו מִי פִתֵּחַ סְבִיבוֹת שִׁנָּיו אֵימָה׃

verses.english: Its pride is rows of shields, closed with a tight seal.
verses.hebrew: גַּאֲוָה אֲפִיקֵי מָגִנִּים סָגוּר חוֹתָם צָר׃

verses.english: They draw near, one to another, and no wind can come between them.
verses.hebrew: אֶחָד בְּאֶחָד יִגַּשׁוּ וְרוּחַ לֹא־יָבוֹא בֵינֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Each clings to its fellow; they hold together and do not separate.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ־בְּאָחִיהוּ יְדֻבָּקוּ יִתְלַכְּדוּ וְלֹא יִתְפָּרָדוּ׃

verses.english: Its sneezes flash light, and its eyes are like dawn’s eyelids.
verses.hebrew: עֲ‍טִישֹׁתָיו תָּהֶל אוֹר וְעֵינָיו כְּעַפְעַפֵּי־שָׁחַר׃

verses.english: Torches go out from its mouth; sparks of fire escape.
verses.hebrew: מִפִּיו לַפִּידִים יַהֲלֹכוּ כִּידוֹדֵי אֵשׁ יִתְמַלָּטוּ׃

verses.english: Smoke comes out of its nostrils, like a fanned pot and reeds.
verses.hebrew: מִנְּחִירָיו יֵצֵא עָשָׁן כְּדוּד נָפוּחַ וְאַגְמֹן׃

verses.english: Its breath sets coals ablaze, and flame comes out of its mouth.
verses.hebrew: נַפְשׁוֹ גֶּחָלִים תְּלַהֵט וְלַהַב מִפִּיו יֵצֵא׃

verses.english: Strength lodges in its neck, and dismay dances before it.
verses.hebrew: בְּצַוָּארוֹ יָלִין עֹז וּלְפָנָיו תָּדוּץ דְּאָבָה׃

verses.english: The folds of its flesh cling together; firmly cast upon it, they do not move.
verses.hebrew: מַפְּלֵי בְשָׂרוֹ דָבֵקוּ יָצוּק עָלָיו בַּל־יִמּוֹט׃

verses.english: Its heart is cast like stone, cast like a lower millstone.
verses.hebrew: לִבּוֹ יָצוּק כְּמוֹ־אָבֶן וְיָצוּק כְּפֶלַח תַּחְתִּית׃

verses.english: When it rises, the mighty are afraid; from its crashing they purify themselves.
verses.hebrew: מִשֵּׂתוֹ יָגוּרוּ אֵלִים מִשְּׁבָרִים יִתְחַטָּאוּ׃

verses.english: A sword that reaches it cannot stand, nor spear, missile or javelin.
verses.hebrew: מַשִּׂיגֵהוּ חֶרֶב בְּלִי תָקוּם חֲנִית מַסָּע וְשִׁרְיָה׃

verses.english: It counts iron as straw and bronze as rotten wood.
verses.hebrew: יַחְשֹׁב לְתֶבֶן בַּרְזֶל לְעֵץ רִקָּבוֹן נְחוּשָׁה׃

verses.english: The bow’s offspring cannot make it flee; sling stones become stubble to it.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יַבְרִיחֶנּוּ בֶן־קָשֶׁת לְקַשׁ נֶהְפְּכוּ־לוֹ אַבְנֵי־קָלַע׃

verses.english: Clubs are counted as stubble, and it laughs at a javelin’s rattle.
verses.hebrew: כְּקַשׁ נֶחְשְׁבוּ תוֹתָח וְיִשְׂחַק לְרַעַשׁ כִּידוֹן׃

verses.english: Sharp potsherds are beneath it; it spreads a threshing sledge over the mud.
verses.hebrew: תַּחְתָּיו חַדּוּדֵי חָרֶשׂ יִרְפַּד חָרוּץ עֲלֵי־טִיט׃

verses.english: It makes the deep boil like a pot; it turns the sea into an ointment vessel.
verses.hebrew: יַרְתִּיחַ כַּסִּיר מְצוּלָה יָם יָשִׂים כַּמֶּרְקָחָה׃

verses.english: Behind it a path shines; one would reckon the deep as gray hair.
verses.hebrew: אַחֲרָיו יָאִיר נָתִיב יַחְשֹׁב תְּהוֹם לְשֵׂיבָה׃

verses.english: Upon the dust there is no equal to it, a creature made without fear.
verses.hebrew: אֵין־עַל־עָפָר מָשְׁלוֹ הֶעָשׂוּ לִבְלִי־חָת׃

verses.english: It looks upon everything high; it is king over all the sons of pride.”
verses.hebrew: אֵת־כָּל־גָּבֹהַּ יִרְאֶה הוּא מֶלֶךְ עַל־כָּל־בְּנֵי־שָׁחַץ׃

verses.english: Job answered YHWH and said:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב אֶת־יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר׃

verses.english: “I know that You can do everything, and no purpose can be withheld from You.
verses.hebrew: ידעת [יָדַעְתִּי] כִּי־כֹל תּוּכָל וְלֹא־יִבָּצֵר מִמְּךָ מְזִמָּה׃

verses.english: ‘Who is this who conceals counsel without knowledge?’ Therefore I declared what I did not understand, things too wonderful for me, which I did not know.
verses.hebrew: מִי זֶה מַעְלִים עֵצָה בְּלִי דָעַת לָכֵן הִגַּדְתִּי וְלֹא אָבִין נִפְלָאוֹת מִמֶּנִּי וְלֹא אֵדָע׃

verses.english: ‘Hear now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you make it known to Me.’
verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע־נָא וְאָנֹכִי אֲדַבֵּר אֶשְׁאָלְךָ וְהוֹדִיעֵנִי׃

verses.english: By the hearing of the ear I heard You, but now my eye has seen You.
verses.hebrew: לְשֵׁמַע־אֹזֶן שְׁמַעְתִּיךָ וְעַתָּה עֵינִי רָאָתְךָ׃

verses.english: Therefore I reject it, and relent concerning dust and ashes.”
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן אֶמְאַס וְנִחַמְתִּי עַל־עָפָר וָאֵפֶר׃

verses.english: After YHWH had spoken these words to Job, YHWH said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My anger burns against you and your two friends, because you have not spoken rightly to Me as My servant Job has.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחַר דִּבֶּר יְהוָה אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל־אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־אֱלִיפַז הַתֵּימָנִי חָרָה אַפִּי בְךָ וּבִשְׁנֵי רֵעֶיךָ כִּי לֹא דִבַּרְתֶּם אֵלַי נְכוֹנָה כְּעַבְדִּי אִיּוֹב׃

verses.english: Now take seven bulls and seven rams for yourselves, and go to My servant Job. Offer a burnt offering for yourselves, and My servant Job will pray for you. For I will accept his person, so that I do not deal with you in folly, because you have not spoken rightly to Me as My servant Job has.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה קְחוּ־לָכֶם שִׁבְעָה־פָרִים וְשִׁבְעָה אֵילִים וּלְכוּ אֶל־עַבְדִּי אִיּוֹב וְהַעֲלִיתֶם עוֹלָה בַּעַדְכֶם וְאִיּוֹב עַבְדִּי יִתְפַּלֵּל עֲלֵיכֶם כִּי אִם־פָּנָיו אֶשָּׂא לְבִלְתִּי עֲשׂוֹת עִמָּכֶם נְבָלָה כִּי לֹא דִבַּרְתֶּם אֵלַי נְכוֹנָה כְּעַבְדִּי אִיּוֹב׃

verses.english: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did as YHWH told them, and YHWH accepted Job’s person.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ אֱלִיפַז הַתֵּימָנִי וּבִלְדַּד הַשּׁוּחִי צֹפַר הַנַּעֲמָתִי וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֲלֵיהֶם יְהוָה וַיִּשָּׂא יְהוָה אֶת־פְּנֵי אִיּוֹב׃

verses.english: YHWH restored Job’s fortunes when he prayed for his friend, and YHWH added to everything Job had, doubling it.
verses.hebrew: וַיהוָה שָׁב אֶת־שבית [שְׁבוּת] אִיּוֹב בְּהִתְפַּלְלוֹ בְּעַד רֵעֵהוּ וַיֹּסֶף יְהוָה אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר לְאִיּוֹב לְמִשְׁנֶה׃

verses.english: All his brothers, all his sisters and all his former acquaintances came to him and ate bread with him in his house. They showed him sympathy and comforted him concerning all the calamity YHWH had brought upon him. Each gave him one qesitah and one gold ring.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֵלָיו כָּל־אֶחָיו וְכָל־אחיתיו [אַחְיוֹתָיו] וְכָל־יֹדְעָיו לְפָנִים וַיֹּאכְלוּ עִמּוֹ לֶחֶם בְּבֵיתוֹ וַיָּנֻדוּ לוֹ וַיְנַחֲמוּ אֹתוֹ עַל כָּל־הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר־הֵבִיא יְהוָה עָלָיו וַיִּתְּנוּ־לוֹ אִישׁ קְשִׂיטָה אֶחָת וְאִישׁ נֶזֶם זָהָב אֶחָד׃

verses.english: YHWH blessed Job’s latter days more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of cattle and one thousand female donkeys.
verses.hebrew: וַיהוָה בֵּרַךְ אֶת־אַחֲרִית אִיּוֹב מֵרֵאשִׁתוֹ וַיְהִי־לוֹ אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר אֶלֶף צֹאן וְשֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים גְּמַלִּים וְאֶלֶף־צֶמֶד בָּקָר וְאֶלֶף אֲתוֹנוֹת׃

verses.english: He had seven sons and three daughters.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־לוֹ שִׁבְעָנָה בָנִים וְשָׁלוֹשׁ בָּנוֹת׃

verses.english: He named the first Jemimah, the second Keziah and the third Keren-happuch.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם־הָאַחַת יְמִימָה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִית קְצִיעָה וְשֵׁם הַשְּׁלִישִׁית קֶרֶן הַפּוּךְ׃

verses.english: In all the land no women were found as beautiful as Job’s daughters, and their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא נִמְצָא נָשִׁים יָפוֹת כִּבְנוֹת אִיּוֹב בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם אֲבִיהֶם נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: After this, Job lived one hundred forty years and saw his sons and his sons’ sons, four generations.
verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי אִיּוֹב אַחֲרֵי־זֹאת מֵאָה וְאַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וירא [וַיִּרְאֶה] אֶת־בָּנָיו וְאֶת־בְּנֵי בָנָיו אַרְבָּעָה דֹּרוֹת׃

verses.english: Job died old and full of days.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת אִיּוֹב זָקֵן וּשְׂבַע יָמִים׃
